title_zh: 【可跳过·非课程内容】课前闲聊：上课安排、学习工具与 ChemDraw
title_en: [Skippable · not course material] Pre-class chat: scheduling, study tools, ChemDraw

points.zh: 两人先寒暄时差与作息，确定以后周六这个时间点比较方便上课。
points.en: They open by comparing time zones and daily routines, and settle on this Saturday slot as the convenient one going forward.

points.zh: 学生说最近受了点小伤不出门，在家里学，室内没有有效空调，最高 27 度还能忍受。
points.en: The student says a minor injury keeps him at home; there is no working air conditioning, and the room tops out at a tolerable 27 °C.

points.zh: 老师提到基础生化课程剩下的次数已经不多，九月份前就能讲完。
points.en: The teacher notes that only a few sessions of the basic biochemistry course remain, and it should finish before September.

points.zh: 之后如果继续学别的内容（解结构、修结构、具体实验），改成每次一小时，按 0.5 节课计。
points.en: If they continue afterwards with other material (solving structures, fixing structures, wet-lab technique), sessions would drop to one hour and count as half a class.

points.zh: 学生分享屏幕，展示自己搭的学习网站：把课程内容整理成可读材料，后面带 quiz，自己作答。
points.en: The student shares his screen and shows a study site he built: lecture content turned into readable material followed by quizzes he answers himself.

points.zh: 他说这个网站还把 Lehninger 教材的内容整合了进去，量太大，不知道怎么学得完。
points.en: He says the site also folds in the Lehninger textbook, and the sheer volume is daunting.

points.zh: 学生强调英文是主要障碍，必须中英对照才看得进去；上次 EMP 就是这样学下来的。
points.en: The student stresses that English is his main obstacle: he needs Chinese alongside English to get through the material, which is how he learned EMP last time.

points.zh: 老师建议打开 ChemDraw 边画边讲，并说这个工具以后一定会用到。
points.en: The teacher suggests working in ChemDraw while explaining, and says the tool will certainly be needed later.

points.zh: 两人讨论 AI 能否直接生成可编辑的代谢通路图（矢量图，能在绘图软件里再改），老师说做 PPT 用的代谢图确实可以。
points.en: They discuss whether AI can produce directly editable metabolic pathway figures (vector graphics that can still be edited), and the teacher says it does work for pathway diagrams meant for slides.

extra.zh: ChemDraw 是 PerkinElmer 的化学结构编辑器：画结构式和反应式，能由结构算分子式、分子量与精确质量，支持 SMILES/InChI 互转，原生格式是 .cdx/.cdxml。画代谢通路的价值在于每个中间体是“化学对象”而不是图片，改一个羟基不用重画整张图。
extra.en: ChemDraw (PerkinElmer) is a chemical structure editor: it draws structures and reaction schemes, derives formula, molecular weight and exact mass from a structure, converts to and from SMILES/InChI, and saves as .cdx/.cdxml. For pathway drawing its value is that each intermediate is a chemical object rather than a picture — changing one hydroxyl does not mean redrawing the figure.

extra.zh: 矢量图（SVG/EPS/PDF，以及 .cdxml）存的是路径与坐标，放大不糊、可逐元素编辑；位图（PNG/JPG）存的是像素，只能整体缩放。他们说的“可以在 Illustrator 里打开再改”指的正是矢量格式这一性质。
extra.en: Vector formats (SVG/EPS/PDF, and .cdxml) store paths and coordinates, so they scale without blurring and every element stays editable; raster formats (PNG/JPG) store pixels and can only be rescaled as a whole. "Open it in Illustrator and edit it" is exactly this property.

extra.zh: Lehninger《Principles of Biochemistry》是这门课的标准参考书；本节课的内容对应柠檬酸循环与氧化磷酸化两章。用中英对照学的实际理由是：酶名、辅因子缩写（TPP、FAD、NAD+）和通路名在文献与数据库里只有英文形式，中文名换一本教材就可能不同。
extra.en: Lehninger's Principles of Biochemistry is the standard reference for this course; today's material corresponds to its citric acid cycle and oxidative phosphorylation chapters. The practical reason for studying bilingually is that enzyme names, cofactor abbreviations (TPP, FAD, NAD+) and pathway names exist only in English in the literature and databases, while Chinese names vary between textbooks.

extra.zh: 这一段没有课程内容，只有两条与后文相关的伏笔：本节课要把三羧酸循环与电子传递链连起来讲，以及全程会对着一张代谢通路总图定位“我们现在讲到哪一步”。复习时可以直接跳到 06:52。
extra.en: Nothing in this stretch is course material. Two things do carry forward: this session will teach the TCA cycle together with the electron transport chain, and the whole lecture is navigated against one overview pathway map. When revising, skip to 06:52.

quiz.q_zh: 老师建议用来一边画一边讲代谢反应的 ChemDraw，是一款什么软件？
quiz.q_en: ChemDraw, which the teacher suggests using to draw reactions while explaining, is what kind of software?

options.zh: 从氨基酸序列预测三维结构的软件
options.en: software predicting 3D structure from an amino acid sequence

options.zh: 绘制化学结构式与反应式的编辑器
options.en: an editor for drawing chemical structures and reaction schemes

options.zh: 做统计分析并输出统计图的通用软件
options.en: general software for statistical analysis and statistical plots

options.zh: 比对蛋白序列并构建进化树的工具
options.en: a tool for aligning protein sequences and building trees

quiz.explain_zh: ChemDraw 是化学结构编辑器，画结构式与反应式，并能由结构算分子式和精确质量。序列比对建树是 MEGA/MAFFT 一类工具，结构预测是 AlphaFold 一类程序，统计作图是 GraphPad/R 一类软件，都与 ChemDraw 的功能无关。
quiz.explain_en: ChemDraw is a chemical structure editor: it draws structures and reaction schemes and derives formula and exact mass from them. Sequence alignment and tree building belong to tools like MEGA/MAFFT, structure prediction to programs like AlphaFold, and statistical plotting to GraphPad/R — none of which is what ChemDraw does.

quiz.q_zh: 两人讨论 AI 生成代谢通路图时，看重的是生成结果的哪一点？
quiz.q_en: When they discuss AI-generated pathway figures, which property of the output do they care about?

options.zh: 能实时连接数据库自动更新通路内容
options.en: it links to a database and refreshes the pathway live

options.zh: 能直接作为期刊插图不必再排版调整
options.en: it can go straight into a journal without any reformatting

options.zh: 是可编辑的矢量图，还能再逐个修改
options.en: it is an editable vector figure that can still be revised

options.zh: 能自动为每一步标注准确的 ΔG°′ 值
options.en: it labels every step with an accurate ΔG°′ value on its own

quiz.explain_zh: 他们关心的是生成的图能在 ChemDraw 或 Illustrator 里打开继续改，也就是矢量、可编辑。自动标注 ΔG°′、实时连数据库、直接投稿用都不是这段对话提到的诉求，也不是这类工具的实际能力。
quiz.explain_en: What they want is a figure that can be opened in ChemDraw or Illustrator and edited further — i.e. vector and editable. Automatic ΔG°′ labelling, live database linkage and publication-ready output are neither mentioned nor realistic capabilities here.

title_zh: 本节课的安排：TCA 循环与电子传递链连着讲；TCA 与 EMP 的总体对比
title_en: Plan for the session: teaching TCA together with the ETC, and how TCA compares with EMP

points.zh: 老师说本节课任务重，希望把电子传递链和三羧酸循环一起学。
points.en: The teacher says this is a heavy session: he wants to cover the electron transport chain together with the TCA cycle.

points.zh: 他指出电子传递链在生化教材里通常单独成章，但这一章和 TCA 循环联系极紧，两章其实是连在一起的。
points.en: He notes that the ETC is usually a separate chapter in biochemistry textbooks, yet it is so tightly linked to the TCA cycle that the two really belong together.

points.zh: 他一贯希望这两部分一起讲，认为这样理解会更深。
points.en: He consistently prefers teaching the two as one block, on the grounds that understanding goes deeper that way.

points.zh: 决定不复习上次的 EMP 途径，因为 EMP 相对没那么难。
points.en: He decides not to review last session's EMP pathway, since EMP is comparatively less difficult.

points.zh: 他随即改口说 EMP 其实也挺难，TCA 与 EMP 难度差不多，甚至更难。
points.en: He immediately qualifies this: EMP is hard too, and TCA is about as hard or harder.

points.zh: 关于步骤数，他说 EMP 是十个整，三羧酸循环“好像是十几个、十一二个”。
points.en: On step count he says EMP has exactly ten steps and the TCA cycle "seems to have a dozen or so, eleven or twelve".

points.zh: 他给出的第一个对比点：EMP 途径在基本上所有生物体内都存在，分布非常广泛。
points.en: His first contrast: the EMP pathway is present in essentially all organisms, extremely widely distributed.

points.zh: 他说 TCA 循环只在部分生物里被利用，因为 TCA 与氧气高度相关，是一种有氧呼吸的形式，而很多生物走的是无氧形式。
points.en: He says the TCA cycle is used only by some organisms, because it is tightly tied to oxygen as a form of aerobic respiration, while many organisms operate anaerobically.

points.zh: 他补充说植物很大程度上靠光合作用途径产能，而不是靠三羧酸循环，并当场表示自己不确定植物会不会用 TCA。
points.en: He adds that plants largely make energy through photosynthesis rather than the TCA cycle, while admitting on the spot that he is not sure whether plants use TCA at all.

extra.zh: 他说 TCA “好像是十几个、十一二个”步骤（后面又说“这么十来步”）。标准计数是 8 步 8 个酶：柠檬酸合酶、顺乌头酸酶、异柠檬酸脱氢酶、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体、琥珀酰CoA合成酶、琥珀酸脱氢酶、延胡索酸酶（fumarase）、苹果酸脱氢酶。把 PDH 复合体这个入口反应也算进去也只有 9 步。他说 EMP 十步是对的。本节课他没有更正步骤数。
extra.en: He says TCA has "a dozen or so, eleven or twelve" steps (and later "about ten steps"). The standard count is 8 steps and 8 enzymes: citrate synthase, aconitase, isocitrate dehydrogenase, the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex, succinyl-CoA synthetase, succinate dehydrogenase, fumarase, malate dehydrogenase. Counting the PDH entry reaction as well gives only 9. His ten steps for EMP is correct. He never revises the number in this lecture.

extra.zh: 他说 TCA “只在部分微生物和大部分的动物里比较广泛存在”。实际上 TCA 循环在需氧生物中近乎普遍——细菌、真菌、植物、动物都有完整循环；不完整或分支型的是专性厌氧菌和部分寄生生物，它们只走氧化支或还原支来供应生物合成前体。所以正确的对比是“厌氧生物不跑完整 TCA”，而不是“只有部分微生物和动物有”。
extra.en: He says TCA is "widespread only in some microbes and most animals". In fact the cycle is near-universal among aerobes — bacteria, fungi, plants and animals all run a complete cycle; it is obligate anaerobes and some parasites that carry an incomplete or branched version, running only the oxidative or reductive arm to supply biosynthetic precursors. The correct contrast is "anaerobes do not run a complete TCA", not "only some microbes and animals have it".

extra.zh: 他坚持把两章连起来讲的真正理由，讲课里没有点破：TCA 循环本身每转一圈只由底物水平磷酸化直接得到 1 个 GTP，其余能量全部以 3 个 NADH + 1 个 FADH2 的形式存着，必须交给电子传递链才能兑换成 ATP。而且琥珀酸脱氢酶同时是 TCA 的第 6 步和呼吸链的复合体 II——一个酶同属两条通路，这才是“两章连在一起”的物理接口。
extra.en: The real reason for teaching the two chapters together is left unsaid: one turn of the TCA cycle yields only a single GTP by substrate-level phosphorylation, and all the rest of the energy is banked as 3 NADH + 1 FADH2, which only the electron transport chain can convert into ATP. Moreover succinate dehydrogenase is simultaneously step 6 of the cycle and Complex II of the respiratory chain — one enzyme in both pathways is the physical interface between the two chapters.

extra.zh: 一轮 TCA 循环的收支（以进入的 1 个乙酰CoA 计）：放出 2 个 CO2，生成 3 个 NADH、1 个 FADH2、1 个 GTP（或 ATP），并消耗 1 分子水（延胡索酸水合）另加柠檬酸合酶那一步的水。按现行换算 NADH ≈ 2.5 ATP、FADH2 ≈ 1.5 ATP，一圈约合 10 个 ATP，其中只有 1 个不经呼吸链。
extra.en: Balance of one turn (per acetyl-CoA entering): 2 CO2 released, 3 NADH, 1 FADH2 and 1 GTP (or ATP) formed, with water consumed at the fumarase and citrate synthase steps. At the current conversions of ≈2.5 ATP per NADH and ≈1.5 per FADH2, a turn is worth about 10 ATP, of which only one is made without the respiratory chain.

quiz.q_zh: 按标准生化教材计数，TCA 循环有多少步、多少个酶？
quiz.q_en: By the standard textbook count, how many steps and enzymes does the TCA cycle have?

options.zh: 10 步 10 个酶，与 EMP 途径数目相同
options.en: 10 steps, 10 enzymes, the same number as EMP

options.zh: 6 步 6 个酶，另有两个旁路的支路酶
options.en: 6 steps, 6 enzymes, plus two bypass enzymes

options.zh: 12 步 12 个酶，其中包含两次脱羧
options.en: 12 steps, 12 enzymes, two of them decarboxylations

options.zh: 8 步 8 个酶，加上 PDH 入口共 9 步
options.en: 8 steps, 8 enzymes; 9 counting the PDH entry

quiz.explain_zh: 循环本身是 8 步 8 酶（柠檬酸合酶到苹果酸脱氢酶），把 PDH 复合体这个入口反应算进来是 9 步。十步是 EMP 的数目，老师那里说反了；12 步和 6 步都不对应任何一种标准计数法。
quiz.explain_en: The cycle proper is 8 steps and 8 enzymes (citrate synthase through malate dehydrogenase), or 9 if the PDH entry reaction is included. Ten is the EMP count, which the teacher transferred to TCA; neither 12 nor 6 corresponds to any standard way of counting.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 TCA 循环在生物界的分布，下列哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the distribution of the TCA cycle across organisms is correct?

options.zh: 只有真核生物才有，细菌一律用别的替代途径
options.en: only eukaryotes have it; bacteria all use other routes instead

options.zh: 植物白天完全不跑循环，只在夜间才启动它
options.en: plants shut the cycle down by day and switch it on at night

options.zh: 需氧生物中近乎普遍，专性厌氧菌才不完整
options.en: near-universal in aerobes; only obligate anaerobes lack parts

options.zh: 只有部分微生物和大部分动物才有完整循环
options.en: only some microbes and most animals run a complete cycle

quiz.explain_zh: 细菌、真菌、植物、动物凡需氧者都有完整循环，不完整的是专性厌氧菌和部分寄生生物。“只有部分微生物和大部分动物”是老师的说法，范围过窄；细菌恰恰是循环研究的经典材料；植物夜间和根组织依赖循环，但白天也在运行。
quiz.explain_en: Bacteria, fungi, plants and animals all run a complete cycle when aerobic; obligate anaerobes and some parasites are the incomplete cases. "Only some microbes and most animals" is the teacher's version and is too narrow; bacteria are in fact classic material for studying the cycle; and plants run it by day as well, though roots and night tissue depend on it most.

quiz.q_zh: 把三羧酸循环与电子传递链连起来讲，最根本的依据是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the most fundamental reason for teaching the TCA cycle and the ETC together?

options.zh: 两者共用同一批脱氢酶，酶蛋白完全相同
options.en: the two share one set of dehydrogenases, identical proteins

options.zh: 电子传递链的产物必须回到循环里重新氧化
options.en: the products of the ETC must return to the cycle to reoxidize

options.zh: 两者都发生在线粒体的外膜与膜间隙之中
options.en: both take place in the outer membrane and intermembrane space

options.zh: 循环的能量主要以 NADH、FADH2 交给呼吸链
options.en: the cycle banks its energy as NADH and FADH2 for the chain

quiz.explain_zh: 循环每圈只直接产 1 个 GTP，3 个 NADH 和 1 个 FADH2 必须由呼吸链兑现，且琥珀酸脱氢酶同时是复合体 II，这是两者的物理接口。呼吸链的终产物是水，不回到循环；循环在基质、呼吸链在内膜，都不在膜间隙；两者的酶也并非同一批。
quiz.explain_en: Each turn yields only one GTP directly; the 3 NADH and 1 FADH2 must be cashed in by the respiratory chain, and succinate dehydrogenase doubles as Complex II, the physical interface. The chain's end product is water and does not re-enter the cycle; the cycle sits in the matrix and the chain in the inner membrane, neither in the intermembrane space; and their enzymes are not one shared set.

title_zh: 植物也有完整 TCA：动植物在琥珀酰CoA 那一步的差别，以及“发生在哪里”的引入
title_en: Plants do run a complete TCA: the animal/plant difference at succinyl-CoA, and the question of location

points.zh: 学生现场查证后确认植物也用 TCA 循环，老师接受了这个结论。
points.en: The student checks and confirms that plants do use the TCA cycle, and the teacher accepts it.

points.zh: 他补充说植物那一套“单独另外一套”，看起来和动物的稍有不同。
points.en: He adds that plants run "their own separate version", which looks somewhat different from the animal one.

points.zh: 他给出的具体差别：在琥珀酰辅酶A 转变为琥珀酸这一步，植物主要生成 ATP，动物生成 GTP。
points.en: The concrete difference he gives: at the conversion of succinyl-CoA to succinate, plants mainly form ATP while animals form GTP.

points.zh: 他说差别还不止这一点，后边还会提到植物有一些特殊的酶，人体没有。
points.en: He says the differences do not stop there, and that later he will mention enzymes plants have and humans lack.

points.zh: 他指出这些植物特有的酶与脂肪酸代谢、酮体那一块比较相关，留到后面讲。
points.en: He notes those plant-specific enzymes relate to fatty acid metabolism and ketone bodies, and defers the topic.

points.zh: 转入正题：讲 TCA 循环首先要知道它发生的位置。
points.en: He turns to the main thread: to understand the TCA cycle one must first know where it happens.

points.zh: 他说“就是在细胞质里边”，紧接着说的是上次讲的 EMP 途径所有步骤都在细胞质内发生。
points.en: He says "it is in the cytosol", and what immediately follows is that all steps of the EMP pathway covered last time occur in the cytosol.

points.zh: EMP 在细胞质里跑完以后，产物丙酮酸要离开细胞质，进入线粒体。
points.en: Once EMP has finished in the cytosol, its product pyruvate has to leave the cytosol and enter the mitochondrion.

points.zh: 他提示线粒体是双层膜结构，丙酮酸首先遇到的是线粒体外膜。
points.en: He points out that the mitochondrion is a double-membrane organelle, and the outer membrane is what pyruvate meets first.

extra.zh: “整个 TCA 循环……它发生的位置就是在细胞质里边”是本段最容易被抄错的一句：按语气他是要转去说 EMP 在细胞质，字面却像在说 TCA 在细胞质。他在 11:38 前后讲对了——除一步外全部在线粒体基质，只有一步在内膜上。笔记以 11:38 那段为准，不要把 TCA 记成胞质途径。
extra.en: "The whole TCA cycle … its location is in the cytosol" is the sentence most likely to be copied down wrongly here: in context he is pivoting to say that EMP is cytosolic, but the words read as if TCA were. He gets it right around 11:38 — everything but one step is in the mitochondrial matrix, with that one step on the inner membrane. Take the 11:38 passage as the record and do not file TCA as a cytosolic pathway.

extra.zh: 琥珀酰CoA→琥珀酸 的 ATP/GTP 差别来自同工酶：琥珀酰CoA合成酶（succinyl-CoA synthetase）的 β 亚基有 G 型和 A 型，哺乳动物两种都有（GTP 型多在肝、肾，ATP 型多在骨骼肌等高需氧组织），植物和多数细菌是 ADP/ATP 型。两者能量等价，核苷二磷酸激酶（NDPK）可以把磷酸在 GTP 与 ATP 之间互换，所以记账时按 1 个高能磷酸键算即可。
extra.en: The ATP-versus-GTP difference at succinyl-CoA comes from isoenzymes: the β subunit of succinyl-CoA synthetase exists in G and A forms, and mammals have both (the GTP form largely in liver and kidney, the ATP form in tissues like skeletal muscle), while plants and most bacteria use the ADP/ATP form. The two are energetically equivalent — nucleoside diphosphate kinase exchanges the phosphate between GTP and ATP — so for bookkeeping it counts as one high-energy phosphate either way.

extra.zh: 他说的“植物有、人体没有”的酶，通常指乙醛酸循环（glyoxylate cycle）的异柠檬酸裂解酶和苹果酸合酶，位于乙醛酸体。这条支路把异柠檬酸直接劈成琥珀酸和乙醛酸，绕开了循环里的两次脱羧，因此不丢碳——这正是萌发的油料种子能把脂肪酸净合成为糖的原因。动物缺这两个酶，所以脂肪酸不能净变成葡萄糖。
extra.en: The enzymes "plants have and humans lack" normally means isocitrate lyase and malate synthase of the glyoxylate cycle, housed in glyoxysomes. That bypass splits isocitrate straight into succinate and glyoxylate, skipping the cycle's two decarboxylations and therefore losing no carbon — which is why germinating oilseeds can convert fatty acids into sugar. Animals lack both enzymes, so fatty acids cannot be turned into glucose net.

extra.zh: 光合作用和 TCA 循环不是二选一。光合作用同化 CO2 生成糖，糖仍必须经糖酵解 + TCA + 电子传递链氧化才能供给 ATP；夜间、根、种子等非光合组织完全靠呼吸供能。植物线粒体的循环还多一条旁路：交替氧化酶（AOX）可以绕过复合体 III 和 IV 直接把电子交给氧，不泵质子，产热而不产 ATP。
extra.en: Photosynthesis and the TCA cycle are not alternatives. Photosynthesis fixes CO2 into sugar; that sugar still has to go through glycolysis, TCA and the electron transport chain to yield ATP, and non-photosynthetic tissue — roots, seeds, everything at night — depends entirely on respiration. Plant mitochondria also carry an extra branch: alternative oxidase (AOX) hands electrons straight to O2, bypassing Complexes III and IV, pumping no protons and giving heat rather than ATP.

quiz.q_zh: 琥珀酰CoA 转变为琥珀酸这一步，动物与植物的差别在哪里？
quiz.q_en: How do animals and plants differ at the conversion of succinyl-CoA to succinate?

options.zh: 动物用 FAD 作受体，植物用 NAD+ 作氢受体
options.en: animals use FAD as acceptor, plants use NAD+ instead

options.zh: 动物生成 GTP，植物生成 ATP，二者能量等价
options.en: animals make GTP, plants ATP; the two are equivalent

options.zh: 动物在基质中进行，植物在叶绿体基质中进行
options.en: animals run it in the matrix, plants in the chloroplast

options.zh: 动物生成 ATP，植物生成 GTP，二者能量等价
options.en: animals make ATP, plants GTP; the two are equivalent

quiz.explain_zh: 琥珀酰CoA合成酶有 G 型和 A 型同工酶，哺乳动物主要走 GTP，植物和多数细菌走 ATP，经 NDPK 可互换。方向不能反过来记；植物的这一步同样在线粒体基质而非叶绿体；这一步是底物水平磷酸化，不产生 FADH2 或 NADH，FAD 是下一步琥珀酸脱氢酶的事。
quiz.explain_en: Succinyl-CoA synthetase comes in G-type and A-type isoenzymes: mammals mainly make GTP, plants and most bacteria ATP, and NDPK interconverts them. The direction cannot be reversed; the plant reaction is likewise in the mitochondrial matrix, not the chloroplast; and this step is substrate-level phosphorylation with no FADH2 or NADH — FAD belongs to the next step, succinate dehydrogenase.

quiz.q_zh: 对于“植物是否运行 TCA 循环”，正确的理解是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the correct picture of whether plants run the TCA cycle?

options.zh: 植物用光合作用取代循环，只保留最前面三步
options.en: photosynthesis replaces the cycle; only the first steps stay

options.zh: 植物的循环在叶绿体里，与光合作用共用中间体
options.en: the plant cycle sits in chloroplasts, sharing intermediates

options.zh: 植物只在种子萌发的那几天才短暂运行该循环
options.en: plants run the cycle only briefly, while seeds germinate

options.zh: 植物有完整的线粒体循环，夜间与根尤其依赖
options.en: plants have a full mitochondrial cycle; roots rely on it

quiz.explain_zh: 植物线粒体有完整的八步循环，光合只负责同化 CO2 成糖，糖仍要靠呼吸氧化供能，根和夜间的地上部分完全依赖它。循环在线粒体基质而不在叶绿体；它也不是萌发期专属，萌发期特别活跃的是乙醛酸循环这条旁路。
quiz.explain_en: Plant mitochondria run the complete eight-step cycle; photosynthesis only fixes CO2 into sugar, and that sugar must still be oxidized by respiration, on which roots and all tissue at night depend entirely. The cycle is in the mitochondrial matrix, not the chloroplast, and it is not restricted to germination — what is especially active then is the glyoxylate bypass.

quiz.q_zh: 老师说“植物有、我们人体没有”的酶，通常指的是哪一组？
quiz.q_en: Which pair of enzymes is normally meant by "plants have them, humans do not"?

options.zh: 乙醛酸循环的异柠檬酸裂解酶与苹果酸合酶
options.en: isocitrate lyase and malate synthase of the glyoxylate cycle

options.zh: 调控丙酮酸脱氢酶的激酶 PDK 与磷酸酶 PDP
options.en: the PDH-regulating kinase PDK and phosphatase PDP

options.zh: 把草酰乙酸变成 PEP 的磷酸烯醇丙酮酸羧激酶
options.en: PEP carboxykinase, turning oxaloacetate into PEP

options.zh: 催化脂肪酸 β-氧化的线粒体三功能酶复合体
options.en: the mitochondrial trifunctional protein of β-oxidation

quiz.explain_zh: 异柠檬酸裂解酶和苹果酸合酶构成乙醛酸循环，绕过两次脱羧因而不丢碳，使油料种子能把脂肪酸净合成糖；动物没有这两个酶。三功能酶、PDK/PDP、PEP 羧激酶动物全都有，人体的糖异生正是靠 PEP 羧激酶。
quiz.explain_en: Isocitrate lyase and malate synthase constitute the glyoxylate cycle, which skips both decarboxylations and so loses no carbon, letting oilseeds turn fatty acids into sugar; animals have neither. The trifunctional protein, PDK/PDP and PEP carboxykinase are all present in animals — human gluconeogenesis runs on PEP carboxykinase.

title_zh: 丙酮酸怎样进入线粒体：外膜孔道、内膜载体，以及“只有一步在膜上”
title_en: How pyruvate enters the mitochondrion: outer-membrane pores, an inner-membrane carrier, and the one step on the membrane

points.zh: 线粒体外膜上有一些非特异性的蛋白孔道，起类似转运蛋白的作用，但不专一，很多底物都能通过。
points.en: The outer membrane carries non-specific protein pores that act like transporters but without specificity, so many substrates can pass.

points.zh: 丙酮酸先经外膜上的非特异孔道进入内膜与外膜之间的间隙。
points.en: Pyruvate first crosses those non-specific outer-membrane pores into the space between the inner and outer membranes.

points.zh: 内膜上则有一个专一的丙酮酸转运蛋白，他称之为“移位酶”，专门识别丙酮酸。
points.en: The inner membrane, by contrast, holds a specific pyruvate transporter — he calls it a translocase — that recognizes pyruvate alone.

points.zh: 他说这个酶最后让丙酮酸“进入到线粒体的内膜里边”。
points.en: He says this enzyme finally lets pyruvate "enter into the inner membrane of the mitochondrion".

points.zh: 他反复强调：整个 TCA 循环的反应都发生在线粒体基质，也就是内膜的内侧。
points.en: He stresses repeatedly that the reactions of the TCA cycle all take place in the mitochondrial matrix, i.e. on the inner side of the inner membrane.

points.zh: 只有一步例外，是在线粒体内膜上发生的。
points.en: There is exactly one exception, a step that occurs on the inner membrane itself.

points.zh: 他说 TCA 循环发生位置这件事比较重要，因为马上要讲电子传递链。
points.en: He says the location of the cycle matters a great deal because the electron transport chain comes next.

points.zh: 电子传递链发生在线粒体内膜上，所以对“哪一步在膜上、哪一步在基质”要有明确概念。
points.en: The electron transport chain sits in the inner membrane, so one must be clear about which step is on the membrane and which is in the matrix.

extra.zh: 他说移位酶把丙酮酸送“进入到线粒体的内膜里边”——应为送进线粒体基质（matrix）。膜“里边”是磷脂双分子层内部，那里只有疏水链，不是任何代谢物的去处。这个转运体的正名是线粒体丙酮酸载体 MPC（MPC1/MPC2 异二聚体），以 H+ 同向共转运的方式把丙酮酸带进基质，不是普通的“移位酶”。同一段里他把 TCA 循环的定位讲对了（基质），所以只需纠正这一句。
extra.en: He has the translocase deliver pyruvate "into the inner membrane" — it delivers it into the matrix. "Inside" a membrane is the interior of the lipid bilayer, nothing but hydrophobic chains and no destination for a metabolite. The transporter's proper name is the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier, MPC (an MPC1/MPC2 heterodimer), which brings pyruvate into the matrix by H+ symport rather than acting as a generic translocase. He states the cycle's own location correctly (matrix) in the same passage, so only this sentence needs fixing.

extra.zh: 外膜上的“非特异孔道”是 porin，即 VDAC（电压依赖阴离子通道），允许约 5 kDa 以下的溶质近乎自由通过，所以膜间隙的小分子组成基本等同于胞质。真正的选择性屏障是内膜——它的蛋白/脂比极高、富含心磷脂、几乎不通透，每一类代谢物都要有自己的载体（丙酮酸 MPC、ADP/ATP translocase、柠檬酸转运体、磷酸载体等）。这也是质子梯度只能建立在内膜两侧的原因：外膜漏得根本存不住梯度。
extra.en: The "non-specific pores" of the outer membrane are porins — VDAC, the voltage-dependent anion channel — through which solutes below roughly 5 kDa pass almost freely, so the small-molecule composition of the intermembrane space is essentially that of the cytosol. The real selective barrier is the inner membrane: unusually protein-rich, packed with cardiolipin, and effectively impermeable, so every class of metabolite needs its own carrier (MPC for pyruvate, the ADP/ATP translocase, the citrate transporter, the phosphate carrier). This is also why the proton gradient can only exist across the inner membrane: the outer one leaks far too much to hold one.

extra.zh: 他说的“唯一在膜上的那一步”是琥珀酸脱氢酶（succinate dehydrogenase），它就是呼吸链的复合体 II，是循环八个酶中唯一嵌进线粒体内膜的整合膜蛋白，其余七个都是可溶的基质酶。这也正是它同时属于 TCA 循环和电子传递链、把循环直接接进呼吸链的原因。注意丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体不是这个例外——它虽然常与内膜的基质面疏松结合，但仍是基质中的可溶复合体。
extra.en: The "one step on the membrane" is succinate dehydrogenase, which is Complex II of the respiratory chain — the only one of the cycle's eight enzymes that is an integral protein of the inner membrane, the other seven being soluble matrix enzymes. That is exactly why it belongs to both the TCA cycle and the electron transport chain and wires the cycle straight into respiration. Note that the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex is not this exception: though often loosely associated with the matrix face of the inner membrane, it remains a soluble matrix complex.

extra.zh: MPC 的转运方向不是随意的：它把 1 个丙酮酸和 1 个 H+ 一起带过内膜，由跨内膜的质子驱动力（膜电位约 −150 至 −180 mV，基质侧 pH 比膜间隙高约 0.5–0.75 单位）推动，正常呼吸的线粒体里净流向是进入基质。抑制剂 UK5099 阻断 MPC，会让丙酮酸堆在胞质并转向乳酸。
extra.en: MPC's direction is not arbitrary: it carries one pyruvate together with one H+ across the inner membrane, driven by the proton-motive force (a membrane potential of about −150 to −180 mV, with the matrix roughly 0.5–0.75 pH units more alkaline than the intermembrane space), so in a respiring mitochondrion net flux is inward. The inhibitor UK5099 blocks MPC, leaving pyruvate to accumulate in the cytosol and divert to lactate.

quiz.q_zh: 丙酮酸从细胞质到达 TCA 循环反应场所，走的路径是？
quiz.q_en: By what route does pyruvate get from the cytosol to where the TCA cycle runs?

options.zh: 外膜非特异孔道，进膜间隙，再由内膜载体入基质
options.en: outer pores, intermembrane space, inner carrier, matrix

options.zh: 先由内膜载体转运，再经外膜孔道进入线粒体嵴腔
options.en: the inner carrier first, then outer pores into the cristae

options.zh: 由囊泡包裹运输，与内膜融合后释放进入基质
options.en: packaged in vesicles that fuse with the inner membrane

options.zh: 跨过内外两层膜自由扩散，直接进入线粒体基质
options.en: free diffusion across both membranes straight to the matrix

quiz.explain_zh: 外膜的 porin/VDAC 让丙酮酸这类小分子近乎自由进入膜间隙，内膜上的 MPC 再以 H+ 同向共转运把它送进基质。内膜富含心磷脂、几乎不通透，带负电的丙酮酸不能自由扩散过去；线粒体也不用囊泡运输代谢物；把内膜和外膜的先后次序颠倒则与解剖结构相悖。
quiz.explain_en: Porin/VDAC in the outer membrane lets a small molecule like pyruvate into the intermembrane space almost freely, and MPC in the inner membrane then symports it with H+ into the matrix. The inner membrane is cardiolipin-rich and effectively impermeable, so anionic pyruvate cannot simply diffuse through; mitochondria do not import metabolites in vesicles; and putting the inner membrane before the outer one inverts the anatomy.

quiz.q_zh: 老师说 TCA 循环“只有一步不在基质”，那一步的酶是？
quiz.q_en: The teacher says one TCA step is not in the matrix — which enzyme catalyses it?

options.zh: 苹果酸脱氢酶，产生循环最后一个 NADH
options.en: malate dehydrogenase, making the cycle's last NADH

options.zh: α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体中的 E3 亚基
options.en: the E3 subunit of the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex

options.zh: 琥珀酸脱氢酶，也就是呼吸链的复合体 II
options.en: succinate dehydrogenase, which is respiratory Complex II

options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶，缩合乙酰CoA 与草酰乙酸
options.en: citrate synthase, condensing acetyl-CoA with oxaloacetate

quiz.explain_zh: 琥珀酸脱氢酶是循环八个酶中唯一嵌在内膜上的整合膜蛋白，同时充当复合体 II。柠檬酸合酶、苹果酸脱氢酶都是可溶的基质酶；α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体连同它的 E3 亚基同样在基质中，与内膜没有整合关系。
quiz.explain_en: Succinate dehydrogenase is the only one of the cycle's eight enzymes integral to the inner membrane, doubling as Complex II. Citrate synthase and malate dehydrogenase are soluble matrix enzymes, and the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex, E3 subunit included, is likewise in the matrix with no membrane integration.

quiz.q_zh: 线粒体外膜上“非特异性蛋白孔道”的性质是什么？
quiz.q_en: What are the "non-specific protein pores" of the outer membrane?

options.zh: 只识别并转运丙酮酸一种底物的专一载体
options.en: a specific carrier that recognizes and moves only pyruvate

options.zh: 对所有溶质均不通透、起密封作用的膜结构
options.en: a sealed structure impermeable to every kind of solute

options.zh: porin/VDAC，约 5 kDa 以下溶质近乎自由通过
options.en: porin/VDAC: solutes under about 5 kDa pass nearly freely

options.zh: 由 ATP 水解驱动、逆浓度梯度工作的主动泵
options.en: active pumps driven by ATP against a concentration gradient

quiz.explain_zh: 外膜的孔道是 porin（VDAC），被动通透，小分子近乎自由进出，因此膜间隙的小分子组成接近胞质。专一性、耗能的转运在内膜上（如 MPC、ADP/ATP translocase）；若外膜真的密封或需要主动泵，膜间隙就不可能与胞质近乎平衡。
quiz.explain_en: The outer-membrane pores are porins (VDAC): passive, letting small molecules through almost freely, which is why the intermembrane space nearly matches the cytosol in small-molecule composition. Specific, energy-requiring transport happens in the inner membrane (MPC, the ADP/ATP translocase); if the outer membrane were sealed or needed active pumps, that near-equilibrium could not exist.

title_zh: 名称与意义：柠檬酸循环 / TCA，以及“两用代谢途径”
title_en: Names and purpose: citric acid cycle versus TCA, and the amphibolic pathway

points.zh: 同一条通路有两个名字：柠檬酸循环和三羧酸循环；他说英文里 TCA 用得比较多，柠檬酸循环这个叫法比较老。
points.en: One pathway, two names: the citric acid cycle and the tricarboxylic acid cycle; he says TCA is the commoner form in English and "citric acid cycle" sounds older.

points.zh: 他给 TCA 循环的定性是“两用代谢途径”，并逐条解释“两用”指什么。
points.en: He characterizes the cycle as an amphibolic pathway and then unpacks what the two roles are.

points.zh: 第一重：它是完全氧化分解的必经途径，主要是针对糖类而言。
points.en: First role: it is the obligatory route for complete oxidative breakdown, mainly of carbohydrate.

points.zh: 他补充说部分脂肪的完全氧化也要借用 TCA 循环。
points.en: He adds that complete oxidation of some fat also has to go through the cycle.

points.zh: 他说脂肪也有一个“类似于 EMP 途径”的降解，但步骤要简单得多，最终降解为丙酮酸的一些类似物。
points.en: He says fat likewise has an EMP-like degradation, but with far fewer steps, ending in something analogous to pyruvate.

points.zh: 第二重：TCA 的中间代谢产物是很多重要生物分子的前体。
points.en: Second role: the cycle's intermediates are precursors for many important biomolecules.

points.zh: 他反问：为什么要走这么复杂的十来步最终才产能？一大部分原因就是中间产物可以参与别的生物分子的合成。
points.en: He asks rhetorically why energy production should take a dozen convoluted steps, and answers that a large part of the reason is that the intermediates feed other biosyntheses.

points.zh: 所以 TCA 既是一种完全的分解途径，又是一种提供中间代谢产物的途径，这是它的关键点。
points.en: So the cycle is at once a complete catabolic route and a supplier of intermediates — the key point about it.

points.zh: 讲完定性后，他从上节课结尾的 pyruvate（丙酮酸）接着往下讲。
points.en: Having framed it, he picks up from where the last session ended: pyruvate.

extra.zh: amphibolic（两用）的具体清单值得背下来：柠檬酸出线粒体→胞质乙酰CoA→脂肪酸与胆固醇合成；α-酮戊二酸→谷氨酸、谷氨酰胺、脯氨酸、精氨酸；琥珀酰CoA→卟啉环→血红素；草酰乙酸→天冬氨酸→嘧啶核苷酸，或→PEP→糖异生；苹果酸→出线粒体参与还原当量穿梭。中间产物被抽走后必须由回补反应（anaplerotic）补上，否则循环停摆。
extra.en: The amphibolic inventory is worth memorizing: citrate leaves the mitochondrion and becomes cytosolic acetyl-CoA for fatty acid and cholesterol synthesis; α-ketoglutarate becomes glutamate, glutamine, proline, arginine; succinyl-CoA becomes the porphyrin ring and thus haem; oxaloacetate becomes aspartate and pyrimidine nucleotides, or PEP for gluconeogenesis; malate exits as part of reducing-equivalent shuttles. Whatever is withdrawn must be replaced by anaplerotic reactions or the cycle stalls.

extra.zh: 他说脂肪的降解“类似 EMP、最终变成丙酮酸的类似物”。实际上脂肪酸走的是 β-氧化：活化成脂酰CoA 进入线粒体后，每一轮切下二碳，直接生成乙酰CoA，同时产 1 个 FADH2 和 1 个 NADH，中间根本不经过丙酮酸。只有甘油那部分经甘油激酶和甘油-3-磷酸脱氢酶进入糖酵解。奇数链脂肪酸末端剩三个碳生成丙酰CoA，经羧化和变位酶转成琥珀酰CoA，是从侧门进循环。
extra.en: He describes fat degradation as EMP-like, ending in something pyruvate-ish. In fact fatty acids run β-oxidation: activated to acyl-CoA, imported, then clipped two carbons at a time straight to acetyl-CoA, each round also yielding one FADH2 and one NADH, with pyruvate nowhere in the path. Only the glycerol moiety enters glycolysis, via glycerol kinase and glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase. Odd-chain fatty acids leave a three-carbon propionyl-CoA that is carboxylated and rearranged into succinyl-CoA, entering the cycle by a side door.

extra.zh: “循环”意味着有一个分子绕一圈后被原样再生——那个分子是草酰乙酸，不是乙酰CoA。乙酰CoA 每一圈都被消耗掉，浓度随脂肪酸氧化和糖代谢大幅波动；草酰乙酸才是与乙酰基缩合、绕一圈后又生成出来、在体内浓度很低而相对恒定的那一个。更要紧的是：同位素标记的经典结论是，第一圈放出的两个 CO2 全部来自草酰乙酸部分的碳，进来的乙酰基那两个碳这一圈并不离开，要到后面几圈才被放出。
extra.en: "Cycle" implies a molecule regenerated unchanged each turn — and that molecule is oxaloacetate, not acetyl-CoA. Acetyl-CoA is consumed every turn and its concentration swings with fatty acid oxidation and carbohydrate flux; oxaloacetate is the one that condenses with the acetyl group, comes back around, and is held at a low, relatively constant level. More importantly, the classic isotope-labelling result is that both CO2 released in the first turn come from the oxaloacetate carbons: the two carbons of the incoming acetyl group do not leave in that same turn, and are released only in later turns.

extra.zh: 回补反应中最主要的一条是丙酮酸羧化酶：丙酮酸 + CO2 + ATP → 草酰乙酸，辅酶是生物素（维生素 B7），并且被乙酰CoA 变构激活——乙酰CoA 堆积就意味着缺草酰乙酸，这是一个自洽的调控回路。其他回补途径包括谷氨酸脱氢酶（→α-酮戊二酸）、转氨反应（天冬氨酸→草酰乙酸）和奇数链脂肪酸的丙酰CoA→琥珀酰CoA。
extra.en: The chief anaplerotic reaction is pyruvate carboxylase: pyruvate + CO2 + ATP → oxaloacetate, with biotin (vitamin B7) as cofactor and allosteric activation by acetyl-CoA — a self-consistent loop, since accumulating acetyl-CoA is exactly the signal that oxaloacetate is short. Other routes in are glutamate dehydrogenase (to α-ketoglutarate), transamination (aspartate to oxaloacetate), and propionyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA from odd-chain fatty acids.

quiz.q_zh: 说 TCA 循环是“两用代谢途径”(amphibolic)，“两用”指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: Calling the TCA cycle amphibolic — which two roles does that name refer to?

options.zh: 既直接产生 ATP，又直接产生 NADPH 供合成
options.en: it yields ATP directly and NADPH directly for biosynthesis

options.zh: 既在线粒体运行，又能在细胞质完整跑一遍
options.en: it runs in the mitochondrion and again fully in the cytosol

options.zh: 既彻底氧化分解底物，又提供生物合成前体
options.en: it oxidizes substrate fully and supplies biosynthetic precursors

options.zh: 既能正向氧化运行，又能整体反向运行合成糖
options.en: it runs forward oxidatively and wholly in reverse to make sugar

quiz.explain_zh: 两用 = 分解（catabolic）与合成前体（anabolic）兼具，柠檬酸、α-酮戊二酸、琥珀酰CoA、草酰乙酸各自流向脂肪酸、氨基酸、血红素、核苷酸的合成。循环只在基质运行；三个不可逆步骤决定它不能整体反向；它产的还原当量是 NADH 而非 NADPH（NADPH 主要来自磷酸戊糖途径与胞质 NADP+ 型异柠檬酸脱氢酶）。
quiz.explain_en: Amphibolic means both catabolic and anabolic: citrate, α-ketoglutarate, succinyl-CoA and oxaloacetate feed fatty acid, amino acid, haem and nucleotide synthesis respectively. The cycle runs only in the matrix; three irreversible steps prevent it running backwards as a whole; and its reducing equivalent is NADH, not NADPH, which comes mainly from the pentose phosphate pathway and cytosolic NADP+-dependent isocitrate dehydrogenase.

quiz.q_zh: TCA 循环之所以称为“循环”，是因为哪个分子绕一圈后被再生？
quiz.q_en: The TCA cycle is a "cycle" because which molecule is regenerated each turn?

options.zh: 乙酰CoA，它像催化剂一样前后完全不变
options.en: acetyl-CoA, unchanged across the turn like a catalyst

options.zh: 柠檬酸，它在每一圈的起点都会重新出现
options.en: citrate, which reappears at the start of every single turn

options.zh: 琥珀酰CoA，它把两个碳原子带回到起点
options.en: succinyl-CoA, which carries two carbons back to the start

options.zh: 草酰乙酸，它与乙酰基缩合后又重新生成
options.en: oxaloacetate, regenerated after condensing with the acetyl

quiz.explain_zh: 草酰乙酸与乙酰基缩合成柠檬酸，绕一圈后由苹果酸脱氢酶再生出来，净计量上不消耗，因此起类似催化剂的作用。乙酰CoA 恰恰是每圈被消耗的底物；柠檬酸和琥珀酰CoA 都只是途中的中间体，并非闭合点。要注意“再生”是净计量意义上的：同位素实验显示第一圈放出的两个 CO2 全部来自草酰乙酸的碳。
quiz.explain_en: Oxaloacetate condenses with the acetyl group to give citrate and is regenerated one turn later by malate dehydrogenase, unconsumed on balance and hence catalytic in effect. Acetyl-CoA is precisely the substrate consumed each turn; citrate and succinyl-CoA are intermediates along the way, not the closing point. Note that regeneration is stoichiometric: isotope experiments show both CO2 of the first turn come from oxaloacetate carbons.

quiz.q_zh: 脂肪酸的碳骨架是通过什么方式进入 TCA 循环的？
quiz.q_en: By what route does the carbon skeleton of a fatty acid enter the TCA cycle?

options.zh: β-氧化每轮切下二碳，直接生成乙酰CoA
options.en: β-oxidation clips two carbons per round to acetyl-CoA

options.zh: 先全部转成甘油，经糖酵解生成丙酮酸后入循环
options.en: converted wholly to glycerol, then via glycolysis to pyruvate

options.zh: 先降解为丙酮酸，再由 PDH 复合体变成乙酰CoA
options.en: degraded to pyruvate, then turned into acetyl-CoA by PDH

options.zh: 直接与草酰乙酸缩合成柠檬酸，跳过乙酰CoA
options.en: condensing with oxaloacetate directly, skipping acetyl-CoA

quiz.explain_zh: 脂酰CoA 进入线粒体后走 β-氧化，每一轮脱氢、水合、再脱氢、硫解，切下一个二碳单位直接生成乙酰CoA，同时产 FADH2 和 NADH，全程不经丙酮酸。甘油只是三酰甘油上的那一小部分碳；任何底物都必须先变成乙酰CoA 才能被柠檬酸合酶接受。
quiz.explain_en: Acyl-CoA entering the mitochondrion runs β-oxidation — dehydrogenation, hydration, dehydrogenation, thiolysis — releasing one two-carbon unit as acetyl-CoA per round along with FADH2 and NADH, and never passing through pyruvate. Glycerol is only the small carbon fraction of a triacylglycerol, and no substrate reaches citrate synthase except as acetyl-CoA.

title_zh: 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体：E1/E2/E3、生成 NADH，与乙酰CoA 的诞生
title_en: The pyruvate dehydrogenase complex: E1/E2/E3, the NADH produced, and the birth of acetyl-CoA

points.zh: 丙酮酸在细胞质生成后，经一系列反应最终连接到丙酮酸脱氢酶上，形成酶与乙酰基团的复合体。
points.en: Pyruvate, once made in the cytosol, ends up attached to pyruvate dehydrogenase, forming a complex of enzyme and acetyl group.

points.zh: 这里的酶叫丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体，是一个很大的酶，分为 E1、E2、E3 不同的亚基。
points.en: The enzyme here is the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, a very large enzyme divided into distinct E1, E2 and E3 subunits.

points.zh: 这个反应会生成一分子 NADH。
points.en: The reaction generates one molecule of NADH.

points.zh: 他解释“脱氢酶”的名字：脱的氢来自巯基 SH 上面，脱掉一个氢之后碳连到了这个硫上。
points.en: He glosses the name "dehydrogenase": the hydrogen removed comes off a thiol SH, after which the carbon becomes bonded to that sulfur.

points.zh: 生成的 acetyl 就是乙酰基团，他强调这是一个甲基加一个碳，共两个碳。
points.en: The acetyl produced is the acetyl group, which he stresses is two carbons: a methyl plus one more.

points.zh: 他说 CoA 就是丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体的简称，所以这个产物叫乙酰CoA。
points.en: He says CoA is the abbreviation of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, hence the product's name acetyl-CoA.

points.zh: 他提示这就是讲维生素那一章时反复听到的乙酰CoA。
points.en: He points out that this is the acetyl-CoA heard about repeatedly in the vitamins chapter.

points.zh: 这个过程实际上可以看作维生素那一章讲过的“二碳单位的转移”。
points.en: The process can be seen as the transfer of a two-carbon unit, a concept from that same vitamins chapter.

points.zh: 反应中有一个由维生素衍生的小分子 TPP 作为辅酶参与，最终生成乙酰CoA，这一步很关键。
points.en: A small vitamin-derived cofactor, TPP, participates as a coenzyme, and the outcome — acetyl-CoA — makes this a crucial step.

extra.zh: 他说“CoA 就是丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体的简称”，这是错的。CoA = 辅酶 A（coenzyme A），是一个小分子酰基载体，由泛酸（维生素 B5）+ β-巯基乙胺 + 3'-磷酸腺苷组成，靠末端的 —SH 以高能硫酯键携带酰基。丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体的缩写是 PDH 或 PDC。乙酰CoA 里的 CoA 指的是这个载体，不是那个酶。
extra.en: "CoA is the abbreviation for the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex" is wrong. CoA is coenzyme A, a small-molecule acyl carrier built from pantothenate (vitamin B5), β-mercaptoethylamine and 3'-phosphoadenosine, carrying acyl groups as a high-energy thioester on its terminal —SH. The complex abbreviates to PDH or PDC. The CoA in acetyl-CoA is that carrier, not the enzyme.

extra.zh: 他说 NADH 的氢“是巯基 SH 上脱的”。实际的电子来路是：E1 以 TPP 对丙酮酸氧化脱羧，生成羟乙基-TPP；羟乙基转到 E2 的硫辛酰胺（lipoamide）二硫键上，同时被氧化成乙酰基——这里才是真正的氧化步骤；乙酰基再交给 CoA-SH 形成硫酯键的乙酰CoA，E2 上留下二氢硫辛酰胺（两个 SH）；最后 E3 以 FAD 为辅基把这两个 SH 重新氧化成二硫键，电子经 FADH2 交给 NAD+ 生成 NADH。所以还原当量来自丙酮酸的 C1–C2，不是来自 CoA 的巯基；CoA 巯基上的质子只是在成键时被释放。
extra.en: He says the hydrogen for NADH "comes off the SH". The real electron route is: E1 uses TPP to oxidatively decarboxylate pyruvate to hydroxyethyl-TPP; the hydroxyethyl group is transferred onto the disulfide of E2's lipoamide and simultaneously oxidized to an acetyl group — that is the oxidation step; the acetyl is passed to CoA-SH as the thioester acetyl-CoA, leaving dihydrolipoamide (two SH) on E2; finally E3, with FAD as prosthetic group, reoxidizes those two SH back to the disulfide and passes the electrons via FADH2 to NAD+, giving NADH. The reducing equivalents therefore come from C1–C2 of pyruvate, not from CoA's thiol, whose proton is merely released on thioester formation.

extra.zh: 记忆口径：三种酶、五种辅因子。E1 丙酮酸脱氢酶用 TPP（B1）；E2 二氢硫辛酰转乙酰酶用硫辛酰胺（共价接在赖氨酸上形成长约 1.4 nm 的摆臂，把中间体在三个活性中心之间摆渡）和 CoA-SH（B5）；E3 二氢硫辛酰胺脱氢酶用 FAD（B2）和 NAD+（B3/烟酸）。总反应 丙酮酸 + CoA-SH + NAD+ → 乙酰CoA + CO2 + NADH + H+，ΔG°′ ≈ −33.4 kJ/mol，实际上不可逆——这正是脂肪酸不能净合成葡萄糖的化学根源。哺乳动物 E2 核心是 60 聚体。
extra.en: The memory line: three enzymes, five cofactors. E1 (pyruvate dehydrogenase) uses TPP (B1); E2 (dihydrolipoyl transacetylase) uses lipoamide — covalently attached to a lysine, giving a swinging arm about 1.4 nm long that ferries intermediates between the three active sites — plus CoA-SH (B5); E3 (dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase) uses FAD (B2) and NAD+ (niacin). Overall: pyruvate + CoA-SH + NAD+ → acetyl-CoA + CO2 + NADH + H+, ΔG°′ ≈ −33.4 kJ/mol, effectively irreversible — the chemical reason fatty acids cannot be converted to glucose net. The mammalian E2 core is a 60-mer.

extra.zh: TPP 为什么能脱羧，讲课里没有讲：噻唑环上 C2 位的质子 pKa 异常低，去质子后形成一个稳定的碳负离子（ylide），进攻丙酮酸的酮基羰基碳；随后带正电的噻唑氮充当“电子陷阱”，稳定脱羧产生的碳负离子，这是 CO2 能被放出的关键。缺乏维生素 B1 时丙酮酸和 α-酮戊二酸在血中堆积、转向乳酸，临床上表现为脚气病和 Wernicke–Korsakoff 综合征——高糖输液前先补 B1 就是这个道理。
extra.en: Why TPP can decarboxylate is not covered in the lecture: the C2 proton of the thiazolium ring has an unusually low pKa, and deprotonation gives a stabilized carbanion (ylide) that attacks the keto carbonyl of pyruvate; the positively charged thiazolium nitrogen then acts as an electron sink, stabilizing the carbanion left by decarboxylation, which is what allows CO2 to leave. Thiamine deficiency lets pyruvate and α-ketoglutarate accumulate in blood and divert to lactate, presenting clinically as beriberi and Wernicke–Korsakoff syndrome — the reason thiamine is given before a glucose infusion.

quiz.q_zh: 乙酰CoA 里的 CoA 指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the name acetyl-CoA, what does CoA stand for?

options.zh: 复合体 E2 亚基上一段特定的肽链
options.en: a particular stretch of peptide on the E2 subunit

options.zh: 由 FAD 与 NAD+ 构成的电子传递辅基
options.en: an electron-carrying prosthetic group of FAD and NAD+

options.zh: 辅酶 A，泛酸衍生的小分子酰基载体
options.en: coenzyme A, a small acyl carrier made from pantothenate

options.zh: 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体的英文缩写形式
options.en: the standard English abbreviation of the PDH complex

quiz.explain_zh: CoA 是辅酶 A，由泛酸（B5）、β-巯基乙胺和 3'-磷酸腺苷组成，用末端 —SH 以硫酯键带酰基。老师说它是复合体的简称，那个缩写其实是 PDH/PDC；它也不是 E2 上的肽段（E2 上共价接着的是硫辛酰胺），更不是 FAD 与 NAD+ 的组合。
quiz.explain_en: CoA is coenzyme A — pantothenate (B5), β-mercaptoethylamine and 3'-phosphoadenosine — carrying acyl groups as a thioester on its terminal —SH. The teacher calls it the complex's abbreviation, but that abbreviation is PDH/PDC; nor is it a peptide of E2 (what is covalently attached there is lipoamide), and certainly not a combination of FAD and NAD+.

quiz.q_zh: PDH 复合体反应生成 NADH，其还原当量直接来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: In the PDH reaction, where do the reducing equivalents for NADH come from?

options.zh: E1 亚基上组氨酸残基的咪唑环
options.en: the imidazole ring of a histidine residue in the E1 subunit

options.zh: CoA 巯基上被脱下来的那一个氢原子
options.en: the hydrogen atom stripped off the thiol group of CoA

options.zh: TPP 噻唑环 C2 位上脱下的那个质子
options.en: the proton removed from C2 of the TPP thiazolium ring

options.zh: E2 上二氢硫辛酰胺的那两个巯基
options.en: the two thiol groups of dihydrolipoamide sitting on E2

quiz.explain_zh: 乙酰基交给 CoA 后，E2 上留下二氢硫辛酰胺，E3 用 FAD 把这两个巯基氧化回二硫键，电子经 FADH2 交给 NAD+。CoA 巯基的质子只是在形成硫酯键时被释放，并未被氧化；TPP 的 C2 质子参与形成 ylide 而非交给 NAD+；组氨酸咪唑环在这里不承担氧化还原任务。
quiz.explain_en: After the acetyl group goes to CoA, E2 is left as dihydrolipoamide, and E3 uses FAD to reoxidize those two thiols to a disulfide, passing the electrons via FADH2 to NAD+. CoA's thiol proton is merely released on thioester formation and is not oxidized; the TPP C2 proton forms the ylide rather than reducing NAD+; and a histidine imidazole plays no redox role here.

quiz.q_zh: PDH 复合体三种酶与五种辅因子的对应关系，哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which pairing of the PDH complex's three enzymes and five cofactors is correct?

options.zh: E1 用硫辛酰胺，E2 用 NAD+ 与 FAD，E3 用 TPP 和 CoA
options.en: E1 lipoamide; E2 NAD+ and FAD; E3 TPP and CoA

options.zh: E1 用 TPP，E2 用硫辛酰胺与 CoA，E3 用 FAD 和 NAD+
options.en: E1 TPP; E2 lipoamide and CoA; E3 FAD and NAD+

options.zh: E1 用 CoA，E2 用 FAD 与 TPP，E3 用硫辛酰胺和 NAD+
options.en: E1 CoA; E2 FAD and TPP; E3 lipoamide and NAD+

options.zh: E1 用 FAD，E2 用 TPP 与 NAD+，E3 用硫辛酰胺和 CoA
options.en: E1 FAD; E2 TPP and NAD+; E3 lipoamide and CoA

quiz.explain_zh: E1 靠 TPP 脱羧生成羟乙基-TPP；E2 的硫辛酰胺摆臂接过并氧化成乙酰基，再交给 CoA-SH 生成硫酯；E3 以 FAD 为辅基把二氢硫辛酰胺氧化回来，电子最终给 NAD+。把 FAD 或 CoA 放到 E1、把 TPP 放到 E2 或 E3，都与“脱羧在先、氧化在中、再氧化辅因子在后”的顺序矛盾。
quiz.explain_en: E1 decarboxylates with TPP to hydroxyethyl-TPP; E2's lipoamide arm takes it over, oxidizes it to an acetyl group and hands it to CoA-SH as a thioester; E3, with FAD as prosthetic group, reoxidizes dihydrolipoamide and passes the electrons to NAD+. Placing FAD or CoA on E1, or TPP on E2 or E3, contradicts the order decarboxylation → oxidation → cofactor reoxidation.

title_zh: 这一步到底在哪里发生：内膜、膜间隙还是基质；丙酮酸转运的方向与乙酰CoA 的去留
title_en: Where this step actually happens — membrane, intermembrane space or matrix — plus transport direction and the fate of acetyl-CoA

points.zh: 讲到反应位置时他先说“在细胞质”，随即改口说“不是在细胞质，在线粒体的内膜和外膜中间”。
points.en: Locating the reaction he first says "in the cytosol", then corrects himself to "not the cytosol — between the inner and outer mitochondrial membranes".

points.zh: 他对着总图复述路线：葡萄糖在细胞质里经 EMP 途径分解成 PA，即 pyruvate 丙酮酸。
points.en: Tracing the overview map he recaps: glucose is broken down in the cytosol by EMP into PA, i.e. pyruvate.

points.zh: 他说这个丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体存在的位置在线粒体的内膜上。
points.en: He says the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex is located on the inner mitochondrial membrane.

points.zh: 丙酮酸是一个非常小的分子，能穿过线粒体的两层膜进入基质。
points.en: Pyruvate is a very small molecule and crosses both mitochondrial membranes into the matrix.

points.zh: 由于酶就在内膜上，他说丙酮酸一进入线粒体就立刻发生这个反应，马上变成乙酰CoA 的形式。
points.en: Because the enzyme sits on the inner membrane, he says the reaction happens the instant pyruvate arrives, immediately converting it to acetyl-CoA.

points.zh: 学生追问是“在内膜里边”还是“在内膜上”，他答：只能说在内膜上，不是在膜的里边，膜里边是磷脂双分子层。
points.en: The student asks whether it is inside the inner membrane or on it; he answers that one can only say on it, not inside, since inside is the lipid bilayer.

points.zh: 他的理由是：这一步只是把乙酰基加到酶上，而酶在内膜上，所以始终把这个反应称为在内膜上发生。
points.en: His reasoning: the step merely puts the acetyl group onto the enzyme, and the enzyme is on the inner membrane, so he consistently calls the reaction membrane-located.

points.zh: 他指出丙酮酸移位酶不只是单向的，也可以把丙酮酸从线粒体里运出去，并说很多不是很关键的反应在生物体内都是双向的。
points.en: He notes the pyruvate translocase is not one-way and can also export pyruvate, adding that many non-critical reactions in the body are bidirectional.

points.zh: 他说形成乙酰CoA 的好处是把乙酰基牢牢绑定在线粒体内膜上，不会再到处乱跑，以供后续 TCA 使用；但这一步一般不算在 TCA 循环之内，只是个前体反应。
points.en: He says forming acetyl-CoA has the advantage of pinning the acetyl group firmly to the inner membrane so it cannot wander off, ready for the cycle — while noting this step is normally not counted as part of the cycle, only as a precursor reaction.

extra.zh: 本段他把 PDH 复合体先后放在“膜间隙”和“内膜上”，两处都不对。真核细胞里丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体是线粒体基质中的可溶性多酶复合体，最多与内膜的基质面疏松结合，不是内膜整合蛋白；底物丙酮酸和产物乙酰CoA、NADH、CO2 全都在基质里，膜间隙里根本没有 PDH（原核则在胞质）。他在 17:26 前后被学生追问后把“内膜里边”改成“内膜上”，但全程没有说出“基质”这个词。要点：整条通路里真正嵌进线粒体内膜的只有琥珀酸脱氢酶（复合体 II），这也正是它能把 TCA 循环直接接进呼吸链的原因。
extra.en: In this stretch he puts the PDH complex first in the intermembrane space and then on the inner membrane; both are wrong. In eukaryotes the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex is a soluble multienzyme complex of the mitochondrial matrix, at most loosely associated with the matrix face of the inner membrane and never an integral membrane protein; its substrate pyruvate and its products acetyl-CoA, NADH and CO2 are all in the matrix, and there is no PDH in the intermembrane space at all (in prokaryotes it is cytosolic). Pressed by the student around 17:26 he changes "inside the inner membrane" to "on the inner membrane", but never says "matrix". The key point: of this whole pathway only succinate dehydrogenase (Complex II) is truly integral to the inner membrane, which is exactly why it wires the TCA cycle straight into the respiratory chain.

extra.zh: 他说乙酰CoA 生成后“被绑定在了线粒体内膜上，不会再到处乱跑”。乙酰CoA 并没有被锚定在膜上——它是基质里自由扩散的可溶代谢物。它出不去的真正原因是线粒体内膜对乙酰CoA 不通透：要把乙酰单位送到胞质做脂肪酸或胆固醇合成，必须先由柠檬酸合酶缩合成柠檬酸，经三羧酸转运体出膜，再由胞质的 ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶劈开重新生成乙酰CoA，这就是柠檬酸穿梭。
extra.en: He says that once acetyl-CoA forms it is "bound to the inner membrane and can no longer wander". Acetyl-CoA is not anchored to any membrane — it is a freely diffusing soluble metabolite of the matrix. What keeps it in is that the inner membrane is impermeable to it: to deliver acetyl units to the cytosol for fatty acid or cholesterol synthesis, citrate synthase must first condense it into citrate, which leaves through the tricarboxylate transporter and is cleaved back to acetyl-CoA by cytosolic ATP-citrate lyase. That is the citrate shuttle.

extra.zh: “不是很关键的反应在生物体内都是双向的”不是一条可用的规则。转运和反应的方向由热力学决定：底物与产物的实际浓度、以及偶联的驱动力。丙酮酸载体 MPC 是质子同向共转运体，由跨内膜的质子驱动力推动，正常呼吸的线粒体里净流向是进入基质；而 PDH 催化的这一步 ΔG°′ ≈ −33 kJ/mol 且释放 CO2，在体内根本不可逆——所以丙酮酸能进出，乙酰CoA 却回不去丙酮酸。
extra.en: "Non-critical reactions are all bidirectional" is not a usable rule. Direction, for transport as for reaction, is set by thermodynamics: the actual concentrations of substrate and product plus whatever driving force is coupled in. MPC is a proton symporter driven by the proton-motive force across the inner membrane, so net flux in a respiring mitochondrion is inward; whereas the PDH step itself, at ΔG°′ ≈ −33 kJ/mol and releasing CO2, is irreversible in vivo — pyruvate can move both ways, but acetyl-CoA can never go back to pyruvate.

extra.zh: 他说“这一步不算 TCA 循环之内，只是前体”是对的，而这个位置恰恰是整条通路最重要的开关：PDH 激酶（PDK）把 E1α 上的丝氨酸磷酸化使复合体失活，当 NADH/NAD+、乙酰CoA/CoA、ATP/ADP 比值高时 PDK 被激活；PDH 磷酸酶（PDP）在 Ca2+ 升高（肌肉收缩）和胰岛素作用下去磷酸化，重新激活复合体。因为这一步不可逆，机体一旦把糖的碳交出去就再也变不回葡萄糖，所以这个开关决定“烧糖还是省糖”。
extra.en: His remark that the step is a precursor rather than part of the cycle is right, and this position is precisely the pathway's most important switch: PDH kinase (PDK) phosphorylates serines on E1α to inactivate the complex, and is itself activated when the NADH/NAD+, acetyl-CoA/CoA and ATP/ADP ratios are high; PDH phosphatase (PDP) dephosphorylates and reactivates it in response to rising Ca2+ (contracting muscle) and insulin. Because the step is irreversible, carbon committed here can never return to glucose, so this switch decides whether sugar is burned or spared.

quiz.q_zh: 真核细胞里，丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体究竟位于什么部位？
quiz.q_en: In a eukaryotic cell, where is the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex located?

options.zh: 线粒体膜间隙中，附着于外膜的内侧面
options.en: in the intermembrane space, on the inner face of the outer membrane

options.zh: 细胞质基质中，与游离的核糖体相结合
options.en: in the cytosol proper, in association with free ribosomes

options.zh: 线粒体内膜中，是跨膜的整合膜蛋白
options.en: within the inner membrane, as an integral transmembrane protein

options.zh: 线粒体基质中，是可溶性的多酶复合体
options.en: in the mitochondrial matrix, as a soluble multienzyme complex

quiz.explain_zh: PDH 复合体是基质里的可溶复合体，至多与内膜的基质面疏松结合，底物与产物也都在基质。膜间隙里没有 PDH；真正嵌进内膜的 TCA 酶只有琥珀酸脱氢酶（复合体 II）；胞质定位只适用于原核生物，真核细胞的丙酮酸必须先被运进基质。
quiz.explain_en: The PDH complex is soluble in the matrix, at most loosely associated with the matrix face of the inner membrane, and its substrate and products are in the matrix too. There is no PDH in the intermembrane space; the only TCA enzyme integral to the inner membrane is succinate dehydrogenase (Complex II); and cytosolic location applies to prokaryotes, since in eukaryotes pyruvate must be imported first.

quiz.q_zh: 乙酰CoA 之所以“出不了线粒体”，真正的原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What actually keeps acetyl-CoA from leaving the mitochondrion?

options.zh: 内膜对它不通透，需先缩合成柠檬酸再出去
options.en: the inner membrane is impermeable; it must exit as citrate

options.zh: 它被硫酯键共价锚定在内膜的磷脂头部上
options.en: it is covalently anchored to inner-membrane phospholipid heads

options.zh: 它一旦生成就立刻被基质的硫酯酶水解掉
options.en: it is hydrolysed the moment it forms by a matrix thioesterase

options.zh: 膜间隙的低 pH 让它迅速质子化而失去活性
options.en: the low pH of the intermembrane space protonates it and stops it

quiz.explain_zh: 乙酰CoA 是基质中自由扩散的可溶代谢物，被困住是因为内膜没有它的载体；要送到胞质必须先缩合成柠檬酸，经三羧酸转运体出去，再由 ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶劈开，这就是柠檬酸穿梭。它并没有与膜共价结合；基质硫酯酶若把它统统水解，循环就无法进行；膜间隙的 pH 反而略低于基质，与它是否留在基质无关。
quiz.explain_en: Acetyl-CoA is a freely diffusing soluble matrix metabolite; what traps it is the absence of a carrier for it in the inner membrane. Reaching the cytosol requires condensation to citrate, export through the tricarboxylate transporter, and cleavage by ATP-citrate lyase — the citrate shuttle. It is not covalently bound to the membrane; a matrix thioesterase hydrolysing all of it would abolish the cycle; and the intermembrane space, though slightly more acidic than the matrix, has nothing to do with its retention.

quiz.q_zh: 关于线粒体丙酮酸载体 MPC 的转运方向，正确的说法是？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the transport direction of the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier is correct?

options.zh: 不关键的反应一律双向，方向完全是随机的
options.en: non-critical reactions are all bidirectional and random in direction

options.zh: 由 ATP 水解直接驱动，只能单向送入基质
options.en: driven straight by ATP hydrolysis, inward only, never outward

options.zh: 与钠离子反向转运，净流向是流出到膜间隙
options.en: antiport with sodium, with net flux out to the intermembrane space

options.zh: 与质子同向共转运，正常呼吸时净流向基质
options.en: symport with protons; net flux inward in a respiring mitochondrion

quiz.explain_zh: MPC 把丙酮酸与 H+ 一起带过内膜，由质子驱动力推动，正常呼吸的线粒体里净流向进入基质，但并非“只能单向”。它不直接水解 ATP，也不是 Na+ 反向转运体；“不关键就双向”更不是规则，方向由热力学（浓度梯度与偶联的驱动力）决定。
quiz.explain_en: MPC carries pyruvate together with H+ across the inner membrane, driven by the proton-motive force, giving net inward flux in a respiring mitochondrion — though not strictly one-way. It does not hydrolyse ATP directly, nor is it a Na+ antiporter; and "non-critical means bidirectional" is no rule at all, since direction is set by thermodynamics — concentration gradients and the coupled driving force.

title_zh: 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体收尾：TPP 转移二碳单位，以及 TCA 与 EMP 学习重点的不同
title_en: Finishing the PDH complex: TPP transfers the two-carbon unit, and why TCA is studied differently from glycolysis

points.zh: 丙酮酸经过这个复合体之后就变成了乙酰基（acetyl），也就是图上标红的那一部分。
points.en: After passing through the complex, pyruvate becomes the acetyl group — the part drawn in red on the slide.

points.zh: 复合体里带的 TPP 就是讲维生素那一章提过的小分子辅酶，这里再遇到一次。
points.en: The TPP carried by the complex is the small coenzyme already met in the vitamin chapter; it reappears here.

points.zh: TPP 承担的是「转移二碳单位」的功能，而所谓二碳单位说的就是乙酰基。
points.en: TPP performs the transfer of a two-carbon unit, and that two-carbon unit is precisely the acetyl group.

points.zh: 丙酮酸的羧酸基团则以二氧化碳的形式脱掉，直接就离开了反应。
points.en: The carboxyl group of pyruvate leaves as CO2 — it is simply lost from the reaction.

points.zh: 所以丙酮酸最终是以乙酰CoA 的形式发挥作用，之后才开始进入三羧酸循环。
points.en: Pyruvate therefore does its work in the form of acetyl-CoA, and only then does the TCA cycle begin.

points.zh: 这一步一般不算作 TCA 循环内部的步骤：它是前体反应，它的产物才是循环的起始物。
points.en: This step is not usually counted as part of the cycle proper: it is a precursor reaction whose product is the cycle's starting material.

points.zh: 学 EMP 途径时强调的是每一步酶怎么被 activate、被 deactivate，学生举了加第二个磷酸那一步的调控为例。
points.en: In glycolysis the emphasis was on how each enzyme is activated or deactivated; a student cited the regulation at the second phosphorylation.

points.zh: 学 TCA 循环时强调的是能量：看某一步产生了什么类型的能量载体，而不是它怎么被抑制、被合成。
points.en: In the TCA cycle the emphasis is energy: what kind of energy carrier each step yields, rather than how it is inhibited or induced.

extra.zh: 定位问题（本段紧邻的 18:32 前后他说，生成乙酰CoA 就相当于「被牢牢绑定在线粒体内膜上」）。真核细胞里丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体是线粒体基质中的可溶性多酶复合体，只是常与内膜的基质面疏松结合，并不是内膜整合蛋白；底物、产物（乙酰CoA、NADH、CO2）也都在基质里。乙酰CoA 同样是基质中的可溶代谢物，它「跑不掉」的真正原因是内膜对它不通透——乙酰单位要出基质必须先缩合成柠檬酸，经三羧酸转运体 + 胞质 ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶才能到胞质。整条通路里唯一嵌在内膜上的酶是琥珀酸脱氢酶（复合体 II）。
extra.en: Localisation. Just before this stretch (around 18:32) he says forming acetyl-CoA amounts to being 'anchored onto the inner membrane'. In eukaryotes the PDH complex is a soluble multienzyme assembly in the mitochondrial matrix — loosely associated with the matrix face of the inner membrane, not integral to it — and its substrates and products (acetyl-CoA, NADH, CO2) are all in the matrix. Acetyl-CoA is likewise a soluble matrix metabolite; it cannot leave because the inner membrane is impermeable to it, so acetyl units exit only after condensation to citrate, via the tricarboxylate transporter plus cytosolic ATP-citrate lyase. Of the whole pathway only succinate dehydrogenase (Complex II) is an integral inner-membrane enzyme.

extra.zh: TPP 到底怎么「转移二碳单位」：噻唑环 C2 上的质子 pKa 异常低，去质子后生成碳负离子（叶立德），亲核进攻丙酮酸的 C2 酮羰基；脱羧时产生的碳负离子由带正电的噻唑环氮原子作为电子阱稳定下来，得到羟乙基-TPP。缺乏维生素 B1（硫胺素）时这一步做不动，丙酮酸和乳酸在血中堆积，这就是脚气病和 Wernicke-Korsakoff 综合征的生化基础。
extra.en: How TPP actually transfers the two-carbon unit: the C2 proton of the thiazolium ring has an unusually low pKa, so deprotonation gives a carbanion (ylide) that attacks the C2 keto carbonyl of pyruvate; the carbanion generated on decarboxylation is stabilised by the positively charged ring nitrogen acting as an electron sink, giving hydroxyethyl-TPP. Without thiamine (vitamin B1) this step stalls and pyruvate and lactate accumulate in blood — the biochemical basis of beriberi and Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome.

extra.zh: 复合体用五种辅因子，对应四种维生素：TPP（B1）、硫辛酰胺、CoA-SH（泛酸，B5）、FAD（核黄素，B2）、NAD+（烟酰胺，B3）。总反应 丙酮酸 + CoA-SH + NAD+ → 乙酰CoA + CO2 + NADH + H+ 的 ΔG°′ ≈ −33.5 kJ/mol，生理条件下完全不可逆。这条不可逆正是「脂肪酸不能净生成葡萄糖」的根源：碳一旦以乙酰CoA 的形式进入，就回不到丙酮酸。
extra.en: The complex uses five cofactors derived from four vitamins: TPP (B1), lipoamide, CoA-SH (pantothenate, B5), FAD (riboflavin, B2) and NAD+ (niacin, B3). The overall reaction pyruvate + CoA-SH + NAD+ → acetyl-CoA + CO2 + NADH + H+ has ΔG°′ ≈ −33.5 kJ/mol and is irreversible under physiological conditions. That irreversibility is exactly why fatty acids cannot give a net yield of glucose: once carbon enters as acetyl-CoA there is no route back to pyruvate.

extra.zh: 乙酰CoA 里的 CoA 是辅酶 A（coenzyme A），一个小分子酰基载体：泛酸 + β-巯基乙胺 + 3'-磷酸腺苷，靠末端 —SH 以硫酯键挂住酰基。它不是酶，也不是「丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体」的缩写——复合体的缩写是 PDH 或 PDC。同一个 CoA 在脂肪酸氧化、酮体代谢里搬运的也是酰基，只是酰基不同。
extra.en: The CoA of acetyl-CoA is coenzyme A, a small-molecule acyl carrier: pantothenate + beta-mercaptoethylamine + 3'-phosphoadenosine, holding the acyl group as a thioester on its terminal —SH. It is not an enzyme, and it is not an abbreviation for the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex — that is PDH or PDC. The same CoA carries acyl groups in fatty acid oxidation and ketone body metabolism; only the acyl group differs.

quiz.q_zh: 真核细胞中，丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体位于哪个部位？
quiz.q_en: In a eukaryotic cell, where does the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex sit?

options.zh: 线粒体内膜与外膜之间的膜间隙
options.en: The intermembrane space between both membranes

options.zh: 线粒体基质中的可溶性多酶复合体
options.en: A soluble multienzyme complex in the matrix

options.zh: 线粒体外膜上的孔蛋白通道结构
options.en: A porin-lined channel in the outer membrane

options.zh: 线粒体内膜中的整合膜蛋白复合体
options.en: An integral protein complex of the inner membrane

quiz.explain_zh: 复合体是基质里的可溶性装配体，只是常与内膜的基质面疏松结合，底物和产物都在基质中。说它嵌在内膜里不对——整条通路里只有琥珀酸脱氢酶是内膜整合蛋白；膜间隙里没有 PDH；外膜孔蛋白只是让小分子自由通透的通道，与催化无关。
quiz.explain_en: The complex is a soluble matrix assembly, at most loosely bound to the matrix face of the inner membrane, and its substrates and products are all in the matrix. It is not embedded in the inner membrane — only succinate dehydrogenase is integral there; there is no PDH in the intermembrane space; and outer-membrane porins are permeability channels, not catalytic sites.

quiz.q_zh: TPP 在丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体 E1 上完成的化学步骤是？
quiz.q_en: What chemical step does TPP carry out on E1 of the PDH complex?

options.zh: 噻唑环碳负离子进攻酮基并稳定脱羧中间体
options.en: A ring carbanion attacks the keto group and stabilises the carbanion

options.zh: 铁硫簇把两个电子逐个传递给辅酶Q分子
options.en: An iron-sulfur cluster passes two electrons on to ubiquinone

options.zh: 硫酯键把乙酰基直接交给辅酶A的巯基
options.en: A thioester bond hands the acetyl group to the thiol of CoA

options.zh: 血红素铁结合氧分子并完成四电子还原
options.en: A heme iron binds O2 and completes a four-electron reduction

quiz.explain_zh: 噻唑环 C2 去质子生成的叶立德亲核进攻丙酮酸的酮羰基，脱羧后产生的碳负离子由环上带正电的氮稳定，得到羟乙基-TPP。铁硫簇传电子给辅酶Q 是复合体 I／II 的事；硫酯键交接乙酰基发生在 E2 的硫辛酰胺之后，不是 TPP 干的；血红素铁的四电子还氧还原是细胞色素c 氧化酶的功能。
quiz.explain_en: Deprotonation at C2 of the thiazolium ring gives an ylide that attacks the keto carbonyl of pyruvate; the carbanion left after decarboxylation is stabilised by the positively charged ring nitrogen, giving hydroxyethyl-TPP. Passing electrons to ubiquinone via iron-sulfur clusters belongs to Complexes I and II; the thioester handover of the acetyl group happens after the lipoamide of E2, not at TPP; four-electron reduction of O2 at a heme iron is the job of cytochrome c oxidase.

quiz.q_zh: 老师为什么说丙酮酸脱氢酶这一步不属于 TCA 循环内部？
quiz.q_en: Why does he say the pyruvate dehydrogenase step is not inside the TCA cycle?

options.zh: 它是前体反应，产物才是循环的起始物
options.en: It is a precursor step whose product starts the cycle

options.zh: 它在细胞质中进行，循环各步都在基质里
options.en: It runs in the cytosol while the cycle runs in the matrix

options.zh: 它不产生还原当量，只做碳骨架的修剪
options.en: It yields no reducing equivalents, only carbon trimming

options.zh: 它由单个酶催化，循环各步都由复合体催化
options.en: One enzyme catalyses it while the cycle uses complexes

quiz.explain_zh: 他讲得很清楚：这一步只是前体，它的产物乙酰CoA 才是循环的起始物，所以不列进循环。它并不在细胞质里（真核细胞中就在基质）；它产生一分子 NADH，不是「不产生还原当量」；催化它的本身就是多酶复合体，而循环里绝大多数步骤由单个酶完成。
quiz.explain_en: His reason is explicit: the step is a precursor, and its product acetyl-CoA is what the cycle starts from, so it is not listed as a cycle step. It does not run in the cytosol (in eukaryotes it is in the matrix); it does produce one NADH; and it is itself a multienzyme complex, whereas most cycle steps are catalysed by single enzymes.

title_zh: 可逆性、能量记账，与第一步：乙酰CoA 把乙酰基交给草酰乙酸
title_en: Reversibility, energy bookkeeping, and step one: acetyl-CoA hands its acetyl group to oxaloacetate

points.zh: 他说 TCA 循环除第一步以外每一步都是可逆的，所以没有很大必要逐步强调调控。
points.en: He states that apart from the first step every step of the TCA cycle is reversible, so there is little need to stress regulation step by step.

points.zh: 对照 EMP 途径：那里一共有三个不可逆步骤，不可逆步骤的速率调控就很关键。
points.en: By contrast glycolysis has three irreversible steps, and rate control at irreversible steps matters a great deal there.

points.zh: TCA 要弄清楚的是每一步的能量账：消耗还是产生水、是否产生 NADH、是否产生 ATP 或 GDP。
points.en: What matters in the TCA cycle is the energy ledger of each step: water consumed or produced, whether NADH is made, whether ATP or GDP appears.

points.zh: 两章重点不同，但讲法一样，还是一个反应一个反应地看。
points.en: The two chapters differ in emphasis but not in method: the reactions are still worked through one at a time.

points.zh: 他用 ChemDraw 把所有分子重画成「三条横线」的骨架式，因为整个循环都是这种线式在反复变化。
points.en: He redraws every molecule in ChemDraw as a three-line skeleton, because the whole cycle is these line structures shifting back and forth.

points.zh: 学生说记有环的结构几乎不出错，一换成这种竖线／三杠线的写法就开始混乱，所以值得按统一形式记。
points.en: A student notes that ring structures are easy to remember but these line drawings get confusing, which is why one consistent format helps.

points.zh: TCA 循环的第一步一定是乙酰CoA 把自己的乙酰基转移出去。
points.en: The first step of the cycle is always acetyl-CoA transferring its acetyl group away.

points.zh: 他给的理由是：乙酰CoA 是乙酰基连在「酶」上，酶被占着就相当于被 deactivate，生物体希望蛋白被频繁地重复利用。
points.en: His stated reason: acetyl-CoA is an acetyl group attached to an 'enzyme', an occupied enzyme counts as deactivated, and the organism wants its proteins used over and over.

points.zh: 乙酰基接到草酰乙酸上；他当场查草酰乙酸的英文，最后摸索出 Oxaloacetate。
points.en: The acetyl group is handed to oxaloacetate; he looks the English name up live and arrives at 'oxaloacetate'.

extra.zh: 他说「TCA 循环除第一步外每一步都可逆」。实际上循环里有三个基本不可逆的步骤，ΔG°′ 都是较大的负值：柠檬酸合酶、异柠檬酸脱氢酶、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体，而且这三个正好都是调控位点——异柠檬酸脱氢酶被 ADP 和 Ca2+ 激活、被 ATP 和 NADH 抑制，是哺乳动物公认的主要限速点；α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体被自己的产物琥珀酰CoA 和 NADH 抑制、被 Ca2+ 激活。其余几步确实接近平衡。他在本节课里没有更正这句话。
extra.en: He says that apart from the first step every step of the cycle is reversible. In fact three steps are essentially irreversible, all with large negative ΔG°′: citrate synthase, isocitrate dehydrogenase and the alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex — and all three are control points. Isocitrate dehydrogenase, activated by ADP and Ca2+ and inhibited by ATP and NADH, is the accepted main flux-controlling step in mammals; the alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex is product-inhibited by succinyl-CoA and NADH and activated by Ca2+. The remaining steps are indeed close to equilibrium. He does not correct this during the lecture.

extra.zh: 一圈 TCA 的净收支，是他要求的「能量账」的标准答案：乙酰CoA + 3 NAD+ + FAD + GDP + Pi + 2 H2O → 2 CO2 + 3 NADH + FADH2 + GTP + CoA-SH。也就是每圈 3 NADH、1 FADH2、1 GTP、2 CO2，并且要注意水是被消耗的（柠檬酰CoA 水解一分子、延胡索酸水合一分子），不是产生的。按 NADH ≈ 2.5、FADH2 ≈ 1.5 折算，一圈约相当于 10 个 ATP。
extra.en: The net ledger for one turn — the standard answer to the bookkeeping he asks for: acetyl-CoA + 3 NAD+ + FAD + GDP + Pi + 2 H2O → 2 CO2 + 3 NADH + FADH2 + GTP + CoA-SH. So 3 NADH, 1 FADH2, 1 GTP and 2 CO2 per turn, and note that water is consumed (one at the hydrolysis of citryl-CoA, one at the hydration of fumarate), not produced. Counting NADH as about 2.5 and FADH2 as about 1.5, one turn is worth roughly 10 ATP.

extra.zh: 他把 CoA 说成「酶」，说乙酰基占着它就相当于酶被 deactivate。CoA 是辅酶 A，一个小分子酰基载体，没有催化活性，也就谈不上失活（也可能是转写把「辅酶」的「辅」字丢了，但即便读作辅酶，「被占着失活」的说法仍不成立）。第一步能自发进行的真正原因是乙酰基以硫酯键接在 CoA 的巯基上，这个键是高能键，水解 ΔG°′ ≈ −31 kJ/mol，正是它把缩合反应拉到底，而不是「要把酶腾出来重复利用」。
extra.en: He calls CoA an enzyme and says an acetyl group occupying it deactivates the enzyme. CoA is coenzyme A, a small-molecule acyl carrier with no catalytic activity, so it cannot be deactivated (the transcript may have dropped a syllable from 'coenzyme', but even read that way the 'occupied and therefore inactive' framing does not hold). The real reason the first step is spontaneous is that the acetyl group sits on CoA's thiol as a thioester, a high-energy bond whose hydrolysis is about −31 kJ/mol, and that is what drives the condensation to completion — not any need to free up an enzyme for reuse.

extra.zh: 柠檬酸合酶走的是有序机制：先结合草酰乙酸，诱导契合让酶发生大幅构象闭合，乙酰CoA 的结合位点这时才成形。这个顺序不是细节——它保证在没有草酰乙酸的时候乙酰CoA 不会被白白结合和水解掉。缩合产物先是柠檬酰CoA（citryl-CoA），还留在活性中心，随后硫酯键才被水解成柠檬酸 + CoA-SH，能量在水解那一刻才释放出来把反应推到不可逆。
extra.en: Citrate synthase uses an ordered mechanism: oxaloacetate binds first, and induced fit drives a large domain closure that only then creates the acetyl-CoA site. The order is not a detail — it ensures acetyl-CoA is not bound and wastefully hydrolysed when no oxaloacetate is present. The condensation product is first citryl-CoA, still held in the active site; only then is the thioester hydrolysed to citrate plus CoA-SH, and it is that hydrolysis which releases the energy making the step irreversible.

quiz.q_zh: 哺乳动物 TCA 循环中公认的主要限速点是哪个酶？
quiz.q_en: Which enzyme is the accepted main flux-controlling step of the mammalian TCA cycle?

options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶，因为它是循环唯一不可逆的一步
options.en: Citrate synthase, the cycle's only irreversible reaction

options.zh: 异柠檬酸脱氢酶，被 ADP 激活而被 ATP 抑制
options.en: Isocitrate dehydrogenase, ADP-activated and ATP-inhibited

options.zh: 延胡索酸酶，因为它决定苹果酸的生成速度
options.en: Fumarase, which sets the rate at which malate appears

options.zh: 琥珀酸脱氢酶，因为它同时属于电子传递链
options.en: Succinate dehydrogenase, shared with the electron chain

quiz.explain_zh: 异柠檬酸脱氢酶被 ADP 和 Ca2+ 激活、被 ATP 和 NADH 抑制，是循环通量的主要控制点。柠檬酸合酶确实不可逆，但循环里不可逆的步骤不止它一个，把它讲成「唯一」是过度简化；延胡索酸酶和琥珀酸脱氢酶的反应都接近平衡，不承担限速功能。
quiz.explain_en: Isocitrate dehydrogenase, activated by ADP and Ca2+ and inhibited by ATP and NADH, is the principal controller of flux. Citrate synthase is indeed irreversible, but it is not the only irreversible step, so calling it the sole one oversimplifies; fumarase and succinate dehydrogenase both operate near equilibrium and do not set the rate.

quiz.q_zh: 乙酰CoA 里的 CoA 究竟是什么？
quiz.q_en: What exactly is the CoA in acetyl-CoA?

options.zh: 线粒体内膜上转运乙酰基的载体蛋白
options.en: A carrier protein of the inner mitochondrial membrane

options.zh: 由泛酸构成、以末端巯基携带酰基的辅酶
options.en: A pantothenate-based coenzyme carrying acyl on a thiol

options.zh: 一种以血红素为辅基的电子传递蛋白
options.en: An electron-transfer protein built around a heme

options.zh: 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体的英文缩写形式
options.en: The English abbreviation of the PDH complex

quiz.explain_zh: 辅酶 A 由泛酸、β-巯基乙胺和 3'-磷酸腺苷组成，靠末端 —SH 以硫酯键挂住酰基。它不含血红素，也不传电子；丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体的缩写是 PDH／PDC，不是 CoA；它是可溶的小分子，不是内膜上的载体蛋白，乙酰单位真要出基质得先变成柠檬酸。
quiz.explain_en: Coenzyme A is built from pantothenate, beta-mercaptoethylamine and 3'-phosphoadenosine, and holds acyl groups as a thioester on its terminal —SH. It contains no heme and transfers no electrons; the PDH complex is abbreviated PDH or PDC, not CoA; and it is a small soluble molecule rather than a membrane carrier — acetyl units leave the matrix only as citrate.

quiz.q_zh: 柠檬酸合酶的缩合反应能被拉到不可逆，推动力来自？
quiz.q_en: What drives the citrate synthase condensation to irreversibility?

options.zh: 一分子 ATP 水解为反应提供磷酸基团
options.en: One ATP is hydrolysed to donate a phosphate group

options.zh: 草酰乙酸羰基上自带的高能磷酸键断裂
options.en: A high-energy phosphate bond on oxaloacetate breaks

options.zh: NADH 被氧化时释放出来的还原当量能
options.en: Energy released as NADH is oxidised in this step

options.zh: 柠檬酰CoA 的硫酯键在活性中心被水解
options.en: Hydrolysis of the citryl-CoA thioester in the site

quiz.explain_zh: 缩合先生成还留在活性中心的柠檬酰CoA，随后硫酯键被水解（ΔG°′ ≈ −31 kJ/mol），正是这一步把总反应拉成不可逆。这个酶不消耗 NTP，所以中文叫合酶而不是合成酶；草酰乙酸上根本没有磷酸基团；这一步既不产生也不消耗 NADH。
quiz.explain_en: Condensation first gives citryl-CoA, still bound in the active site; hydrolysis of that thioester (ΔG°′ about −31 kJ/mol) is what makes the overall reaction irreversible. The enzyme consumes no NTP, which is why it is a synthase rather than a synthetase; oxaloacetate carries no phosphate group at all; and this step neither makes nor uses NADH.

title_zh: 柠檬酸合酶：循环怎么闭合、名字怎么来，以及限速与产物抑制
title_en: Citrate synthase: how the cycle closes, where the name comes from, and rate limitation by product inhibition

points.zh: 第八步（最后一步）的产物正是第一步的底物，所以这条途径才叫做「循环」。
points.en: The product of the eighth and last step is the substrate of the first, which is precisely why the pathway is a cycle.

points.zh: 他当场核对英文：citrate 是柠檬酸，草酸是 oxalic acid，草酰乙酸是 oxaloacetate。
points.en: He checks the English on the spot: citrate is the citric acid anion, oxalic acid is the two-carbon diacid, and oxaloacetate is the cycle intermediate.

points.zh: 他拆名字解释：acetate 是乙酸，对应结构的下半部分，上面那部分对应草酰。
points.en: He parses the name: acetate is the acetic acid part corresponding to the lower half of the structure, with the oxalo- part above.

points.zh: 这一步的酶写作 citrate synthase（他读成 citrate synthesis），中文柠檬酸合酶。
points.en: The enzyme here is citrate synthase (he reads it as 'citrate synthesis'), in Chinese 柠檬酸合酶.

points.zh: 他提到中文里「合酶」和「合成酶」有那么一点区别，但认为英文里没有这个区别，建议统一叫合成酶。
points.en: He notes that Chinese distinguishes 合酶 from 合成酶 slightly, judges that English does not, and proposes using 合成酶 throughout.

points.zh: 他说这一步是整个 TCA 循环唯一不可逆的一步，因此也是唯一的限速步骤。
points.en: He says this is the only irreversible step in the whole cycle and therefore its only rate-limiting step.

points.zh: 这一步的速度决定了循环起始物的浓度，也就决定了整个 TCA 循环的速度。
points.en: The rate of this step sets the concentration of the cycle's starting material and hence the rate of the whole cycle.

points.zh: 抑制它的东西很多，主要是 ATP、NADH 和琥珀酰CoA；他把琥珀酰CoA 说成「它再下一步的产物」。
points.en: Many things inhibit it, chiefly ATP, NADH and succinyl-CoA; he describes succinyl-CoA as the product of the step just after.

points.zh: 总规律和 EMP 途径的调控一模一样：细胞内能量越多，TCA 和 EMP 的进程就被压得越低。
points.en: The principle is the same as in glycolysis: the more energy the cell already has, the more both pathways are throttled back.

extra.zh: 酶名被读成 citrate synthesis。英文里 synthesis 是「合成」这件事，从来不做酶名；酶是 citrate synthase。而且英文恰恰是区分的：synthase 不偶联 NTP 的水解，synthetase（属于连接酶 ligase）要消耗 ATP 或 GTP，中文的「合酶／合成酶」正是照这个区分翻译的。所以他「统一叫合成酶」的建议方向反了——柠檬酸合酶不用 NTP，能量来自硫酯键，中文标准名就是柠檬酸合酶。对照：琥珀酰CoA 合成酶（succinyl-CoA synthetase）与 GTP／ATP 偶联，那个才叫合成酶。
extra.en: The enzyme is read as 'citrate synthesis'. In English, synthesis names the process and is never an enzyme name; the enzyme is citrate synthase. English does draw the distinction: a synthase does not couple NTP hydrolysis, while a synthetase (a ligase) consumes ATP or GTP — and the Chinese pair 合酶 / 合成酶 was coined to mirror exactly that. So the proposal to standardise on 合成酶 runs the wrong way: citrate synthase uses no NTP and takes its energy from a thioester, so the standard Chinese name is 柠檬酸合酶. Compare succinyl-CoA synthetase, which is coupled to GTP/ATP and genuinely is a 合成酶.

extra.zh: 抑制物本身列对了（ATP、NADH、琥珀酰CoA），但琥珀酰CoA 不是柠檬酸的「再下一步」产物：柠檬酸 → 异柠檬酸 → α-酮戊二酸 → 琥珀酰CoA，中间隔了三步、三个酶。属于位置报错，不影响抑制关系——琥珀酰CoA 与乙酰CoA 结构相似，是竞争性地和乙酰CoA 争柠檬酸合酶的结合位点。
extra.en: The inhibitors themselves are right (ATP, NADH, succinyl-CoA), but succinyl-CoA is not the product of the step immediately after citrate: citrate → isocitrate → alpha-ketoglutarate → succinyl-CoA is three steps and three enzymes away. The misplacement does not affect the regulation itself — succinyl-CoA resembles acetyl-CoA structurally and competes with it for the citrate synthase site.

extra.zh: 柠檬酸合酶实际上很少是通量的真正瓶颈。它的两个底物在基质里的浓度都远低于它的 Km，尤其草酰乙酸浓度极低，所以通量主要由底物可得性控制——草酰乙酸一多，柠檬酸合酶立刻加速。真正的别构控制点在下游：异柠檬酸脱氢酶（ADP／Ca2+ 激活，ATP／NADH 抑制）和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体（琥珀酰CoA／NADH 抑制，Ca2+ 激活）。肌肉收缩时 Ca2+ 涌入基质同时激活这两个酶和 PDH，这就是「用力时循环自动提速」的机制。
extra.en: Citrate synthase is rarely the true bottleneck. Both its substrates sit far below its Km in the matrix — oxaloacetate especially so — hence flux is governed largely by substrate availability: more oxaloacetate, faster citrate synthase. The real allosteric control lies downstream, at isocitrate dehydrogenase (activated by ADP and Ca2+, inhibited by ATP and NADH) and the alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex (inhibited by succinyl-CoA and NADH, activated by Ca2+). During contraction, Ca2+ entering the matrix activates both of these plus PDH — the mechanism by which the cycle speeds up on demand.

extra.zh: 三个容易搅在一起的名字，也是他在 24:15 到 24:45 之间自己一步步理清的：oxalic acid 草酸，HOOC–COOH，最简单的二羧酸，和循环无关（植物里常见的草酸钙结晶就是它）；oxaloacetate 草酰乙酸，四碳，OOC–CO–CH2–COO−，循环的起点和终点；citrate 柠檬酸，六碳三羧酸，第一步的产物，「三羧酸循环」这个名字就是从它来的。
extra.en: Three names that blur together — and which he untangles for himself between 24:15 and 24:45: oxalic acid, HOOC–COOH, the simplest dicarboxylic acid, unrelated to the cycle (it is the calcium oxalate crystal of plants); oxaloacetate, the four-carbon OOC–CO–CH2–COO−, both start and end of the cycle; and citrate, the six-carbon tricarboxylic acid made in the first step, from which the name 'tricarboxylic acid cycle' comes.

quiz.q_zh: citrate synthase 中文译作「合酶」而不是「合成酶」，依据是？
quiz.q_en: Why is citrate synthase a 合酶 rather than a 合成酶 in Chinese?

options.zh: 它不偶联 NTP 水解，能量来自硫酯键
options.en: It couples no NTP; a thioester supplies the energy

options.zh: 它的产物是三羧酸，按产物类别来命名
options.en: Its product is a triacid, and the name follows that

options.zh: 它催化的是分解方向，历史上先被发现
options.en: It was first found running in the degradative direction

options.zh: 它由多个亚基组成，属于多酶复合体
options.en: It is built of several subunits as a large complex

quiz.explain_zh: synthase／合酶不消耗 NTP，synthetase／合成酶要偶联 ATP 或 GTP；柠檬酸合酶的能量来自乙酰CoA 的硫酯键，所以是合酶。它催化的是缩合而不是分解；亚基数目与命名无关，很多单体酶也叫合酶；产物有几个羧基更不进入命名规则——琥珀酰CoA 合成酶的产物是二羧酸，照样叫合成酶。
quiz.explain_en: A synthase couples no NTP hydrolysis while a synthetase consumes ATP or GTP; citrate synthase draws its energy from the thioester of acetyl-CoA, so it is a synthase. It catalyses condensation, not degradation; subunit count has nothing to do with the naming, since many monomeric enzymes are synthases; and the number of carboxyls in the product is irrelevant — succinyl-CoA synthetase makes a diacid and is still a synthetase.

quiz.q_zh: 下列名称与结构的对应，哪一项是正确的？
quiz.q_en: Which pairing of name and structure is correct?

options.zh: acetate 是乙酰CoA，携带酰基的辅酶
options.en: Acetate is acetyl-CoA, the acyl-carrying coenzyme

options.zh: citrate 是草酸，最简单的二羧酸
options.en: Citrate is oxalic acid, the simplest diacid

options.zh: oxaloacetate 是草酰乙酸，四碳二羧酸
options.en: Oxaloacetate is the four-carbon keto diacid

options.zh: oxalic acid 是柠檬酸，六碳三羧酸
options.en: Oxalic acid is citrate, a six-carbon triacid

quiz.explain_zh: 草酰乙酸是四碳的 OOC–CO–CH2–COO−，带一个酮基和两个羧基，是循环的起点和终点。citrate 是柠檬酸不是草酸；oxalic acid 才是草酸，只有两个碳，与柠檬酸完全不同；acetate 是乙酸根，乙酰CoA 是乙酰基通过硫酯键接在辅酶 A 上的产物，两者不能划等号。
quiz.explain_en: Oxaloacetate is the four-carbon OOC–CO–CH2–COO−, carrying one keto group and two carboxylates, and is both start and end of the cycle. Citrate is citric acid, not oxalic acid; oxalic acid has only two carbons and is a completely different compound; and acetate is the acetic acid anion, whereas acetyl-CoA is that acetyl group joined to coenzyme A through a thioester.

quiz.q_zh: 抑制柠檬酸合酶的琥珀酰CoA，在循环中的位置是？
quiz.q_en: Where does succinyl-CoA, an inhibitor of citrate synthase, sit in the cycle?

options.zh: 循环的最后一步产物，由苹果酸生成
options.en: The final product of the cycle, made from malate

options.zh: 循环之外的产物，全部由脂肪酸氧化供给
options.en: A product outside the cycle, from fatty acid beta-oxidation

options.zh: 柠檬酸之后隔三步，由 α-酮戊二酸氧化脱羧生成
options.en: Three steps after citrate, from oxidative decarboxylation of alpha-ketoglutarate

options.zh: 柠檬酸的直接下一步产物，只隔一个酶
options.en: The next product after citrate, one enzyme away

quiz.explain_zh: 顺序是柠檬酸 → 异柠檬酸 → α-酮戊二酸 → 琥珀酰CoA，中间隔了三步三个酶，由 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体氧化脱羧生成。它不是柠檬酸的紧邻产物；循环最后一步的产物是草酰乙酸而不是它；脂肪酸的奇数碳链和某些氨基酸确实能生成琥珀酰CoA，但循环内部本来就有这一步，不能说它全来自循环之外。
quiz.explain_en: The order is citrate → isocitrate → alpha-ketoglutarate → succinyl-CoA: three steps and three enzymes on, formed by oxidative decarboxylation at the alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex. It does not immediately follow citrate; the last step of the cycle yields oxaloacetate, not succinyl-CoA; and although odd-chain fatty acids and some amino acids do feed in succinyl-CoA, the cycle makes it internally as well.

title_zh: TCA 里有没有 ΔG 大于零的步骤：消耗 ATP 不等于反应吸能
title_en: Is there a step with positive ΔG in the TCA cycle? Spending ATP is not the same as an endergonic reaction

points.zh: 学生提问：TCA 循环里有没有像 EMP 途径里那样 Gibbs 自由能大于零的情况。
points.en: A student asks whether the TCA cycle contains a step with positive Gibbs free energy, as glycolysis does.

points.zh: 他先给出总的判断：生物体内自发进行的反应，90% 以上 ΔG 都是小于零的。
points.en: He first gives the general picture: well over 90% of the reactions that proceed spontaneously in cells have negative ΔG.

points.zh: 他回答确实有那么一步：它的 ΔG 没有小于零，但也基本没有大于零，很接近零。
points.en: He answers that one such step exists: its ΔG is not clearly negative but not clearly positive either — it is close to zero.

points.zh: 那一步能往前走的机制和 EMP 里那一步一样：产物一直被消耗掉，底物就还能自发向产物方向进行。
points.en: It moves forward by the same mechanism as its glycolytic counterpart: the product is continuously consumed, so substrate still flows spontaneously toward it.

points.zh: 学生追问：EMP 里消耗能量的有第一步和第三步，为什么不强调它们 ΔG 大于零，只强调裂解成两个分子那一步。
points.en: The student presses: glycolysis spends energy at steps one and three, so why is positive ΔG stressed only at the step that splits the molecule in two?

points.zh: 他指出这里理解有偏差：所谓「消耗能量」指的是消耗了一分子 ATP，这是两回事。
points.en: He points out the confusion: 'spending energy' there means consuming one molecule of ATP, which is a different matter.

points.zh: Gibbs 自由能只是化学上用来衡量反应向正向还是逆向进行的量。
points.en: Gibbs free energy is simply the chemical measure of whether a reaction runs forward or backward.

points.zh: EMP 第一步和第三步用掉一分子 ATP、上了一个磷酸基团，ATP 的作用只是把磷酸基团送出去；整个反应的 ΔG 仍然小于零，仍然是自发发生的。
points.en: Steps one and three of glycolysis each spend one ATP to install a phosphate; ATP's role is only to donate that phosphate, and the overall ΔG of each reaction stays negative and spontaneous.

extra.zh: TCA 各步的 ΔG°′（kJ/mol，标准值）：柠檬酸合酶 −32.2；顺乌头酸酶 +13.3；异柠檬酸脱氢酶明显负值；α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体 −33.5；琥珀酰CoA 合成酶 ≈ −3；琥珀酸脱氢酶接近 0；延胡索酸酶小负值；苹果酸脱氢酶 +29.7。所以 ΔG°′ 为正的不止「那么一步」——顺乌头酸酶和苹果酸脱氢酶都是正的，两个都靠下游把产物抽走而正向进行。他讲的驱动机制是对的，只是数目不止一处。
extra.en: Standard ΔG°′ values around the cycle (kJ/mol): citrate synthase −32.2; aconitase +13.3; isocitrate dehydrogenase strongly negative; alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex −33.5; succinyl-CoA synthetase about −3; succinate dehydrogenase near 0; fumarase slightly negative; malate dehydrogenase +29.7. So more than one step has positive ΔG°′ — both aconitase and malate dehydrogenase do, and both run forward because the downstream enzyme drains the product. His mechanism is right; the count is not.
