extra.zh: 关键区别是 ΔG 和 ΔG°′ 不是一回事：ΔG = ΔG°′ + RT ln Q，Q 是实际浓度商。决定反应方向的永远是细胞内实际浓度下的 ΔG，而 ΔG°′ 只是所有物质都是 1 mol/L 时的参考值。苹果酸脱氢酶就是最好的例子：ΔG°′ = +29.7 kJ/mol 看起来完全不该发生，但基质里 NADH/NAD+ 比很低、草酰乙酸浓度又极低（远低于其他中间物），把 ln Q 项压成一个大负数，实际 ΔG 就成了负的。
extra.en: The key distinction is that ΔG and ΔG°′ are not the same: ΔG = ΔG°′ + RT ln Q, where Q is the actual concentration quotient. Direction is always set by ΔG at real intracellular concentrations, while ΔG°′ is merely the reference value with everything at 1 mol/L. Malate dehydrogenase is the textbook case: ΔG°′ = +29.7 kJ/mol looks impossible, yet a low matrix NADH/NAD+ ratio and a very low oxaloacetate concentration make the ln Q term strongly negative, so the actual ΔG is negative.

extra.zh: 他澄清得对，可以再加一层记账：己糖激酶那一步实际上是两个反应偶联起来的。葡萄糖 + Pi → 6-磷酸葡萄糖 本身 ΔG°′ ≈ +13.8 kJ/mol，是吸能的；ATP 水解 ΔG°′ ≈ −30.5 kJ/mol；酶把两者偶联在一个活性中心里完成，总和 ΔG°′ ≈ −16.7 kJ/mol，所以整体放能、不可逆。「消耗一分子 ATP」描述的是化学计量，「ΔG 大于零」描述的是热力学方向，两者互相独立。
extra.en: His clarification is correct and can be sharpened into bookkeeping: the hexokinase step is two reactions coupled. Glucose + Pi → glucose 6-phosphate alone has ΔG°′ about +13.8 kJ/mol and is endergonic; ATP hydrolysis is about −30.5 kJ/mol; the enzyme couples the two in one active site for a net ΔG°′ of about −16.7 kJ/mol, hence exergonic and irreversible. 'Spends one ATP' is a statement about stoichiometry; 'positive ΔG' is a statement about thermodynamic direction, and the two are independent.

extra.zh: EMP 途径那三个不可逆步骤，正是他拿来对照的：己糖激酶 ΔG°′ ≈ −16.7、磷酸果糖激酶-1 ≈ −14.2、丙酮酸激酶 ≈ −31.4 kJ/mol。所谓「不可逆」指的就是这几步的负值太大，细胞内实际 ΔG 也远离零，逆向根本走不动，所以糖异生必须绕路：丙酮酸羧化酶 + PEP 羧激酶绕过丙酮酸激酶，果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶和葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶绕过另外两步。
extra.en: The three irreversible glycolytic steps he uses for contrast: hexokinase ΔG°′ about −16.7, phosphofructokinase-1 about −14.2, pyruvate kinase about −31.4 kJ/mol. 'Irreversible' means these values are so negative that the real intracellular ΔG stays far from zero and the back reaction is unusable, which is why gluconeogenesis must detour: pyruvate carboxylase plus PEP carboxykinase bypass pyruvate kinase, and fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase and glucose-6-phosphatase bypass the other two.

quiz.q_zh: 己糖激酶那一步消耗一分子 ATP，它的 ΔG°′ 是？
quiz.q_en: The hexokinase step spends one ATP; what is its ΔG°′?

options.zh: 负值，与 ATP 水解偶联后总体放能
options.en: Negative: coupling to ATP hydrolysis makes it exergonic

options.zh: 正值，消耗 ATP 就说明反应是吸能的
options.en: Positive, since spending ATP means the step is endergonic

options.zh: 接近零，靠下游产物被消耗才能推动
options.en: Near zero, and pulled along by downstream consumption

options.zh: 正值，靠底物浓度极高才勉强往前走
options.en: Positive, driven only by very high substrate levels

quiz.explain_zh: 葡萄糖磷酸化本身是吸能的（ΔG°′ ≈ +13.8 kJ/mol），但酶把它和 ATP 水解（≈ −30.5）偶联在一个活性中心里，总和 ≈ −16.7 kJ/mol，是放能且不可逆的。把「消耗 ATP」直接等同于吸能是这里最典型的误解；这一步的负值很大，既不接近零，也不需要靠底物堆积或下游抽取来推动。
quiz.explain_en: Phosphorylating glucose is itself endergonic (ΔG°′ about +13.8 kJ/mol), but the enzyme couples it to ATP hydrolysis (about −30.5) in one active site for a net of roughly −16.7 kJ/mol: exergonic and irreversible. Equating 'spends ATP' with 'endergonic' is exactly the misconception here; the value is strongly negative, so the step is neither near equilibrium nor dependent on substrate accumulation or downstream pull.

quiz.q_zh: TCA 循环中 ΔG°′ 明显为正、却仍能正向进行的步骤是？
quiz.q_en: Which TCA step has a clearly positive ΔG°′ yet still runs forward?

options.zh: 苹果酸脱氢酶那一步，草酰乙酸浓度极低
options.en: Malate dehydrogenase, since oxaloacetate stays very low

options.zh: 琥珀酸脱氢酶那一步，被 FAD 强行拉动
options.en: Succinate dehydrogenase, forced along by bound FAD

options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶那一步，被产物柠檬酸拉动
options.en: Citrate synthase, pulled along by citrate itself

options.zh: α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶那一步，靠 CO2 逸出
options.en: Alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, pulled by CO2 loss

quiz.explain_zh: 苹果酸脱氢酶的 ΔG°′ = +29.7 kJ/mol，但基质里草酰乙酸浓度极低、NADH/NAD+ 比也低，使实际 ΔG 变负，反应照样往前走（顺乌头酸酶 +13.3 同理）。柠檬酸合酶 ΔG°′ ≈ −32.2，是循环里最放能的步骤之一；α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶 ≈ −33.5，本来就大幅放能；琥珀酸脱氢酶的 ΔG°′ 接近零，也不是正值。
quiz.explain_en: Malate dehydrogenase has ΔG°′ = +29.7 kJ/mol, yet a very low matrix oxaloacetate concentration and a low NADH/NAD+ ratio make the actual ΔG negative and the reaction proceeds (aconitase at +13.3 works the same way). Citrate synthase is about −32.2, among the most exergonic steps of the cycle; alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase is about −33.5, strongly exergonic already; and succinate dehydrogenase sits near zero rather than positive.

title_zh: ΔG 正负的方向含义，以及在 ChemDraw 里画出草酰乙酸
title_en: What the sign of ΔG really says about direction, and drawing oxaloacetate in ChemDraw

points.zh: ΔG 大于零的意义就是：这个反应不是自发进行的。
points.en: A positive ΔG means one thing: the reaction is not spontaneous as written.

points.zh: 循环里很多反应是可逆的，我们顺着讲的方向 ΔG 小于零，反过来的方向就是大于零。
points.en: Many reactions in the cycle are reversible: in the direction we present them ΔG is negative, so the reverse direction is positive.

points.zh: 逆向反应并不是不能发生，只要额外提供一点能量，在一定程度上也是可以进行的。
points.en: The reverse reaction is not forbidden; supply some energy and it can proceed to some extent.

points.zh: 之所以要着重强调那一步，是因为按我们顺着讲的方向，它理论上是「倒过来」的那一步。
points.en: That one step gets emphasis because, in the direction we are narrating, it is the step that theoretically runs backwards.

points.zh: 别的步骤在顺时针的讲述方向上 ΔG 都是小于零的，默认自发，不必逐个强调。
points.en: The other steps all have negative ΔG in the clockwise direction, are spontaneous by default, and need no special comment.

points.zh: 那一步虽然是逆着的，但因为产物被不断消耗，实际上照样能往前走。
points.en: Although that step runs against the gradient, continuous consumption of its product keeps it moving forward anyway.

points.zh: 他打开 ChemDraw 开始画，第一个画的是起始原料草酰乙酸。
points.en: He opens ChemDraw and starts drawing, beginning with the starting material oxaloacetate.

points.zh: 羧基他直接写成 COOH 或 COO−，因为把羰基的氧真画出来反而不好看。
points.en: He writes carboxyls simply as COOH or COO−, because drawing the carbonyl oxygen explicitly makes the structure look worse.

points.zh: 草酰乙酸被画成横着的骨架：左边凸出一截，右边是两个 COO−，这就是循环的起始原料。
points.en: Oxaloacetate is drawn as a horizontal skeleton with a stub on the left and two COO− groups on the right — the cycle's starting material.

extra.zh: 「产物被消耗所以还能往前走」这句话在整个循环层面还有一个更根本的版本：TCA 循环的总驱动力来自两处不可逆的出口——两分子 CO2 直接扩散离开，以及 NADH／FADH2 被电子传递链持续再氧化。这两条把所有中间步骤的浓度商压在远离平衡的一侧。所以一旦缺氧或加氰化物、电子传递链停下来，NADH 立刻堆积、NAD+ 枯竭，TCA 循环几乎马上停转——不是循环本身需要氧，而是它需要一个能不断收走电子的下游。
extra.en: 'The product is consumed so it still goes forward' has a deeper version at the level of the whole cycle: the driving force comes from two irreversible exits — two CO2 simply diffusing away, and NADH/FADH2 being continuously re-oxidised by the electron transport chain. Together these hold every intermediate's concentration quotient far from equilibrium. Hence under anoxia or cyanide, when the chain stops, NADH piles up and NAD+ runs out and the cycle halts almost at once: the cycle itself needs no oxygen, but it needs a downstream sink that keeps taking electrons.

extra.zh: 生化里的「可逆／不可逆」是热力学说法，不是「酶能不能反着催化」。酶总是同等加速正逆两个方向、不改变平衡常数；说一步不可逆，指的是细胞内实际 ΔG 离零太远，逆向通量小到没有意义。所以绕过不可逆步骤必须换一条路、换一套酶（糖异生用丙酮酸羧化酶 + PEP 羧激酶绕过丙酮酸激酶），而接近平衡的步骤（如延胡索酸酶、苹果酸脱氢酶）同一个酶就能双向使用。
extra.en: 'Reversible' and 'irreversible' in biochemistry are thermodynamic terms, not statements about whether the enzyme can run backwards. An enzyme always accelerates both directions equally and never changes the equilibrium constant; calling a step irreversible means the in-cell ΔG is so far from zero that reverse flux is negligible. That is why bypassing an irreversible step requires a different route and different enzymes (pyruvate carboxylase plus PEP carboxykinase around pyruvate kinase), while near-equilibrium steps such as fumarase and malate dehydrogenase are used in both directions by the same enzyme.

extra.zh: 草酰乙酸的结构值得单独记：−OOC–CO–CH2–COO−，四个碳，C2 是酮基，C1 和 C4 是两个羧基。要点是被乙酰基进攻的位点恰恰是 C2 那个酮羰基——酮羰基的碳带部分正电荷，正好接受乙酰CoA 甲基去质子后形成的烯醇负离子。这也解释了它在基质里浓度为什么极低却够用：柠檬酸合酶对它亲和力很高，一生成就被抓走。
extra.en: The structure of oxaloacetate is worth memorising on its own: −OOC–CO–CH2–COO−, four carbons, a keto group at C2 and carboxylates at C1 and C4. The point is that the acetyl group attacks precisely that C2 keto carbonyl — its carbon carries a partial positive charge and is the natural target for the enolate formed when the methyl of acetyl-CoA is deprotonated. It also explains how so low a matrix concentration suffices: citrate synthase binds it tightly and takes it as soon as it appears.

extra.zh: 他为了好看写成 COOH，但生理条件下这些羧基几乎全部解离：脂肪族羧酸的 pKa 约 3–5，pH 7.4 下按 Henderson-Hasselbalch 计算，质子化形式不到千分之一。所以规范写法和规范命名都用阴离子形式——citrate、oxaloacetate、succinate、malate，而不是 citric acid、malic acid。柠檬酸在生理 pH 下带三个负电荷，这也是它能被三羧酸转运体识别、并螯合 Ca2+ 的原因。
extra.en: He writes COOH for looks, but under physiological conditions these carboxyls are essentially fully dissociated: aliphatic carboxylic acids have pKa around 3–5, so by Henderson-Hasselbalch at pH 7.4 less than one part in a thousand is protonated. That is why both the standard drawings and the standard names use anions — citrate, oxaloacetate, succinate, malate rather than citric or malic acid. Citrate carries three negative charges at physiological pH, which is what lets the tricarboxylate transporter recognise it and what makes it a Ca2+ chelator.

quiz.q_zh: 「某一步的 ΔG 大于零」在生物化学里的准确含义是？
quiz.q_en: What does 'this step has positive ΔG' actually mean in biochemistry?

options.zh: 这个反应必须由专门的酶催化才能进行
options.en: The reaction requires a dedicated enzyme to take place

options.zh: 这个反应必定要消耗一分子 ATP 才能完成
options.en: The reaction must consume one ATP in order to complete

options.zh: 写成这个方向时不自发，需要偶联或被下游拉动
options.en: As written it is not spontaneous and needs coupling or a pull

options.zh: 这个反应在细胞里无论如何都不会发生
options.en: The reaction can never take place inside a living cell

quiz.explain_zh: ΔG 的正负只说明按写出的方向自不自发；正值的反应可以靠与放能反应偶联、或靠下游把产物抽走而照常进行，苹果酸脱氢酶就是例子。说它绝不会发生是把热力学当成禁令；酶只加快达到平衡的速度，改变不了 ΔG 的符号；偶联的方式也不限于 ATP，浓度梯度、CO2 逸出、下游消耗都可以。
quiz.explain_en: The sign of ΔG says only whether the reaction is spontaneous as written; a positive step can still proceed by coupling to an exergonic one or by having its product drained downstream, as malate dehydrogenase does. Saying it can never happen treats thermodynamics as a prohibition; an enzyme only speeds the approach to equilibrium and cannot change the sign of ΔG; and coupling need not involve ATP — concentration gradients, CO2 escape and downstream consumption all serve.

quiz.q_zh: 生理 pH 下，TCA 中间物的羧基主要以什么形式存在？
quiz.q_en: At physiological pH, in what form are the carboxyls of TCA intermediates?

options.zh: 以硫酯形式存在，方便与辅酶结合
options.en: As thioesters, so as to bind their coenzyme

options.zh: 以 COOH 形式存在，因为 pKa 高于 7
options.en: As COOH, because their pKa lies above pH 7

options.zh: 以 COO− 形式存在，因为 pKa 约为 3–5
options.en: As COO−, because their pKa is around 3 to 5

options.zh: 以酸酐形式存在，便于直接转移酰基
options.en: As anhydrides, ready to transfer acyl groups

quiz.explain_zh: 脂肪族羧酸 pKa 约 3–5，pH 7.4 时几乎全部解离，所以规范名用 citrate、malate 这类阴离子形式，他写 COOH 只是画图方便。pKa 高于 7 的说法与实测相反；酸酐在水中极不稳定，不会作为中间物存在；硫酯只出现在乙酰CoA 和琥珀酰CoA 上，其余中间物并不带 CoA。
quiz.explain_en: Aliphatic carboxylic acids have pKa around 3–5 and are essentially fully ionised at pH 7.4, which is why the standard names are anionic — citrate, malate — and why writing COOH is only a drawing convenience. A pKa above 7 contradicts measurement; anhydrides are far too unstable in water to exist as intermediates; and thioesters occur only in acetyl-CoA and succinyl-CoA, the other intermediates carrying no CoA at all.

title_zh: 缩合成柠檬酸：乙酰基去了哪个碳，以及循环最初怎么起步
title_en: Condensation to citrate: where the acetyl group lands, and how the cycle gets started at all

points.zh: 他继续画草酰基团：链上带一个羰基，旁边直接写 CoA（大写 C、小写 o、大写 A）就可以。
points.en: He continues drawing: a carbonyl on the chain, with CoA written beside it (capital C, lower-case o, capital A) as shorthand.

points.zh: 为了让人看清这是个乙酰基，可以在末端再补一个 CH3 表示甲基。
points.en: To make it clear that the group is an acetyl, a terminal CH3 can be added to mark the methyl.

points.zh: 草酰乙酸和乙酰CoA 这两个东西，在 citrate synthase（柠檬酸合酶）的作用下发生反应。
points.en: Oxaloacetate and acetyl-CoA react under the action of citrate synthase.

points.zh: 他把乙酰基标成红色，再复制一份草酰乙酸，指出乙酰基是加在哪个具体位置上的。
points.en: He colours the acetyl group red, copies the oxaloacetate, and points out the exact position where the acetyl group is added.

points.zh: 新画出来的那个碳就是原来乙酰CoA 上的甲基碳。
points.en: The carbon he has just drawn in is the methyl carbon that came from acetyl-CoA.

points.zh: 反应之后原来草酰乙酸上的那个羰基变成了羟基。
points.en: After the reaction the carbonyl that was on oxaloacetate has become a hydroxyl.

points.zh: 标颜色的目的就是让人看清乙酰基是从乙酰CoA 那里整体搬过来的。
points.en: The colouring exists so that one can see the acetyl group was transferred over from acetyl-CoA as a whole.

points.zh: 学生提问：如果没有第八步的产物草酰乙酸，循环最开始怎么起步。
points.en: A student asks: without the oxaloacetate made in the eighth step, how does the cycle start in the first place?

points.zh: 他先回答 TCA 有两重意义：一是能量的最终氧化代谢途径，把这些产物全部分解掉；二是很多别的途径中间产物的产生者。
points.en: He answers first that the cycle has two roles: it is the final oxidative route for energy, breaking these products all the way down, and it is the producer of intermediates for many other pathways.

extra.zh: 缩合的真实机制：柠檬酸合酶的 Asp375 夺走乙酰CoA 甲基上的一个质子，His274 把生成的烯醇负离子稳定住；这个碳负离子亲核进攻草酰乙酸的 C2 酮羰基，成键得到柠檬酰CoA（citryl-CoA）；最后 His320 参与把硫酯键水解，放出柠檬酸和 CoA-SH。顺序很关键：先成 C–C 键、后水解硫酯，如果反过来先把硫酯水解掉，那 −31 kJ/mol 就白白散成热了。
extra.en: The real mechanism: Asp375 of citrate synthase abstracts a proton from the methyl of acetyl-CoA and His274 stabilises the resulting enolate; that carbanion attacks the C2 keto carbonyl of oxaloacetate to form the C–C bond, giving citryl-CoA; finally His320 assists hydrolysis of the thioester, releasing citrate and CoA-SH. The order matters: bond formation first, thioester hydrolysis second — hydrolysing first would dissipate that −31 kJ/mol as heat.

extra.zh: 学生这个问题的标准答案是回补反应（anaplerotic reactions）：草酰乙酸不是靠上一圈「留下来」的，而是随时可以被补进来。主力是丙酮酸羧化酶，丙酮酸 + CO2 + ATP → 草酰乙酸，辅酶是生物素（维生素 B7），而且它被乙酰CoA 别构激活——乙酰CoA 一多就自动去补草酰乙酸，这是循环的自动配平机制。其他入口还有天冬氨酸转氨生成草酰乙酸、谷氨酸转氨生成 α-酮戊二酸、奇数碳脂肪酸经丙酰CoA 生成琥珀酰CoA。
extra.en: The textbook answer to the student's question is the anaplerotic reactions: oxaloacetate is not merely left over from the previous turn but can be replenished at any time. The main route is pyruvate carboxylase, pyruvate + CO2 + ATP → oxaloacetate, with biotin (vitamin B7) as cofactor — and it is allosterically activated by acetyl-CoA, so an excess of acetyl-CoA automatically calls up more oxaloacetate. Other entries include transamination of aspartate to oxaloacetate, of glutamate to alpha-ketoglutarate, and odd-chain fatty acids feeding in as succinyl-CoA via propionyl-CoA.

extra.zh: 柠檬酸是前手性（prochiral）分子：它有两条化学上完全相同的 −CH2COO− 臂，一条来自乙酰基，一条来自草酰乙酸。顺乌头酸酶用「三点结合」把两条臂区分开，脱水永远发生在来自草酰乙酸的那一条上，所以产物只有 2R,3S-异柠檬酸一种立体异构体。当年正是这一点让 Ogston 解决了同位素实验的悖论：标记的乙酰基碳没有像「对称分子应该」那样被随机处理。
extra.en: Citrate is prochiral: it has two chemically identical −CH2COO− arms, one derived from the acetyl group and one from oxaloacetate. Aconitase distinguishes them by three-point attachment, so dehydration always occurs on the arm that came from oxaloacetate and the product is exclusively 2R,3S-isocitrate. This is precisely the point with which Ogston resolved the old isotope paradox: the labelled acetyl carbons were not scrambled as a symmetric molecule 'should' scramble them.

extra.zh: 「三羧酸循环」这个名字就是从第一步的产物来的：柠檬酸带三个羧基。但循环里真正称得上三羧酸的只有柠檬酸、顺乌头酸和异柠檬酸这三个，α-酮戊二酸往后全是二羧酸。所以 TCA cycle（tricarboxylic acid cycle）、citric acid cycle（柠檬酸循环）、Krebs cycle 是同一个循环的三个名字，分别按羧基数、按第一个产物、按发现者命名。
extra.en: The name 'tricarboxylic acid cycle' comes from the product of the first step: citrate carries three carboxyls. But only citrate, cis-aconitate and isocitrate are genuinely tricarboxylic; from alpha-ketoglutarate onward everything is a dicarboxylic acid. TCA cycle, citric acid cycle and Krebs cycle are thus three names for the same thing — after the number of carboxyls, after the first product, and after its discoverer.

quiz.q_zh: 柠檬酸合酶反应中，乙酰CoA 一侧发生的第一件事是？
quiz.q_en: In the citrate synthase reaction, what happens first on the acetyl-CoA side?

options.zh: 甲基先被羧化成丙二酰基
options.en: The methyl is carboxylated to malonyl

options.zh: 甲基去质子生成烯醇负离子
options.en: The methyl is deprotonated to an enolate

options.zh: 硫酯键先被水分子水解掉
options.en: The thioester is hydrolysed by water first

options.zh: 巯基先被氧化成二硫键
options.en: The thiol is first oxidised to a disulfide

quiz.explain_zh: Asp375 夺走甲基上的质子，生成的烯醇负离子亲核进攻草酰乙酸的酮羰基，成键后才轮到硫酯水解。次序反过来先水解硫酯，那份能量就白白丢掉、反应也拉不到不可逆；巯基氧化成二硫键是 PDH 复合体里硫辛酰胺的化学；甲基羧化成丙二酰CoA 是脂肪酸合成的起始步骤，由乙酰CoA 羧化酶完成。
quiz.explain_en: Asp375 abstracts a proton from the methyl, and the resulting enolate attacks the keto carbonyl of oxaloacetate; only after the C–C bond forms is the thioester hydrolysed. Reversing that order would waste the thioester energy and leave the reaction reversible; oxidation of a thiol to a disulfide is lipoamide chemistry in the PDH complex; and carboxylation of the methyl to malonyl-CoA is the committed step of fatty acid synthesis, catalysed by acetyl-CoA carboxylase.

quiz.q_zh: 顺乌头酸酶能区分柠檬酸两条 −CH2COO− 臂，直接后果是？
quiz.q_en: Aconitase can tell apart the two −CH2COO− arms of citrate; what follows?

options.zh: 两条臂同时脱水，生成双键中间体
options.en: Both arms dehydrate at once, giving a diene

options.zh: 两条臂随机脱水，产物是消旋混合物
options.en: Both arms dehydrate at random, giving a racemate

options.zh: 只有来自乙酰基的那条臂发生脱水
options.en: Only the arm from the acetyl group is dehydrated

options.zh: 只有来自草酰乙酸的那条臂发生脱水
options.en: Only the arm from oxaloacetate is dehydrated

quiz.explain_zh: 酶通过三点结合固定柠檬酸这个前手性分子，脱水固定发生在来自草酰乙酸的那条臂上，所以产物只有 2R,3S-异柠檬酸一种。随机脱水会给出消旋产物，与实验完全不符；来自乙酰基的两个碳这一圈根本不动，正是同位素实验的经典结论；一个分子上两条臂同时脱水在化学上并不存在。
quiz.explain_en: Three-point attachment fixes the prochiral citrate so that dehydration always occurs on the arm derived from oxaloacetate, and the sole product is 2R,3S-isocitrate. Random dehydration would give a racemic product, contradicting experiment; the two carbons from the acetyl group are untouched in this turn, which is the classic isotope result; and simultaneous dehydration of both arms of one molecule simply does not occur.

quiz.q_zh: 循环起步所需要的草酰乙酸，机体主要靠什么补充？
quiz.q_en: How does the body mainly replenish the oxaloacetate the cycle needs?

options.zh: 由乙酰CoA 直接羧化成四碳酸
options.en: Acetyl-CoA is carboxylated to a C4 acid

options.zh: 由丙酮酸羧化酶把丙酮酸羧化
options.en: Pyruvate carboxylase carboxylates pyruvate

options.zh: 由柠檬酸在胞质中裂解释放
options.en: Citrate is cleaved in the cytosol to release it

options.zh: 由琥珀酸脱氢酶反向催化生成
options.en: Succinate dehydrogenase runs in reverse

quiz.explain_zh: 丙酮酸羧化酶以生物素为辅酶，丙酮酸 + CO2 + ATP → 草酰乙酸，并被乙酰CoA 别构激活，是最主要的回补反应。乙酰CoA 羧化生成的是丙二酰CoA，走的是脂肪酸合成，不生成草酰乙酸；胞质里 ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶放出的是乙酰CoA 和草酰乙酸，但那是把碳送出线粒体，不是基质内的补充途径；琥珀酸脱氢酶反向催化只回到琥珀酸，与草酰乙酸无关。
quiz.explain_en: Pyruvate carboxylase, a biotin enzyme, converts pyruvate + CO2 + ATP to oxaloacetate and is allosterically activated by acetyl-CoA — the principal anaplerotic route. Carboxylating acetyl-CoA gives malonyl-CoA and starts fatty acid synthesis, not oxaloacetate; cytosolic ATP-citrate lyase does release oxaloacetate along with acetyl-CoA, but that exports carbon from the mitochondrion rather than replenishing the matrix pool; and running succinate dehydrogenase backwards only regenerates succinate.

title_zh: 草酰乙酸的「搬运工」角色，与柠檬酸异构化成异柠檬酸
title_en: Oxaloacetate as the cycle's carrier, and the isomerisation of citrate to isocitrate

points.zh: 反过来说，很多别的化学反应的产物或底物也可以作为 TCA 循环的中间产物。
points.en: Conversely, the products and substrates of many other reactions can enter the cycle as intermediates.

points.zh: 他举了草酰乙酸、琥珀酸这些例子，说它们在别的生化反应里也会参与进去，不一定是代谢途径。
points.en: He cites oxaloacetate and succinate as examples that also take part in other biochemical reactions, not necessarily metabolic pathways.

points.zh: 所以草酰乙酸本来就是生物体内自然存在的一种物质，它并不是由乙酰CoA 生成的。
points.en: Oxaloacetate is therefore a substance that naturally exists in the organism; it is not made from acetyl-CoA.

points.zh: 他说草酰乙酸在 TCA 循环里起的是「搬运工」的作用：进来以后负责搬运乙酰基。
points.en: He describes oxaloacetate as a porter within the cycle: it comes in and carries the acetyl group around.

points.zh: 他说这个东西在整个反应的前后都是不变的，看完一整圈就会发现它没怎么发生变化。
points.en: He says it is unchanged before and after the whole reaction, and that after a full turn one sees it has hardly altered.

points.zh: 他更正自己的画图：那个基团是羟基；第一步产物右边是三个羧基、左边是一个羟基。
points.en: He corrects his own drawing: that group is a hydroxyl, and the first product carries three carboxyls on the right and one hydroxyl on the left.

points.zh: 下一步是柠檬酸发生异构化变成异柠檬酸，酶名他一时没读准（乌头酸酶 / aconitase）。
points.en: The next step isomerises citrate to isocitrate; he stumbles over the enzyme's name (aconitase).

points.zh: 图上把中间产物画在中括号里，他类比 EMP 途径里生成 2,3-BPG 那一步的短寿命中间产物。
points.en: The intermediate is drawn in square brackets, which he compares with the short-lived intermediate at the 2,3-BPG step of glycolysis.

points.zh: 他把中括号里的物种称作「过渡态」，并说中间结构不用记，只看原始底物和最终产物；这一步主要变的是左边那个羟基的位置。
points.en: He calls the bracketed species a transition state, says its structure need not be memorised and only substrate and final product matter, and notes that what changes is the position of the hydroxyl on the left.

extra.zh: 他说草酰乙酸「整个反应前后都不变、只是个搬运工」。在净计量意义上成立——一圈之后确实再生出一分子草酰乙酸，而且它才是循环里前后不变、起催化剂作用的那一个（乙酰CoA 恰恰相反，每一圈都被消耗掉）。但说「分子没变化」在化学上是错的：同位素标记的经典结论是，第一圈里放出的两个 CO2 全部来自草酰乙酸原有骨架上的碳，刚进来的乙酰基那两个碳这一圈根本不离开，要到后面几圈才被放出。草酰乙酸的 C2 酮碳正是被乙酰基甲基进攻的位点，随后经历脱羧和氧化。所以 TCA 循环不是简单地「把刚进来的乙酰基烧掉」，而是一个碳骨架不断被打散重组的过程。
extra.en: He says oxaloacetate is 'unchanged from beginning to end, just a porter'. In net stoichiometric terms that holds — one turn does regenerate a molecule of oxaloacetate, and it is indeed the species that comes through the cycle unchanged and acts catalytically (acetyl-CoA is the opposite: it is consumed every turn). But 'the molecule does not change' is chemically wrong. The classic isotope-labelling result is that both CO2 released in the first turn come from carbons of the original oxaloacetate skeleton; the two carbons of the acetyl group that just entered do not leave in that turn at all and are released only several turns later. The C2 keto carbon of oxaloacetate is precisely the atom attacked by the acetyl methyl, and it then undergoes decarboxylation and oxidation. So the cycle is not simply 'burning the acetyl group that just arrived' — it is a carbon skeleton being repeatedly dismantled and reassembled.

extra.zh: 画在中括号里的顺乌头酸（cis-aconitate）是中间体（intermediate），不是过渡态（transition state）。中间体是势能面上的极小点，是真实存在、原则上可以分离的物种——顺乌头酸本身就能从反应体系中分离到；过渡态是势能面上的鞍点，寿命约一个键振动周期（~10⁻¹³ s），无法分离，也不会作为一个物种画进反应式里。他在这一段其他几处说的都是「中间体」，只有这一句说成过渡态。
extra.en: The cis-aconitate drawn in square brackets is an intermediate, not a transition state. An intermediate is a local minimum on the potential energy surface — a real species that can in principle be isolated, and cis-aconitate can indeed be isolated from the reaction mixture. A transition state is a saddle point with a lifetime of roughly one bond vibration (about 10⁻¹³ s); it cannot be isolated and is never drawn as a species in a reaction scheme. Elsewhere in this passage he says 'intermediate' correctly; only this one sentence says transition state.

extra.zh: 为什么非得异构化：柠檬酸的中心碳是叔醇，羟基所在的碳上没有氢，根本没法被氧化成酮，也就无法进行随后的 β-脱羧。顺乌头酸酶先脱水生成顺乌头酸，再反向加水，把 —OH 挪到相邻碳上变成仲醇，异柠檬酸这才能被异柠檬酸脱氢酶氧化脱羧。总反应柠檬酸 ⇌ 异柠檬酸的 ΔG°′ ≈ +13.3 kJ/mol，是吸能的，平衡时约九成是柠檬酸，只有约一成是异柠檬酸（还有少量顺乌头酸），反应能往前走完全靠异柠檬酸脱氢酶不断把产物抽走。
extra.en: Why the isomerisation is necessary: the central carbon of citrate is a tertiary alcohol with no hydrogen on the carbinol carbon, so it cannot be oxidised to a ketone and the subsequent beta-decarboxylation is impossible. Aconitase first dehydrates to cis-aconitate and then rehydrates in the opposite sense, moving the −OH to the adjacent carbon as a secondary alcohol; only then can isocitrate dehydrogenase oxidise and decarboxylate it. The overall citrate ⇌ isocitrate reaction has ΔG°′ about +13.3 kJ/mol and is endergonic, with roughly nine parts citrate to one part isocitrate at equilibrium (plus a little cis-aconitate); it goes forward solely because isocitrate dehydrogenase keeps draining the product.

extra.zh: 顺乌头酸酶的活性中心是一个 [4Fe-4S] 簇，而且用法很特别：四个铁里有一个不与半胱氨酸配位，空出来的配位位直接结合底物的羟基和羧基，起 Lewis 酸的作用来帮助脱水，并不传电子。这个裸露的铁很容易被超氧阴离子氧化脱落，簇塌成 [3Fe-4S]，酶就失活——这是氧化应激下 TCA 通量下降的一个直接原因。胞质里的同源蛋白更有意思：铁充足时它是顺乌头酸酶，铁缺乏时铁硫簇散掉，它转身变成 IRP1，去结合 mRNA 上的铁反应元件调控铁代谢。
extra.en: The active site of aconitase is a [4Fe-4S] cluster used in an unusual way: one of the four irons is not ligated by cysteine, and its free coordination positions bind the substrate's hydroxyl and carboxylate directly, acting as a Lewis acid to assist dehydration rather than transferring electrons. That exposed iron is readily oxidised and lost to superoxide, collapsing the cluster to [3Fe-4S] and inactivating the enzyme — a direct reason why TCA flux falls under oxidative stress. The cytosolic homologue is more striking still: iron-replete it is an aconitase, iron-depleted it loses the cluster and becomes IRP1, binding iron-responsive elements in mRNA to regulate iron metabolism.

quiz.q_zh: 第一圈 TCA 循环放出的两个 CO2，其碳原子来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: Where do the carbons of the two CO2 released in the first turn come from?

options.zh: 刚刚进来的那个乙酰基的两个碳
options.en: The two carbons of the acetyl that just came in

options.zh: 乙酰基与草酰乙酸各出一个碳
options.en: One carbon each from acetyl and oxaloacetate

options.zh: 这一圈中重新固定进来的两个碳
options.en: Two carbons freshly fixed during this same turn

options.zh: 草酰乙酸原有骨架上带来的那两个碳
options.en: Two carbons from the original oxaloacetate skeleton

quiz.explain_zh: 同位素标记的经典结论是：第一圈放出的两个 CO2 全部来自草酰乙酸原有的碳，乙酰基那两个碳这一圈并不离开，要到后面几圈才被放出。所以「烧掉刚进来的乙酰基」这个直觉是错的；说两者各出一个碳同样与标记实验不符；循环里没有把 CO2 重新固定的反应，回补用的丙酮酸羧化酶发生在循环之外。
quiz.explain_en: The classic isotope-labelling result is that both CO2 of the first turn come from carbons already present in oxaloacetate; the two acetyl carbons do not leave in that turn and are released only several turns later. The intuition that the incoming acetyl group is burned is therefore wrong; a one-carbon-each split contradicts the labelling data just as much; and no step of the cycle fixes CO2 — the carboxylation that replenishes oxaloacetate happens outside it.

quiz.q_zh: 画在中括号里的顺乌头酸，正确的化学称呼是？
quiz.q_en: What is the correct chemical term for the bracketed cis-aconitate?

options.zh: 共价加合物，与酶不可逆地结合
options.en: A covalent adduct bound irreversibly to the enzyme

options.zh: 中间体，是势能面上的极小点
options.en: An intermediate, a minimum on the energy surface

options.zh: 过渡态，是势能面上的鞍点
options.en: A transition state, a saddle on that same surface

options.zh: 别构效应物，调节酶的活性
options.en: An allosteric effector modulating enzyme activity

quiz.explain_zh: 顺乌头酸是真实存在、原则上可以分离的物种，处在势能面的极小点上，因此是中间体。过渡态是鞍点，寿命约一个键振动周期，无法分离，也不会作为物种写进反应式；它不结合调控位点，谈不上别构效应物；它与酶之间是非共价结合，反应完就离开，不是共价加合物。
quiz.explain_en: cis-Aconitate is a real species that can in principle be isolated and sits at a minimum on the potential energy surface, which makes it an intermediate. A transition state is a saddle point lasting about one bond vibration, cannot be isolated and is never written as a species; the compound binds no regulatory site, so it is not an allosteric effector; and it is held non-covalently and leaves when the reaction is done, so it is no covalent adduct.

quiz.q_zh: 柠檬酸必须先异构化成异柠檬酸，根本原因是？
quiz.q_en: Why must citrate first be isomerised to isocitrate?

options.zh: 柠檬酸分子太大，脱羧酶容纳不下
options.en: Citrate is too bulky for the decarboxylase

options.zh: 叔醇不能被氧化成酮，无法脱羧
options.en: A tertiary alcohol cannot be oxidised to a ketone

options.zh: 柠檬酸是对称分子，酶识别不了它
options.en: Citrate is symmetric and cannot be recognised

options.zh: 三个羧基电荷太高，酶无法结合
options.en: Three carboxylates are too charged to bind

quiz.explain_zh: 柠檬酸的羟基长在叔碳上，那个碳没有氢，无法被氧化成酮，后续的 β-脱羧也就无从谈起；把羟基挪到相邻碳变成仲醇之后，异柠檬酸脱氢酶才能氧化脱羧。电荷高并不妨碍结合，这些酶的活性中心本来就带正电残基；分子大小与顺乌头酸酶的底物尺寸无关；柠檬酸是前手性而非对称，顺乌头酸酶恰恰能区分它的两条臂。
quiz.explain_en: The hydroxyl of citrate sits on a tertiary carbon that bears no hydrogen, so it cannot be oxidised to a ketone and the subsequent beta-decarboxylation is impossible; only after the hydroxyl is moved to the neighbouring carbon as a secondary alcohol can isocitrate dehydrogenase oxidise and decarboxylate it. High charge is no barrier to binding, since these active sites carry positive residues for exactly that; molecular bulk is not the issue for aconitase; and citrate is prochiral rather than symmetric — aconitase distinguishes its two arms precisely.

title_zh: 顺乌头酸酶：柠檬酸→异柠檬酸的两步与「产物被消耗」的驱动力
title_en: Aconitase: the two-step citrate→isocitrate isomerisation and the pull of product consumption

points.zh: 催化柠檬酸变成异柠檬酸的酶叫乌头酸酶（顺乌头酸酶），老师当场拼不准英文，读成 actonitis / aconitis，让学生自己查正确拼写。
points.en: The enzyme converting citrate to isocitrate is aconitase (cis-aconitase). The teacher could not recall the English spelling on the spot, said something like actonitis/aconitis, and asked the student to look it up.

points.zh: 他强调这个酶催化的过程整体上是可逆的，两步都是可逆步骤。
points.en: He stressed that the reaction this enzyme catalyses is reversible as a whole, both partial steps included.

points.zh: 他把反应拆成两步：第一步柠檬酸变成中间体，他说这一步 ΔG 小于 0，是自然而然就会发生的。
points.en: He split the reaction in two: citrate to the intermediate first, which he said has ΔG below zero and therefore happens spontaneously.

points.zh: 第二步中间体变成异柠檬酸，他说这一步 ΔG 大于 0，是略微吸能的。
points.en: The second step, intermediate to isocitrate, he described as having ΔG above zero, i.e. slightly endergonic.

points.zh: 他解释吸能的那一步仍然能往前走，是因为产物异柠檬酸被后面的三羧酸循环反应不断消耗掉。
points.en: He explained that the endergonic step still proceeds because isocitrate is continuously consumed by the downstream TCA reactions.

points.zh: 他把这条推广成通则：生物体内 ΔG 大于 0 还能自发进行的反应，基本都是靠产物不断被消耗，和上节课 EMP 途径里那些 ΔG 大于 0 的步骤是一回事。
points.en: He generalised this into a rule: in cells, reactions with a positive ΔG that still run forward almost always do so because their product is being drained, exactly like the positive-ΔG steps of glycolysis covered in the previous lecture.

points.zh: 他说这一步本质上只是把一个羟基换个位置，从原来的碳挪到相邻的碳上，分子骨架不变。
points.en: He said the step is essentially a repositioning of one hydroxyl group from one carbon to the neighbouring carbon, with the carbon skeleton unchanged.

points.zh: 他反复说这一步没有任何能量变化，所以到目前为止整个 TCA 循环还没有涉及能量的产生，这些步骤不重要、中间体结构不用记。
points.en: He repeated that there is no energy change here, so up to this point the cycle has produced no energy at all; these steps are not important and the intermediate's structure need not be memorised.

points.zh: 他建议在图上用另一种颜色把移动的那个羟基标出来，便于对照前后两个结构。
points.en: He suggested colouring the migrating hydroxyl differently on the drawing so the before/after structures can be compared.

extra.zh: 两步的 ΔG 方向他标反了。标准说法是：第一步是脱水（柠檬酸 → 顺乌头酸 + H2O），这一步吸能，是整个反应的热力学障碍；第二步是从双键另一侧反向加水（顺乌头酸 + H2O → 异柠檬酸），这一步放能。总反应柠檬酸 ⇌ 异柠檬酸 ΔG°′ ≈ +13.3 kJ/mol，整体是吸能的。他随后给出的驱动力解释——异柠檬酸被异柠檬酸脱氢酶不断消耗、把平衡拉过去——完全正确，只是挂到了错误的那一步上，本段内他没有自我更正。
extra.en: He inverted the ΔG signs of the two half-steps. The standard account: step one is a dehydration (citrate → cis-aconitate + H2O) and is the endergonic, thermodynamically difficult part; step two is rehydration from the opposite face (cis-aconitate + H2O → isocitrate) and is exergonic. Overall citrate ⇌ isocitrate has ΔG°′ ≈ +13.3 kJ/mol, endergonic. His driving-force explanation — isocitrate drained by isocitrate dehydrogenase pulls the equilibrium over — is entirely correct, just attached to the wrong half-step, and he does not correct it in this stretch.

extra.zh: 顺乌头酸酶的活性中心含一个 [4Fe-4S] 簇，但它不做氧化还原：簇里有一个铁不与半胱氨酸配位，空出的配位位点直接抓住底物的羟基和羧基，起 Lewis 酸的作用，帮助脱水/加水。这也是氟乙酸剧毒的原因——氟乙酰CoA 与草酰乙酸缩合成氟柠檬酸，把顺乌头酸酶不可逆地卡死，柠檬酸堆积、循环停摆，这就是经典的「致死性合成」。
extra.en: Aconitase carries a [4Fe-4S] cluster that does no redox chemistry. One iron of the cluster is not ligated by cysteine; its free coordination site binds the substrate's hydroxyl and carboxylate directly, acting as a Lewis acid during the dehydration/rehydration. This is why fluoroacetate is lethal: fluoroacetyl-CoA condenses with oxaloacetate to fluorocitrate, which locks aconitase irreversibly, citrate accumulates and the cycle stalls — the textbook case of lethal synthesis.

extra.zh: 「吸能反应靠产物消耗被推着走」这句话要说准：ΔG°′ 是标准态（各物 1 mol/L）下的值，细胞里真正决定方向的是 ΔG = ΔG°′ + RT·ln Q。异柠檬酸浓度被压得很低，Q 很小，ln Q 是大的负数，实际 ΔG 已经是负的——反应并不是「逆着热力学被硬推」，而是在细胞的真实浓度下本来就自发。平衡时这三者的混合物以柠檬酸为主（约九成），异柠檬酸只占不到一成。
extra.en: Say the driving-force argument precisely. ΔG°′ is the standard-state value (1 M each); direction in the cell is set by ΔG = ΔG°′ + RT·ln Q. Isocitrate is held very low, so Q is small, ln Q is a large negative number and the actual ΔG is already negative — the reaction is not being shoved uphill, it is downhill at real cellular concentrations. At equilibrium the mixture is dominated by citrate (around 90%), with isocitrate under 10%.

extra.zh: 柠檬酸看着完全对称，其实是前手性分子（prochiral）：它两条 —CH2COO− 臂在化学上等价，但酶用三点结合把它固定住以后，只对来自草酰乙酸的那一条臂动手。所以脱水/加水永远发生在同一侧，同位素标记进来的乙酰基碳，也就能被一路追踪下去——这正是后面「第一圈放出的两个 CO2 全来自草酰乙酸部分」这个经典结论的基础。
extra.en: Citrate looks symmetric but is prochiral: its two —CH2COO− arms are chemically equivalent, yet three-point binding at the enzyme fixes the molecule so that only the arm derived from oxaloacetate is acted on. The dehydration/rehydration therefore always happens on the same side, and isotopically labelled acetyl carbons can be followed through the cycle — the basis of the classic result that both CO2 released in the first turn come from the oxaloacetate part.

quiz.q_zh: 柠檬酸经顺乌头酸酶变成异柠檬酸这一步，在细胞里为什么能持续向前进行？
quiz.q_en: Why does the aconitase step, citrate to isocitrate, keep running forward in the cell?

options.zh: 酶偶联一分子 ATP 的水解，把吸能的异构化直接推过去
options.en: The enzyme couples hydrolysis of one ATP to push the endergonic isomerisation through

options.zh: 中间体顺乌头酸被铁硫簇氧化，放出的能量补偿了吸能
options.en: The cis-aconitate intermediate is oxidised by the Fe-S cluster, offsetting the uphill cost

options.zh: 总反应吸能，靠异柠檬酸被下游脱氢酶不断消耗而拉过去
options.en: The overall reaction is endergonic and is pulled over by isocitrate being drained downstream

options.zh: 总反应放能，是循环里三个不可逆调控位点当中的一个
options.en: The overall reaction is exergonic and is one of the cycle's three irreversible control points

quiz.explain_zh: 柠檬酸 ⇌ 异柠檬酸 ΔG°′ ≈ +13.3 kJ/mol，是吸能的，平衡偏向柠檬酸；异柠檬酸被异柠檬酸脱氢酶不断抽走，细胞内实际 ΔG 才是负的。说它放能、是不可逆调控位点不对——循环里三个不可逆调控步骤是柠檬酸合酶、异柠檬酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体，不含此步。顺乌头酸酶不消耗 ATP。它的 [4Fe-4S] 簇只作 Lewis 酸抓底物，全程不做氧化还原。
quiz.explain_en: Citrate ⇌ isocitrate has ΔG°′ ≈ +13.3 kJ/mol and lies toward citrate; the reaction is pulled forward because isocitrate dehydrogenase drains the product, making the in-cell ΔG negative. Calling it exergonic and a control point is wrong — the three irreversible regulatory steps are citrate synthase, isocitrate dehydrogenase and the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex. Aconitase consumes no ATP, and its [4Fe-4S] cluster acts only as a Lewis acid, doing no redox chemistry.

quiz.q_zh: 顺乌头酸酶把羟基从一个碳「搬」到相邻碳上，化学上实际发生的是什么？
quiz.q_en: Chemically, how does aconitase move the hydroxyl from one carbon to its neighbour?

options.zh: 羟基上的氢先交给 FAD，再经酮式互变异构回到醇式
options.en: The hydroxyl hydrogen goes to FAD, then keto-enol tautomerism restores the alcohol

options.zh: 磷酸基先转到羟基上活化，脱去磷酸后完成位置迁移
options.en: A phosphate is transferred onto the hydroxyl to activate it, then leaves after migration

options.zh: 先脱水生成顺乌头酸的双键，再从双键另一侧反向加水
options.en: Dehydration first gives the cis-aconitate double bond, then water adds back on the other face

options.zh: 铁硫簇先夺走羟基，酶的构象翻转后再把它放回邻位碳
options.en: The Fe-S cluster strips the hydroxyl, and a conformational flip returns it to the adjacent carbon

quiz.explain_zh: 顺乌头酸酶是 hydratase（水合酶）类：先脱一分子水生成顺乌头酸（一个真实可分离的中间体），再从双键的另一面加回一分子水，净结果就是羟基换到邻位碳。整个过程没有氧化还原，所以不涉及 FAD 交氢；也没有磷酸转移，酶不消耗 NTP；铁硫簇是配位抓底物的 Lewis 酸，不会把羟基「拿走再放回」。
quiz.explain_en: Aconitase is a hydratase: it removes one water to give cis-aconitate — a real, isolable intermediate — then adds water back across the opposite face, net-shifting the hydroxyl to the neighbouring carbon. No redox occurs, so no hydrogen goes to FAD; there is no phosphoryl transfer and no NTP is used; and the Fe-S cluster coordinates the substrate as a Lewis acid rather than abstracting and returning the hydroxyl.

title_zh: 异柠檬酸脱氢酶：第一个产能步骤与脱下的那个 CO2
title_en: Isocitrate dehydrogenase: the first energy-yielding step and where the CO2 comes from

points.zh: 他约定：凡是产生能量的地方都用绿色标出来，而这里是 TCA 循环里第一次遇到产生能量的步骤。
points.en: He set a convention: every energy-yielding step gets marked in green, and this is the first such step encountered in the cycle.

points.zh: 底物是异柠檬酸 isocitrate，酶是异柠檬酸脱氢酶 isocitrate dehydrogenase。
points.en: The substrate is isocitrate and the enzyme is isocitrate dehydrogenase.

points.zh: 这一步脱去一分子二氧化碳，他明确指出脱掉的是中间那个羧基，不是两端的。
points.en: The step releases one CO2, and he pointed out explicitly that it is the middle carboxyl group that goes, not one of the terminal ones.

points.zh: 他说脱二氧化碳时「顺便脱去了刚刚发生位移的那个羟基的一分子水」，把羟基变羰基描述成了脱水。
points.en: He said the decarboxylation also carries away one molecule of water from the hydroxyl that had just migrated, describing the hydroxyl-to-carbonyl change as a dehydration.

points.zh: 产物在这里变成羰基的形式，他把羟基改画到结构式下方，说这样跟课本图更匹配。
points.en: The product now carries a carbonyl; he redrew the hydroxyl at the bottom of the structure to match the textbook figure.

points.zh: 他指出课本图里把 COO− 画到了下面，而他自己更喜欢把羧基横着排开，说横着看更清楚。
points.en: He noted the textbook draws the COO− pointing down, whereas he prefers laying the carboxyls out horizontally, which he finds easier to read.

points.zh: 他解释图里那处标红是因为正常情况下这个基团不会画成直着连出来，但标红处本身是正确的，不影响理解。
points.en: He explained that the red mark in the figure is there because that group would not normally be drawn sticking straight out; the marked structure itself is correct.

points.zh: 他强调这一步开始才真正值得关注，因为 TCA 循环里他只打算讨论产生能量的步骤。
points.en: He stressed that this is where the cycle starts to matter, because he intends to discuss only the energy-yielding steps.

extra.zh: 「脱羧的时候顺便带走一分子水」是错的，这一步不放出水。真实次序是：C2 上的羟基先被氧化成酮——C–H 以氢负离子（H−）交给 NAD+，O–H 上的质子释放到溶液里——生成草酰琥珀酸（oxalosuccinate）；这个 β-酮酸再脱去中间的羧基放出 CO2。原来羟基上的那个氧一直留在分子里，变成 α-酮戊二酸的酮基氧。他是把「羟基变羰基」在画图上误当成了脱水，本段内没有自我更正。
extra.en: The claim that a water molecule leaves along with the CO2 is wrong; no water is released. The true order is: the C2 hydroxyl is oxidised to a ketone — the C–H leaves as hydride to NAD+, the O–H proton goes to solution — giving oxalosuccinate; this β-keto acid then loses its middle carboxyl as CO2. The oxygen of the original hydroxyl stays in the molecule as the keto oxygen of α-ketoglutarate. He mistook 'hydroxyl becomes carbonyl' on the drawing for a dehydration, and does not correct it here.

extra.zh: 氧化和脱羧是在同一个活性中心里连着做完的两步，中间体草酰琥珀酸不释放出来。Mn2+（或 Mg2+）的作用正在这里：β-脱羧会先生成一个烯醇式负离子，金属离子与相邻的羰基氧配位、把这个负电荷稳定住，脱羧才能顺利发生。所以「需要镁锰离子」不是可有可无的细节，而是 β-酮酸脱羧的普遍机制。
extra.en: Oxidation and decarboxylation happen back-to-back in the same active site; oxalosuccinate is never released. This is where Mn2+ (or Mg2+) earns its keep: β-decarboxylation passes through an enolate, and the metal ion coordinates the adjacent carbonyl oxygen to stabilise that negative charge. The metal requirement is not an incidental detail but the general mechanism of β-keto acid decarboxylation.

extra.zh: 异柠檬酸 → α-酮戊二酸 + CO2 的 ΔG°′ ≈ −8.4 kJ/mol，是明确的负值，所以这一步在生理条件下基本不可逆——和它前面那步（+13.3 kJ/mol、吸能）正好构成一对：吸能步被这个不可逆步骤拉着走。也正因为不可逆，它才有资格当调控点。
extra.en: Isocitrate → α-ketoglutarate + CO2 has ΔG°′ ≈ −8.4 kJ/mol, clearly negative, so the step is effectively irreversible under physiological conditions. It pairs with the preceding endergonic step (+13.3 kJ/mol): the uphill isomerisation is dragged along by this irreversible one. Irreversibility is also what qualifies it as a control point.

extra.zh: 这里脱掉的 CO2 的碳，来自草酰乙酸带进来的部分，不是这一圈刚缩合上去的乙酰基的两个碳。同位素标记的经典结论是：第一圈放出的两个 CO2 全部来自草酰乙酸；乙酰基的两个碳这一圈并不离开，要到后面几圈才被放出。所以「乙酰CoA 的两个碳变成两个 CO2」只在多圈的净计量上成立，不能按单圈的原子对应去理解。
extra.en: The carbon leaving as CO2 here comes from the oxaloacetate-derived part, not from the two acetyl carbons condensed on in this turn. The classic isotope result is that both CO2 released in the first turn come from oxaloacetate; the acetyl carbons do not leave in that turn and only appear as CO2 in later ones. 'The two carbons of acetyl-CoA become two CO2' holds as multi-turn bookkeeping, not as atom-by-atom accounting within one turn.

quiz.q_zh: 异柠檬酸脱氢酶这一步，原来 C2 羟基上的那个氧原子最后去了哪里？
quiz.q_en: In the isocitrate dehydrogenase step, where does the oxygen of the original C2 hydroxyl end up?

options.zh: 留在分子里，成为 α-酮戊二酸的酮基氧
options.en: It stays in the molecule as the keto oxygen of α-ketoglutarate

options.zh: 以一分子水离开，供延胡索酸酶那一步回收
options.en: It leaves as water, later recycled at the fumarase step

options.zh: 随脱下的二氧化碳一起离开，进入线粒体基质
options.en: It leaves together with the CO2 and enters the mitochondrial matrix

options.zh: 转移到 NAD+ 的烟酰胺环上，一起形成 NADH
options.en: It is transferred to the nicotinamide ring of NAD+ to form NADH

quiz.explain_zh: 羟基被氧化成酮，氧原子原地留下变成 α-酮戊二酸的酮基氧；老师说的「顺便带走一分子水」并不发生。脱下的 CO2 来自中间那个羧基，带走的是羧基自己的两个氧。NAD+ 接受的是氢负离子，只拿走 C–H 上的氢和两个电子，不带氧。
quiz.explain_en: The hydroxyl is oxidised to a ketone and its oxygen stays put as the keto oxygen of α-ketoglutarate; no water leaves, contrary to what was said in the lecture. The CO2 that departs comes from the middle carboxyl and takes that carboxyl's own two oxygens. NAD+ accepts a hydride — the C–H hydrogen plus two electrons — and carries no oxygen.

quiz.q_zh: 异柠檬酸氧化脱羧的正确次序和中间产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the correct order of events, and the intermediate, in the oxidative decarboxylation of isocitrate?

options.zh: 先与 CoA 缩合成硫酯，再脱羧并把电子交给 NAD+
options.en: Condensation with CoA to a thioester first, then decarboxylation with electrons to NAD+

options.zh: 先脱羧生成琥珀酸半醛，再被氧化成 α-酮戊二酸
options.en: Decarboxylation first gives succinate semialdehyde, then oxidation to α-ketoglutarate

options.zh: 先氧化 C2 羟基生成草酰琥珀酸，再 β-脱羧放出 CO2
options.en: The C2 hydroxyl is oxidised to oxalosuccinate first, then β-decarboxylation releases CO2

options.zh: 先脱水生成顺乌头酸，再水解掉中间的那个羧基
options.en: Dehydration to cis-aconitate first, then hydrolytic removal of the middle carboxyl

quiz.explain_zh: 氧化在前、脱羧在后，中间体是草酰琥珀酸这个 β-酮酸，酮基使 β-羧基容易脱去，Mn2+/Mg2+ 稳定烯醇负离子。琥珀酸半醛是 GABA 支路的中间体，不出现在这里；脱水生成顺乌头酸是上一步顺乌头酸酶干的事；与 CoA 缩合成硫酯是下一步 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体的特征，异柠檬酸脱氢酶不用 CoA。
quiz.explain_en: Oxidation comes first, decarboxylation second, via the β-keto acid oxalosuccinate; the keto group makes the β-carboxyl easy to lose and Mn2+/Mg2+ stabilises the enolate. Succinate semialdehyde belongs to the GABA shunt, not here; dehydration to cis-aconitate is the preceding aconitase step; and thioester formation with CoA is the signature of the next enzyme, the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex — isocitrate dehydrogenase uses no CoA.

title_zh: 第一个 NADH、IDH 的两种同工酶，以及把羧基横着画的记图法
title_en: The first NADH, the two isocitrate dehydrogenase isozymes, and drawing carboxyls horizontally

points.zh: 他说这是 TCA 循环第一步产生能量的地方，在脱氢酶这里获得一分子 NADH。
points.en: He called this the cycle's first energy-yielding step, giving one NADH at the dehydrogenase.

points.zh: 他说 NADH 上的氢来自刚刚从中间挪下来的那个羟基上的氢原子。
points.en: He said the hydrogen on NADH comes from the hydroxyl that had just been repositioned.

points.zh: 他讲异柠檬酸脱氢酶在体内有两种同工酶，问学生还记不记得同工酶的定义。
points.en: He noted that isocitrate dehydrogenase exists as two isozymes and asked the student to recall what an isozyme is.

points.zh: 他给的同工酶定义是：不同的酶、长得比较像，但发挥的功能完全一模一样，都催化这一个反应。
points.en: His definition of an isozyme: different enzymes that look alike and whose function is exactly identical, both catalysing this one reaction.

points.zh: 两种同工酶的区别在辅酶：一种以 NAD 为辅酶，另一种以 NADP 为辅酶，两种在体内都有。
points.en: The two differ in cofactor: one uses NAD, the other NADP, and both are present in the body.

points.zh: 他明确本课只讨论以 NAD 为辅酶、最终产生 NADH 的那一种。
points.en: He stated that the course will follow only the NAD-dependent form, the one that yields NADH.

points.zh: 他补充说这些酶都需要镁离子和锰离子参与，但当场判断这一点不很重要。
points.en: He added that these enzymes require Mg2+ and Mn2+, while judging that detail unimportant for now.

points.zh: 学生提问碳数对不上——上面的图看着有四个碳、下面只画了三个；他确认是同一个分子，只是右边那个羧基被挪到了下方。
points.en: The student asked why the carbon count seemed off — four carbons above, three drawn below; he confirmed it is the same molecule with the right-hand carboxyl moved to the bottom.

points.zh: 他借机说明自己的记图法：把所有羧基横过来排成一条线，每一步 COOH 到底在哪就一目了然，因为这一步最容易把人搞昏头。
points.en: He used the moment to explain his drawing convention: lay all the carboxyls out horizontally so the position of each COOH is obvious at every step, since this is the point where people most easily lose track.

extra.zh: 「两种同工酶功能完全一模一样」讲过头了。同工酶的标准定义是催化同一个化学反应，但在动力学、调控和组织/亚细胞分布上不同。NAD+ 型只在线粒体基质、被 ADP 和 Ca2+ 激活、被 ATP 和 NADH 抑制，承担 TCA 循环的通量；NADP+ 型线粒体和胞质都有，主要任务是提供 NADPH 给生物合成和抗氧化系统（GSH/Trx），并不跑循环的通量。化学反应相同，生理功能并不相同。
extra.en: 'Exactly the same function' overstates it. The standard definition of isozymes is enzymes catalysing the same reaction but differing in kinetics, regulation and tissue/subcellular distribution. The NAD+-dependent form is matrix-only, activated by ADP and Ca2+, inhibited by ATP and NADH, and carries the cycle's flux; the NADP+-dependent form occurs in both matrix and cytosol and mainly supplies NADPH for biosynthesis and antioxidant systems (GSH/Trx), carrying no cycle flux. Same chemistry, different physiology.

extra.zh: NAD+ 型异柠檬酸脱氢酶是哺乳动物 TCA 循环公认的主要限速点，而且是变构酶：ADP 降低它对异柠檬酸的 Km（能量不足就加速），Ca2+ 同样激活（肌肉收缩、激素信号时把循环拉快），ATP 和 NADH 则是抑制剂。记忆抓手是「底物是异柠檬酸、油门是 ADP/Ca2+、刹车是 ATP/NADH」。
extra.en: The NAD+-dependent isocitrate dehydrogenase is the accepted main rate-limiting point of the mammalian TCA cycle and is allosteric: ADP lowers its Km for isocitrate (low energy charge speeds it up), Ca2+ likewise activates it (linking contraction and hormonal signals to cycle rate), while ATP and NADH inhibit. The handle is: substrate isocitrate, accelerator ADP/Ca2+, brake ATP/NADH.

extra.zh: 「羟基上的氢给了 NADH」要说细一点：NAD+ 接受的是一个氢负离子（H−，即一个质子加两个电子），来自 C2 上的 C–H；羟基 O–H 上的那个质子是单独释放到溶液里的。所以配平写成 isocitrate + NAD+ → α-KG + CO2 + NADH + H+，那个游离的 H+ 就是它。「脱两个氢」是口语简写，实际是一个氢负离子加一个质子。
extra.en: Be precise about which hydrogen goes where: NAD+ accepts a hydride (H−, one proton plus two electrons) taken from the C2 C–H, while the hydroxyl's O–H proton is released separately into solution. Hence the balanced equation isocitrate + NAD+ → α-KG + CO2 + NADH + H+, where that free H+ is the hydroxyl proton. 'Removing two hydrogens' is shorthand for one hydride plus one proton.

extra.zh: NADH 和 NADPH 只差 2′ 位的一个磷酸，却分工严格：NADH 走分解代谢，把电子送进电子传递链换 ATP，细胞把 NAD+/NADH 比维持得很高（氧化态为主，随时能收电子）；NADPH 走合成代谢和抗氧化（脂肪酸合成、谷胱甘肽还原酶），细胞把 NADPH/NADP+ 比维持得很高（还原态为主，随时能给电子）。两个池子由不同的酶维持，不混用。
extra.en: NADH and NADPH differ only by a 2′-phosphate yet are functionally segregated: NADH serves catabolism, delivering electrons to the respiratory chain for ATP, and the cell keeps the NAD+/NADH ratio high (mostly oxidised, ready to accept electrons); NADPH serves biosynthesis and antioxidant defence (fatty acid synthesis, glutathione reductase), and the cell keeps NADPH/NADP+ high (mostly reduced, ready to donate). Separate enzymes maintain the two pools and they are not interchangeable.

quiz.q_zh: 老师说 IDH 的 NAD+ 型和 NADP+ 型同工酶「功能完全一模一样」。标准生化怎么讲？
quiz.q_en: The lecture called the NAD+- and NADP+-dependent isocitrate dehydrogenase isozymes 'functionally identical'. What is the standard account?

options.zh: 催化同一反应，两者都受 ADP 激活、被 ATP 与 NADH 抑制
options.en: They catalyse the same reaction and both are ADP-activated, ATP- and NADH-inhibited

options.zh: 催化同一反应，但调控、定位和生理任务三方面都不相同
options.en: They catalyse the same reaction but differ in regulation, localisation and physiological role

options.zh: 催化不同的反应，只是两者的底物结构比较相近而已
options.en: They catalyse different reactions and merely act on structurally similar substrates

options.zh: 催化同一反应，NADP+ 型才是循环通量的主要承担者
options.en: They catalyse the same reaction, and the NADP+ form carries most of the cycle flux

quiz.explain_zh: 同工酶的定义就是催化同一反应而在动力学、调控和分布上不同，这一对正是标准例子：NAD+ 型在基质、受 ADP/Ca2+ 激活、ATP/NADH 抑制、承担循环通量；NADP+ 型基质和胞质都有，主要供 NADPH 给合成与抗氧化。说它们催化不同反应不成立；说 NADP+ 型承担通量把两者的角色调了个个儿；变构调控是 NAD+ 型的特征，NADP+ 型并不这样被 ADP 调节。
quiz.explain_en: Isozymes by definition catalyse the same reaction while differing in kinetics, regulation and distribution, and this pair is the textbook case: the NAD+ form is matrix-restricted, ADP/Ca2+-activated, ATP/NADH-inhibited and carries cycle flux, while the NADP+ form occurs in matrix and cytosol supplying NADPH for biosynthesis and antioxidant defence. They do not catalyse different reactions; assigning the flux to the NADP+ form reverses their roles; and the allosteric ADP regulation belongs to the NAD+ form only.

quiz.q_zh: 在这一步，NAD+ 从底物那里接受的到底是什么？
quiz.q_en: What exactly does NAD+ accept from the substrate at this step?

options.zh: 一个电子和一个质子，中途形成半醌型的自由基
options.en: One electron and one proton, passing through a semiquinone radical

options.zh: 一个氢负离子，同时另一个质子被释放到周围溶液里
options.en: A hydride, while the other proton is released into the surrounding solution

options.zh: 两个完整的氢原子，一起加到烟酰胺环的 C4 位上
options.en: Two intact hydrogen atoms, added together to C4 of the nicotinamide ring

options.zh: 两个电子和两个质子，生成 NADH2 这样一种形式
options.en: Two electrons and two protons, giving a species written as NADH2

quiz.explain_zh: NAD+ 是双电子受体，接受的是氢负离子（H−）加到烟酰胺环 C4 上，剩下那个质子进溶液，所以方程要写 NADH + H+，没有 NADH2 这种物种。两个完整氢原子一起加是 FAD 的行为；单电子转移经半醌自由基则是黄素和铁硫簇的特长，NAD+ 不走这条路。
quiz.explain_en: NAD+ is an obligate two-electron acceptor: it takes a hydride onto C4 of the nicotinamide ring while the remaining proton goes to solution, which is why the equation reads NADH + H+ — there is no NADH2 species. Adding two whole hydrogen atoms is flavin behaviour, and one-electron transfer through a semiquinone is characteristic of flavins and Fe-S clusters, not of NAD+.

quiz.q_zh: 老师提到这些酶「需要镁离子和锰离子」。二价金属在这个反应里做什么？
quiz.q_en: The lecture mentioned that these enzymes 'need Mg2+ and Mn2+'. What do the divalent metals actually do here?

options.zh: 中和 NAD+ 上的负电荷，帮助它进入酶的活性中心
options.en: Neutralise the negative charge on NAD+ so it can enter the active site

options.zh: 与硫辛酰胺配位成键，固定住那条摆臂的摆动方向
options.en: Coordinate lipoamide to fix the swinging arm's direction of motion

options.zh: 作为电子中转站，把电子从底物一路传给 NAD+
options.en: Serve as an electron relay, passing electrons from substrate to NAD+

options.zh: 稳定 β-脱羧时生成的烯醇式负离子这个中间体
options.en: Stabilise the enolate intermediate formed during β-decarboxylation

quiz.explain_zh: 草酰琥珀酸脱去 β-羧基时先形成烯醇式负离子，金属离子与相邻羰基氧配位把负电荷稳定住，这是 β-酮酸脱羧的通用机制。电子从底物到 NAD+ 是直接的氢负离子转移，不需要金属中转；NAD+ 的结合靠酶的 Rossmann 折叠而非电荷中和；硫辛酰胺摆臂属于 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体的 E2，与这一步无关。
quiz.explain_en: Losing the β-carboxyl from oxalosuccinate goes through an enolate, and the metal coordinates the adjacent carbonyl oxygen to stabilise that charge — the general mechanism for β-keto acid decarboxylation. Electron transfer to NAD+ is a direct hydride transfer needing no metal relay; NAD+ binding is handled by the enzyme's Rossmann fold rather than charge neutralisation; and the lipoamide swinging arm belongs to E2 of the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex, not to this step.

title_zh: α-酮戊二酸的名字拆解与 α-KGDH 复合体：和 PDH 是一套班底
title_en: Parsing the name α-ketoglutarate, and the α-KGDH complex as a copy of PDH

points.zh: 他说整个 TCA 循环的调控没有什么可讲的，教材也不强调调控，只强调能量的变化。
points.en: He said there is little to say about regulation of the TCA cycle, and that the textbook stresses energy changes rather than control.

points.zh: 他小结上一步：这是第一次获得一个 NADH，紧接着的下一步又是一个产能过程，两个产能步骤紧密相连。
points.en: He summed up: that was the first NADH, and the very next step is another energy-yielding one — two such steps back to back.

points.zh: 他补上刚才漏掉的名字：上一步的产物叫 α-酮戊二酸，英文 α-ketoglutarate。
points.en: He supplied the name he had skipped: the previous product is α-ketoglutarate.

points.zh: 他拆解命名：keto 指的是图上蓝色那一小部分，就是酮基；glutarate 对应中文的戊二酸。
points.en: He parsed the name: 'keto' refers to the ketone group highlighted in blue, and 'glutarate' corresponds to the Chinese 戊二酸.

points.zh: 他按甲乙丙丁戊数碳：中间三个碳加两端两个羧基，所以叫戊（五碳）二酸。
points.en: He counted carbons with the classical Chinese ordinals: three middle carbons plus two terminal carboxyls, hence a five-carbon diacid.

points.zh: 下一步的酶是 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体，他指出凡是叫「复合体」的都是比较大的酶。
points.en: The next enzyme is the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex; he noted that anything called a complex is a large enzyme.

points.zh: 他说这个复合体位于线粒体的基质里（先说成线粒体的细胞质，同一句自纠为基质）。
points.en: He placed the complex in the mitochondrial matrix, first misspeaking as 'mitochondrial cytoplasm' and correcting himself within the same sentence.

points.zh: 他说丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体是在线粒体的内膜上，并把定位不同当成这两个复合体的区别。
points.en: He said the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex sits on the inner membrane, and presented this difference in location as what distinguishes the two complexes.

points.zh: 他强调两者其余部分很像：同样分 E1、E2、E3 三个组分，同样用 TPP、FAD 作辅酶，NAD 进来带走一分子氢。
points.en: He stressed how alike they otherwise are: both split into E1, E2 and E3, both use TPP and FAD as cofactors, and NAD comes in to take away the hydrogen.

extra.zh: 他把 PDH 复合体放在线粒体内膜上，并当成它与 α-KGDH 的区别。真核细胞里这两个复合体都在线粒体基质中：PDH 复合体只是常与内膜的基质侧疏松结合，并不是内膜整合蛋白，底物和产物（乙酰CoA、NADH、CO2）都在基质里。两者定位并无差别，真正的区别在底物（丙酮酸 vs α-酮戊二酸）和 E2 转移的酰基（乙酰基 vs 琥珀酰基）。多位校对独立记到这一点，说明是他反复出现的固定说法，全程没有自纠。TCA 八个酶里唯一嵌在内膜上的是琥珀酸脱氢酶（复合体 II）。
extra.en: He puts the PDH complex on the inner membrane and treats that as its difference from α-KGDH. In eukaryotes both complexes are in the mitochondrial matrix: PDH is merely loosely associated with the matrix face of the inner membrane, not an integral membrane protein, and its substrates and products (acetyl-CoA, NADH, CO2) are all in the matrix. Their locations do not differ; the real differences are the substrate (pyruvate vs α-ketoglutarate) and the acyl group E2 transfers (acetyl vs succinyl). Several proofreaders logged this independently, so it is a settled habit rather than a slip, and he never corrects it. The only TCA enzyme embedded in the inner membrane is succinate dehydrogenase (Complex II).

extra.zh: 「TCA 循环没什么调控可讲」是他的教学取舍，字面上与标准生化相反。循环有三个基本不可逆的步骤，也正是三个调控点：柠檬酸合酶（受 ATP、NADH、琥珀酰CoA 抑制）、异柠檬酸脱氢酶（ADP/Ca2+ 激活，ATP/NADH 抑制）和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体（被自己的产物琥珀酰CoA 和 NADH 抑制，被 Ca2+ 激活）。注意规律：三个点都被 NADH 抑制、都对能荷敏感，α-KGDH 还额外被产物反馈抑制。
extra.en: 'Nothing to say about regulation' is a teaching choice that reads, literally, as the opposite of standard biochemistry. The cycle has three essentially irreversible steps and they are precisely its three control points: citrate synthase (inhibited by ATP, NADH, succinyl-CoA), isocitrate dehydrogenase (activated by ADP/Ca2+, inhibited by ATP/NADH) and the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex (product-inhibited by succinyl-CoA and NADH, activated by Ca2+). Note the pattern: all three are NADH-inhibited and energy-charge sensitive, with α-KGDH additionally under product feedback.

extra.zh: α-KGDH 用到的五个辅因子与 PDH 完全相同：E1 的 TPP（硫胺素，维生素 B1）、E2 上共价连着的硫辛酰胺、CoA、E3 的 FAD（核黄素 B2）、以及 NAD+（烟酰胺 B3）。更妙的是 E3（二氢硫辛酰胺脱氢酶）在人体内就是同一个基因产物 DLD，被 PDH、α-KGDH 和支链酮酸脱氢酶三个复合体共用。所以缺 B1 时这两个复合体一起瘫痪——脚气病、Wernicke 脑病里血乳酸和丙酮酸同时升高，就是这个原因。
extra.en: α-KGDH uses the same five cofactors as PDH: TPP on E1 (thiamine, B1), lipoamide covalently attached to E2, CoA, FAD on E3 (riboflavin, B2) and NAD+ (niacin, B3). Better still, E3 (dihydrolipoamide dehydrogenase) is one and the same gene product, DLD, shared by PDH, α-KGDH and the branched-chain keto acid dehydrogenase complex. So thiamine deficiency knocks out both complexes at once — the reason blood lactate and pyruvate rise together in beriberi and Wernicke encephalopathy.

extra.zh: α-酮戊二酸 → 琥珀酰CoA + CO2 的 ΔG°′ ≈ −33.5 kJ/mol，是整个循环里负得最多的几步之一，和柠檬酸合酶（≈ −32 kJ/mol）一个量级，因此在生理条件下彻底不可逆——这是 α-KGDH 能当调控阀门的物理原因，也是循环只能单向转的原因之一。这与紧接着的琥珀酰CoA 合成酶（≈ −3 kJ/mol）形成鲜明对照。
extra.en: α-Ketoglutarate → succinyl-CoA + CO2 has ΔG°′ ≈ −33.5 kJ/mol, among the most negative in the cycle and comparable to citrate synthase (≈ −32 kJ/mol), hence completely irreversible physiologically. That is the physical reason α-KGDH can act as a control valve and part of why the cycle turns in one direction only — in sharp contrast with the very next step, succinyl-CoA synthetase at about −3 kJ/mol.

quiz.q_zh: 真核细胞里，丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体的定位关系是什么？
quiz.q_en: In eukaryotic cells, how are the pyruvate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complexes located relative to each other?

options.zh: 两者都在线粒体基质，PDH 只是常与内膜内侧疏松结合
options.en: Both are in the matrix, PDH merely associating loosely with the inner membrane's matrix face

options.zh: 两者都嵌在线粒体内膜上，催化结构域朝基质一侧伸出
options.en: Both are embedded in the inner membrane with catalytic domains projecting into the matrix

options.zh: PDH 位于膜间隙，α-KGDH 在基质，靠丙酮酸载体连通
options.en: PDH sits in the intermembrane space and α-KGDH in the matrix, linked by the pyruvate carrier

options.zh: PDH 嵌在线粒体内膜上，α-KGDH 游离在线粒体基质里
options.en: PDH is embedded in the inner membrane while α-KGDH floats free in the matrix

quiz.explain_zh: 两个复合体都是基质中的可溶性大分子机器，PDH 只是常贴在内膜的基质面上，底物和产物都在基质里，所以老师用定位来区分两者是不成立的；真正的区别在底物和 E2 转移的酰基种类。膜间隙里没有 PDH，那里是细胞色素 c 的地盘。TCA 八个酶里唯一真正整合进内膜的是琥珀酸脱氢酶。
quiz.explain_en: Both complexes are soluble matrix machines; PDH merely rests against the matrix face of the inner membrane, with substrates and products all in the matrix, so location cannot distinguish the two — substrate and the acyl group transferred by E2 do. There is no PDH in the intermembrane space, which is cytochrome c's territory, and the only genuinely membrane-integral TCA enzyme is succinate dehydrogenase.

quiz.q_zh: α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体用到的五个辅因子是哪一组？
quiz.q_en: Which set of five cofactors does the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex use?

options.zh: 硫胺素、硫辛酰胺、泛醌、FAD、NADP+
options.en: Thiamine, lipoamide, ubiquinone, FAD, NADP+

options.zh: 生物素、硫辛酰胺、CoA、FMN、NAD+
options.en: Biotin, lipoamide, CoA, FMN, NAD+

options.zh: TPP、磷酸吡哆醛、CoA、FAD、NADP+
options.en: TPP, pyridoxal phosphate, CoA, FAD, NADP+

options.zh: TPP、硫辛酰胺、CoA、FAD、NAD+
options.en: TPP, lipoamide, CoA, FAD, NAD+

quiz.explain_zh: 五个辅因子与 PDH 完全一致：E1 用 TPP，E2 携带硫辛酰胺并把琥珀酰基交给 CoA，E3 用 FAD 把二氢硫辛酰胺重新氧化，电子最后交给 NAD+。生物素是丙酮酸羧化酶等羧化反应的辅酶；磷酸吡哆醛是转氨酶的辅酶；泛醌在内膜里给电子传递链当载体，不进这个复合体；这一步的受体是 NAD+ 而不是 NADP+。
quiz.explain_en: The five cofactors are exactly those of PDH: TPP on E1, lipoamide on E2 handing the succinyl group to CoA, FAD on E3 to reoxidise dihydrolipoamide, and finally NAD+ as electron acceptor. Biotin belongs to carboxylases such as pyruvate carboxylase, pyridoxal phosphate to transaminases, and ubiquinone is a membrane carrier of the respiratory chain, not part of this complex; the acceptor here is NAD+, not NADP+.

title_zh: 硫酯键的形成、NADH 的氢到底从哪来，以及脱羧次数的算法
title_en: Forming the thioester, where NADH's hydrogen really comes from, and counting the decarboxylations

points.zh: 他把这一步和丙酮酸脱氢酶反应并排讲：丙酮酸上的 COOH 在脱氢酶作用下脱掉，剩下的部分连到 CoA 的硫上。
points.en: He taught this step alongside the pyruvate dehydrogenase reaction: pyruvate's COOH is removed by the dehydrogenase and the remainder is attached to CoA's sulfur.

points.zh: α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体这里完全一样：那个 COOH 直接脱掉，产物连上 CoA 形成 S-CoA。
points.en: The α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex does the same thing: the COOH comes straight off and the product is joined to CoA as an S-CoA.

points.zh: 他说羧酸脱掉以后形成的硫连接在 CoA 的半胱氨酸上面，就成了琥珀酰CoA 这个玩意。
points.en: He said that once the carboxyl leaves, the sulfur linkage forms on CoA's cysteine, giving succinyl-CoA.

points.zh: 他说在这个过程中同样产生一分子 NADH。
points.en: He said one NADH is likewise produced in this process.

points.zh: 学生问那个硫是不是永远跟 CoA 连着，他确认是，说这个硫就是 CoA 的半胱氨酸基团 cysteine 上的硫，为的是把底物绑在反应里。
points.en: Asked whether the sulfur always stays with CoA, he confirmed it does, saying the sulfur is that of CoA's cysteine group, which keeps the substrate tied into the reaction.

points.zh: 他解释「为什么叫脱氢酶」：他说脱的是 cysteine 上的氢，就是把 SH 上的氢脱掉给了 NADH。
points.en: He explained the name 'dehydrogenase' by saying the enzyme removes the hydrogen of the cysteine SH and gives it to NADH.

points.zh: 他小结两个脱氢酶复合体走的反应基本相似，产物都是一个连着 S-CoA 的酰基化合物。
points.en: He summarised that the two dehydrogenase complexes run essentially parallel reactions, both giving an acyl compound bearing S-CoA.

points.zh: 他把这一步称为整个 TCA 循环中第二步脱羧反应，并说第一步是丙酮酸脱去一分子二氧化碳。
points.en: He called this the second decarboxylation of the TCA cycle, counting pyruvate losing CO2 as the first.

points.zh: 他又说这一步没什么可讲的，因为没有调控；并说 TCA 循环之所以恶心难记，就是因为缺少能加深记忆的调控故事，只剩结构变来变去和能量的进出。
points.en: He again said there is little to discuss because there is no regulation, and that the TCA cycle is so hard to memorise precisely because it lacks a regulatory story — only structures changing and energy going in and out.

extra.zh: 「NADH 的氢是从 CoA 的 SH 上脱下来的」不对。CoA 巯基上的质子只是在形成硫酯键时被释放掉，与 NADH 无关。还原当量来自底物本身：E1 上的 TPP 亲核进攻 α-酮戊二酸的 C2、脱羧生成羟酰-TPP 中间体，这个中间体被氧化，电子交给 E2 的硫辛酰胺二硫键（同时酰基转过去，生成二氢硫辛酰胺），最后 E3 的 FAD 把两个巯基重新氧化成二硫键，电子经 FADH2 交给 NAD+。所以脱下的氢来自 α-酮戊二酸的 C1–C2 部分，不是来自 CoA。
extra.en: 'NADH's hydrogen is stripped from CoA's SH' is wrong. The CoA thiol's proton is simply released when the thioester forms and has nothing to do with NADH. The reducing equivalents come from the substrate: TPP on E1 attacks C2 of α-ketoglutarate and decarboxylation gives a hydroxyacyl-TPP intermediate; that intermediate is oxidised, its electrons going to the lipoamide disulfide on E2 (which simultaneously receives the acyl group, leaving dihydrolipoamide); finally FAD on E3 reoxidises the two thiols to the disulfide and passes the electrons via FADH2 to NAD+. The hydrogens therefore come from the C1–C2 portion of α-ketoglutarate, not from CoA.

extra.zh: CoA 的巯基不在半胱氨酸残基上。CoA = 泛酸（维生素 B5）+ β-巯基乙胺 + 3′-磷酸腺苷；那个 —SH 长在 β-巯基乙胺（cysteamine）臂的末端，而 β-巯基乙胺确实是半胱氨酸脱羧的产物，所以「像半胱氨酸」但并不是蛋白质里的半胱氨酸残基。真正长在蛋白质上的是 E2 的硫辛酰胺——它通过酰胺键接在一个赖氨酸的 ε-氨基上，形成一条约 1.4 nm 的摆臂，在 E1、E2、E3 三个活性中心之间来回递送酰基。
extra.en: CoA's thiol does not sit on a cysteine residue. CoA = pantothenate (vitamin B5) + β-mercaptoethylamine + 3′-phosphoadenosine, and the —SH is at the end of the β-mercaptoethylamine (cysteamine) arm. Cysteamine is indeed the decarboxylation product of cysteine, so it resembles cysteine without being a protein cysteine residue. What is genuinely protein-attached is E2's lipoamide, joined by an amide bond to a lysine ε-amino group to make a swinging arm about 1.4 nm long that ferries the acyl group between the E1, E2 and E3 active sites.

extra.zh: 脱羧的计数要改。丙酮酸脱羧是 PDH 复合体做的，发生在循环之外，是循环的入口反应，不算循环内部的一次。循环内部只有两次氧化脱羧：异柠檬酸脱氢酶（第一次，他自己刚讲过）和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体（第二次）。按他的算法，异柠檬酸那一次被漏掉了。记法：六碳的柠檬酸转一圈变回四碳的草酰乙酸，中间必须掉两个碳，一次在 IDH，一次在 α-KGDH。
extra.en: The count needs fixing. Pyruvate decarboxylation is done by the PDH complex outside the cycle, as its entry reaction, and does not count as one of the cycle's own. Inside the cycle there are exactly two oxidative decarboxylations: isocitrate dehydrogenase (the first, which he had just taught) and the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex (the second). His count silently drops the isocitrate one. The mnemonic: six-carbon citrate must shed two carbons to return to four-carbon oxaloacetate — one at IDH, one at α-KGDH.

extra.zh: 硫酯键为什么是高能键：普通酯的羰基能与氧的孤对电子共振稳定，而硫的 3p 轨道与碳的 2p 轨道重叠差，共振稳定几乎没有，所以酰基-S-CoA 的羰基又活泼、水解又放能，ΔG°′ ≈ −31 到 −33 kJ/mol，与 ATP 水解（≈ −30.5）同一量级。这正是后面琥珀酰CoA 合成酶能把这份能量存成一个 GTP 的本钱，也是柠檬酸合酶那一步能自发缩合的原因。
extra.en: Why the thioester is a high-energy bond: in an ordinary ester the carbonyl is resonance-stabilised by the oxygen lone pair, but sulfur's 3p orbitals overlap poorly with carbon's 2p, so that stabilisation is largely absent. The acyl-S-CoA carbonyl is therefore both reactive and exergonic on hydrolysis, ΔG°′ ≈ −31 to −33 kJ/mol, on a par with ATP hydrolysis (≈ −30.5). That is the capital succinyl-CoA synthetase later converts into one GTP, and the same reason the citrate synthase condensation runs spontaneously.

quiz.q_zh: 老师说 NADH 上的氢是从 CoA 半胱氨酸的 SH 上脱下来的。还原当量真正来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: The lecture said NADH's hydrogen is stripped from the SH of CoA's cysteine. Where do the reducing equivalents really come from?

options.zh: CoA 巯基上的质子，在硫酯键形成时被直接交给 NAD+
options.en: The CoA thiol proton, handed straight to NAD+ as the thioester forms

options.zh: 底物的 C1–C2 部分，经硫辛酰胺和 E3 的 FAD 传给 NAD+
options.en: The substrate's C1–C2 portion, relayed via lipoamide and E3's FAD to NAD+

options.zh: E1 上 TPP 噻唑环的活泼氢，脱羧之后被 NAD+ 直接夺走
options.en: The reactive thiazolium hydrogen of TPP on E1, taken by NAD+ after decarboxylation

options.zh: 基质中的自由质子，由复合体在脱羧的同时顺便收集起来
options.en: Free protons in the matrix, collected by the complex during decarboxylation

quiz.explain_zh: 氧化发生在羟酰-TPP 中间体上，电子交给 E2 的硫辛酰胺（生成二氢硫辛酰胺），再由 E3 的 FAD 传给 NAD+，所以氢来自底物的 C1–C2。CoA 巯基的质子只是成键时释放，不进 NADH；TPP 噻唑环上的活泼氢是它形成碳负离子的地方，不是被氧化的对象；NAD+ 接的是氢负离子而不是溶液里随手捞的质子。
quiz.explain_en: Oxidation occurs at the hydroxyacyl-TPP intermediate, its electrons passing to E2's lipoamide (giving dihydrolipoamide) and then via E3's FAD to NAD+, so the hydrogens come from the substrate's C1–C2. The CoA thiol proton is merely released on bond formation and never reaches NADH; the reactive thiazolium hydrogen of TPP is where the ylide carbanion forms, not the species oxidised; and NAD+ takes a hydride rather than scavenging free protons.

quiz.q_zh: 琥珀酰CoA 里的那个硫来自 CoA 的哪一部分？
quiz.q_en: Which part of CoA provides the sulfur in succinyl-CoA?

options.zh: 3′-磷酸腺苷上的硫代磷酸基
options.en: A thiophosphate on the 3′-phosphoadenosine

options.zh: 蛋白质里的一个半胱氨酸残基
options.en: A cysteine residue of the protein

options.zh: 硫辛酰胺二硫键中的一个硫
options.en: One sulfur of the lipoamide disulfide

options.zh: β-巯基乙胺臂末端的那个巯基
options.en: The thiol at the tip of the β-mercaptoethylamine arm

quiz.explain_zh: CoA 由泛酸、β-巯基乙胺和 3′-磷酸腺苷三段构成，酰基就接在 β-巯基乙胺末端的 —SH 上。它是半胱氨酸脱羧的产物，所以老师说成半胱氨酸是可以理解的误记，但 CoA 是小分子载体，里面没有蛋白质残基。硫辛酰胺的两个硫属于 E2 上的摆臂，酰基只是路过；3′-磷酸腺苷那一段只负责被酶识别，不含硫。
quiz.explain_en: CoA is built from pantothenate, β-mercaptoethylamine and 3′-phosphoadenosine, and the acyl group attaches to the —SH at the tip of the mercaptoethylamine arm. That group is the decarboxylation product of cysteine, which makes the lecture's slip understandable, but CoA is a small-molecule carrier with no protein residues. The lipoamide sulfurs belong to E2's swinging arm, which the acyl group only passes through, and the 3′-phosphoadenosine moiety is a recognition handle containing no sulfur.

quiz.q_zh: 按标准生化，TCA 循环内部的两次氧化脱羧分别由哪两个酶完成？
quiz.q_en: By the standard account, which two enzymes carry out the two oxidative decarboxylations inside the TCA cycle?

options.zh: 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体
options.en: The pyruvate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complexes

options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶和琥珀酰CoA 合成酶这两个不可逆步骤
options.en: Citrate synthase and succinyl-CoA synthetase, the two irreversible steps

options.zh: 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体和异柠檬酸脱氢酶
options.en: The pyruvate dehydrogenase complex and isocitrate dehydrogenase

options.zh: 异柠檬酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体
options.en: Isocitrate dehydrogenase and the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex

quiz.explain_zh: 六碳的柠檬酸要变回四碳的草酰乙酸，必须在循环内部掉两个碳：一次在异柠檬酸脱氢酶，一次在 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体。丙酮酸脱羧由 PDH 复合体在循环之外完成，是循环的入口反应，凡把它算进来的选法都少算了异柠檬酸那一次。柠檬酸合酶是缩合反应，琥珀酰CoA 合成酶做的是底物水平磷酸化，两者都不脱羧。
quiz.explain_en: Six-carbon citrate must shed two carbons to return to four-carbon oxaloacetate, once at isocitrate dehydrogenase and once at the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex. Pyruvate decarboxylation is performed by the PDH complex outside the cycle, as its entry reaction, so any pairing that includes it has quietly dropped the isocitrate step. Citrate synthase performs a condensation and succinyl-CoA synthetase a substrate-level phosphorylation; neither decarboxylates.

title_zh: 琥珀酰CoA 合成酶：名字的来历与循环里唯一的底物水平磷酸化
title_en: Succinyl-CoA synthetase: how it got its name, and the cycle's only substrate-level phosphorylation

points.zh: 他说凡是生成了带 CoA 的产物，都一定会很快被消耗掉，因为 CoA 还绑在酶上，而酶必须被循环利用。
points.en: He said anything carrying CoA must be consumed quickly, because CoA is still tied to the enzyme and the enzyme has to be recycled.

points.zh: 所以紧接着的下一步就是把 CoA 卸下来、把酶解放出来，这一步由琥珀酰CoA 合成酶完成。
points.en: Hence the very next step removes CoA and frees the enzyme, and it is done by succinyl-CoA synthetase.

points.zh: 他查英文名，读成 succineo CoA synthesis，并指出琥珀酸的英文是 succinate。
points.en: He looked up the English name, pronounced it as 'succineo CoA synthesis', and noted that succinate is the English for 琥珀酸.

points.zh: 他讲了酶名的来历：许多酶最初被发现时研究的是合成方向——由底物和 CoA 生成产物，可能还不是在 TCA 循环里，而是别的途径里类似的反应，所以被叫成合成酶。
points.en: He gave the naming history: many enzymes were first found running in the synthetic direction — substrate plus CoA making the product, possibly in another pathway with a similar reaction — and so were named synthetases.

points.zh: 他指出在 TCA 循环里这个酶主要走的是反方向，但名字保留了下来。
points.en: He pointed out that in the TCA cycle the enzyme mainly runs the reverse direction, yet the name stuck.

points.zh: 他说这一步不只是第一步，而且是唯一一步直接产生能量、直接产生 GTP 的反应。
points.en: He said this is not only the first but the only step that directly yields energy, directly making GTP.

points.zh: 他先说「琥珀酰CoA 的高能磷酸键」，随即自纠：不是高能磷酸键，是那个高能的硫键（硫酯键）。
points.en: He first said 'the high-energy phosphate bond of succinyl-CoA', then corrected himself on the spot: not a phosphate bond but the high-energy sulfur (thioester) bond.

points.zh: 他说这个键断开、CoA 离去时释放大量能量，能量直接给了 GDP/GTP。
points.en: He said breaking that bond as CoA leaves releases a large amount of energy, which is handed directly to GDP/GTP.

points.zh: 他给出这一步的标准自由能只有 −3，说这在生化反应里算比较低，向前进行的程度不高，但仍小于 0，而且底物一直被消耗，反应还是能顺利进行。
points.en: He gave the standard free energy as only −3, calling that low, so the step does not run strongly forward; but it is still below zero and the substrate is continuously consumed, so the reaction proceeds.

extra.zh: 「CoA 直接被丢掉、换上一个羟基」作为记账没问题，但真实机制是三次磷酸转移，而且每一步都把能量攥住不放：琥珀酰CoA + Pi 先生成琥珀酰磷酸（一个混合酸酐）；这个磷酸再转到活性中心一个组氨酸上，形成磷酸组氨酸中间体，同时释放琥珀酸；最后组氨酸上的磷酸转给 GDP 生成 GTP。如果真让水直接进攻硫酯，能量就以热的形式白白散掉，什么也存不下来——这正是「偶联」两个字的含义。
extra.en: 'CoA is simply dropped and replaced by a hydroxyl' works as bookkeeping, but the real mechanism is three phosphoryl transfers, each keeping hold of the energy: succinyl-CoA + Pi first gives succinyl phosphate, a mixed anhydride; that phosphoryl is then transferred to an active-site histidine to form a phosphohistidine intermediate, releasing succinate; finally the phosphoryl moves from histidine to GDP, making GTP. Letting water attack the thioester directly would dissipate the energy as heat and store nothing — which is exactly what 'coupling' means.

extra.zh: 英文里 synthase 和 synthetase 是有区别的，中文的合酶/合成酶正是照这个区分翻的：synthetase（合成酶）偶联核苷三磷酸的水解或生成，synthase（合酶）不偶联 NTP。所以这个酶叫「合成酶」的真正原因是它与 GTP/ATP 偶联，不只是他讲的历史命名；同理，柠檬酸那一步的酶不用 NTP，标准名就是柠檬酸合酶 citrate synthase。另外 synthesis 是「合成」这件事，在英文里从来不作酶名。他讲的命名史本身没有错，可以保留。
extra.en: English does distinguish synthase from synthetase, and the Chinese 合酶/合成酶 pair was coined to mirror it: a synthetase couples the hydrolysis or formation of a nucleoside triphosphate, a synthase does not. So this enzyme is a 合成酶 because it is coupled to GTP/ATP, not merely for the historical reason given; correspondingly the citrate step uses no NTP and is properly citrate synthase. And 'synthesis' names the process, never an enzyme. His account of the naming history itself is fine and worth keeping.

extra.zh: 哺乳动物有两种琥珀酰CoA 合成酶同工酶，共用一个 α 亚基而 β 亚基不同：G 型（SUCLG2，GDP 特异）主要在肝、肾等有糖异生和血红素合成需求的组织；A 型（SUCLA2，ADP 特异）主要在脑、心、骨骼肌。植物和多数细菌用 ADP 型直接生成 ATP。两者能量等价，核苷二磷酸激酶（NDPK）可以把 GTP 的 γ-磷酸转给 ADP，所以算 ATP 收支时统一记 1 个 ATP 当量。
extra.en: Mammals have two succinyl-CoA synthetase isozymes sharing an α subunit and differing in β: the G form (SUCLG2, GDP-specific) predominates in liver and kidney, tissues doing gluconeogenesis and haem synthesis, while the A form (SUCLA2, ADP-specific) predominates in brain, heart and skeletal muscle. Plants and most bacteria use the ADP form and make ATP directly. The two are energetically equivalent, since nucleoside diphosphate kinase can move the γ-phosphate of GTP onto ADP, so ATP accounting simply scores one ATP equivalent.

extra.zh: 「唯一直接产生能量的一步」要说准，否则会和「循环一圈产 3 个 NADH、1 个 FADH2」打架。准确的说法是：这是 TCA 循环里唯一的底物水平磷酸化，即唯一一步不经过电子传递链、直接把磷酸基装到核苷二磷酸上。其余四个产能步骤（IDH、α-KGDH、琥珀酸脱氢酶、苹果酸脱氢酶）产的是 NADH/FADH2，那是把电子存起来，要经氧化磷酸化才变成 ATP。
extra.en: 'The only step that directly yields energy' must be phrased carefully or it clashes with 'three NADH and one FADH2 per turn'. Precisely: this is the cycle's only substrate-level phosphorylation, the only step that puts a phosphoryl group onto a nucleoside diphosphate without going through the respiratory chain. The other four energy-yielding steps (IDH, α-KGDH, succinate dehydrogenase, malate dehydrogenase) bank electrons as NADH/FADH2, which become ATP only via oxidative phosphorylation.

quiz.q_zh: 琥珀酰CoA 合成酶把硫酯键的能量存成 GTP，中间要经过什么？
quiz.q_en: Succinyl-CoA synthetase banks the thioester energy as GTP — through what intermediate?

options.zh: 水进攻硫酯生成的四面体中间体
options.en: A tetrahedral intermediate from water attacking the thioester

options.zh: 酶活性中心组氨酸上的磷酸组氨酸
options.en: A phosphohistidine on an active-site histidine

options.zh: 底物上生成的 1,3-二磷酸甘油酸
options.en: A 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate formed on the substrate

options.zh: 与 FAD 结合的酰基-黄素高能中间体
options.en: An acyl-flavin high-energy intermediate bound to FAD

quiz.explain_zh: 机制是三次磷酸转移：琥珀酰CoA + Pi 生成琥珀酰磷酸，磷酸转到活性中心组氨酸成磷酸组氨酸，再转给 GDP 生成 GTP。水直接进攻硫酯确实会生成四面体中间体，但那是单纯水解，能量以热散失，做不出 GTP。1,3-二磷酸甘油酸是糖酵解里磷酸甘油酸激酶那一步的高能中间体，不在 TCA 循环里；酰基-黄素中间体在这个酶里根本不存在。
quiz.explain_en: The mechanism is three phosphoryl transfers: succinyl-CoA + Pi gives succinyl phosphate, the phosphoryl moves to an active-site histidine as phosphohistidine, and from there to GDP to make GTP. Water attacking the thioester would indeed give a tetrahedral intermediate, but that is plain hydrolysis, dissipating the energy as heat and yielding no GTP. 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate is the high-energy intermediate of the phosphoglycerate kinase step in glycolysis, not of this cycle, and no acyl-flavin intermediate exists in this enzyme.

quiz.q_zh: 英文里 synthase 和 synthetase 的区别是什么？
quiz.q_en: What distinguishes a synthase from a synthetase?

options.zh: synthase 催化的反应可逆，synthetase 催化的反应不可逆
options.en: Synthases catalyse reversible reactions and synthetases irreversible ones

options.zh: synthase 只用于分解代谢，synthetase 只用于合成代谢
options.en: A synthase serves catabolism only and a synthetase anabolism only

options.zh: synthetase 偶联核苷三磷酸的水解或生成，synthase 不偶联
options.en: A synthetase couples hydrolysis or formation of an NTP; a synthase does not

options.zh: synthetase 都是多亚基的复合体，synthase 都是单亚基的酶
options.en: Synthetases are multi-subunit complexes and synthases single-subunit enzymes

quiz.explain_zh: 区别就在是否偶联 NTP，中文的合酶/合成酶正是照此翻译：琥珀酰CoA 合成酶与 GDP→GTP 偶联，所以是 synthetase；柠檬酸合酶不用 NTP，所以是 synthase。两者与分解还是合成代谢无关，柠檬酸合酶就在分解途径里。亚基数目和可逆性都不是命名依据——柠檬酸合酶是二聚体，而它催化的反应恰恰是不可逆的。
quiz.explain_en: The distinction is solely whether an NTP is coupled, which is what the Chinese pair 合酶/合成酶 encodes: succinyl-CoA synthetase is coupled to GDP→GTP and is a synthetase, while citrate synthase uses no NTP and is a synthase. The distinction has nothing to do with catabolism versus anabolism — citrate synthase works inside a catabolic pathway. Subunit count and reversibility are not naming criteria either: citrate synthase is a dimer and its reaction is irreversible.

quiz.q_zh: 把这一步称作「TCA 循环唯一直接产生能量的步骤」，准确的说法应该是什么？
quiz.q_en: How should 'the only step of the TCA cycle that directly yields energy' be stated precisely?

options.zh: 它是循环里唯一的底物水平磷酸化步骤
options.en: It is the cycle's only substrate-level phosphorylation step

options.zh: 它是循环里唯一 ΔG°′ 为负的放能步骤
options.en: It is the cycle's only exergonic step with a negative ΔG°′

options.zh: 它是循环里唯一不需要辅酶参与的步骤
options.en: It is the cycle's only step requiring no coenzyme

options.zh: 它是循环里唯一由复合体催化的产能步骤
options.en: It is the cycle's only energy-yielding step run by a complex

quiz.explain_zh: 唯一性在于「不经过电子传递链、直接把磷酸装到核苷二磷酸上」，即底物水平磷酸化；其余产能步骤把电子存进 NADH/FADH2。说它是唯一放能步骤不对，柠檬酸合酶 ≈ −32、α-KGDH ≈ −33.5 kJ/mol，比它负得多。它要用 CoA 和 GDP，不是不需要辅酶。真正由复合体催化的产能步骤是 α-KGDH，不是这一步。
quiz.explain_en: Its uniqueness is that it puts a phosphoryl directly onto a nucleoside diphosphate without the respiratory chain — a substrate-level phosphorylation — whereas the other energy-yielding steps bank electrons as NADH/FADH2. It is not the only exergonic step: citrate synthase (≈ −32) and α-KGDH (≈ −33.5 kJ/mol) are far more negative. It needs CoA and GDP, so it is not coenzyme-free, and the energy-yielding step run by a multienzyme complex is α-KGDH, not this one.

title_zh: −30 kJ/mol 这个尺度、CoA 的离去与一分子 GTP 的生成
title_en: The −30 kJ/mol yardstick, CoA leaving, and the making of one GTP

points.zh: 他重申这一步释放的能量虽然很少，但 Gibbs 自由能仍然小于 0，所以方向没有问题。
points.en: He restated that although little energy is released here, the Gibbs free energy is still below zero, so the direction is not in doubt.

points.zh: 他给学生一个经验尺度：生物体内一个反应如果很强烈地倾向自发进行，它的 Gibbs 自由能一般能达到 −30 kJ/mol。
points.en: He offered a rule of thumb: in cells, a reaction that strongly tends to run spontaneously usually has a Gibbs free energy reaching about −30 kJ/mol.

points.zh: 按这个尺度，这一步的 −3 只有约十分之一，所以他说它进行的程度不是很强烈。
points.en: On that yardstick the −3 of this step is about a tenth, so he called its forward tendency weak.

points.zh: 他在图上把上一步的产物挪到左边，继续往下画。
points.en: He moved the previous product to the left on the drawing and continued from there.

points.zh: 他描述下一步：把 CoA 基团直接丢掉、拿走，产物就变成琥珀酸。
points.en: He described the next step as simply dropping and removing the CoA group, leaving succinate.

points.zh: 他说在这里我们获得了一分子 GTP。
points.en: He said that here we obtain one molecule of GTP.

points.zh: 学生问 GTP 有什么区别，他回答就是一个鸟苷酸，即碱基换成了鸟嘌呤。
points.en: Asked what makes GTP different, he answered that it is simply a guanine nucleotide — the base is guanine.

points.zh: 他说这个问题问得很在点上，自己当年学的时候也很好奇：既然是产能过程，为什么这一步产生的偏偏是 GTP 而不是 ATP。
points.en: He said the question was well aimed, and that he had wondered the same thing as a student: if this is an energy-yielding process, why is the product GTP rather than ATP.

extra.zh: −30 kJ/mol 不是「自发反应的门槛」，它是 ATP 水解的标准自由能（约 −30.5 kJ/mol）。反应能不能自发，取决于细胞内实际浓度下的 ΔG = ΔG°′ + RT·ln Q，而不是 ΔG°′ 本身。最好的反证就在这个循环里：苹果酸脱氢酶 ΔG°′ = +29.7 kJ/mol，正得离谱，却因为草酰乙酸被柠檬酸合酶迅速抽走而一路正向进行。他这一步报的 −3 kJ/mol 本身是对的（不同教材 −2.9 到 −3.4）。
extra.en: −30 kJ/mol is not a threshold for spontaneity; it is the standard free energy of ATP hydrolysis (about −30.5 kJ/mol). Whether a reaction runs is set by ΔG = ΔG°′ + RT·ln Q at real cellular concentrations, not by ΔG°′ alone. The best counterexample sits in this very cycle: malate dehydrogenase has ΔG°′ = +29.7 kJ/mol, strongly positive, yet runs forward because citrate synthase drains oxaloacetate. His −3 kJ/mol for this step is itself correct (textbooks give −2.9 to −3.4).

extra.zh: 这一段前后他好几次把产物说成 GDP（如「直接给了 GDP」「产生一分子的 GDP」）。循环产生的是 GTP：底物水平磷酸化写成 琥珀酰CoA + GDP + Pi → 琥珀酸 + GTP + CoA，GDP 是底物、是磷酸受体。他在 52:35 前后说对过一次，但后面几处一直说成 GDP，直到本讲结束都没有自纠，做「每一步得到什么」的表格时一定要写 GTP。
extra.en: Several times in this stretch he names the product GDP ('it goes straight to GDP', 'one GDP is produced'). The cycle produces GTP: the substrate-level phosphorylation reads succinyl-CoA + GDP + Pi → succinate + GTP + CoA, with GDP the substrate and phosphoryl acceptor. He gets it right once around 52:35 but reverts afterwards and never corrects it in this lecture, so any 'what does each step yield' table must say GTP.

extra.zh: GTP 和 ATP 只差碱基（鸟嘌呤 vs 腺嘌呤），磷酸酐键的水解自由能实际上是等价的，所以能量上没有高下之分。线粒体基质里的核苷二磷酸激酶（NDPK）可以把 GTP 的 γ-磷酸转给 ADP：GTP + ADP ⇌ GDP + ATP，这个反应近乎等能、双向。因此做 ATP 收支时，这一步就记 1 个 ATP 当量，不必单独为 GTP 开一栏。
extra.en: GTP and ATP differ only in the base (guanine vs adenine); the free energy of hydrolysis of their phosphoanhydride bonds is effectively the same, so neither is energetically superior. Nucleoside diphosphate kinase in the matrix transfers the γ-phosphate of GTP to ADP: GTP + ADP ⇌ GDP + ATP, a near-isoenergetic, freely reversible reaction. ATP accounting therefore scores this step as one ATP equivalent rather than keeping a separate GTP column.

extra.zh: 收支上的位置：一分子葡萄糖生成两分子乙酰CoA，TCA 循环转两圈，所以这一步一共贡献 2 个 GTP（= 2 个 ATP 当量）。这 2 个和糖酵解净得的 2 个 ATP 一样，都属于底物水平磷酸化，合计 4 个，在葡萄糖完全氧化的约 30–32 个 ATP 里只占一小部分——绝大部分要靠 NADH 和 FADH2 走氧化磷酸化拿。
extra.en: Where it sits in the ledger: one glucose gives two acetyl-CoA, so the cycle turns twice and this step contributes 2 GTP (= 2 ATP equivalents).
