Accumulating NADH inhibits the cycle rather than triggering anaplerosis, and a fully reduced Q pool is a respiratory-chain redox state unrelated to it.

quiz.q_zh: 把 TCA 循环称为两性代谢途径（amphibolic）的理由是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why is the TCA cycle called an amphibolic pathway?

options.zh: 它在细胞质和线粒体基质里各跑一遍
options.en: It runs once in the cytosol and once in the matrix

options.zh: 它既被 ATP 抑制又被 ADP 激活
options.en: It is inhibited by ATP and activated by ADP

options.zh: 它既彻底氧化底物又提供生物合成前体
options.en: It fully oxidises fuel and also supplies precursors

options.zh: 它在有氧和无氧条件下都可以照常运转
options.en: It operates under both aerobic and anaerobic conditions

quiz.explain_zh: amphibolic 指同一条途径兼具分解和合成两种功能：既把乙酰CoA 烧成 CO2，又输出柠檬酸、α-酮戊二酸、琥珀酰CoA、草酰乙酸作为脂肪酸、氨基酸、血红素和葡萄糖的前体。说它在两个区室各跑一遍不对，循环只在基质里；被 ATP 抑制、被 ADP 激活说的是变构调控，任何调控途径都有，不是这个词的含义；说无氧也能运转不对，NADH 无法再氧化时循环就停。
quiz.explain_en: Amphibolic means one pathway serving both catabolism and anabolism: it burns acetyl-CoA to CO2 and also exports citrate, α-ketoglutarate, succinyl-CoA and oxaloacetate as precursors of fatty acids, amino acids, haem and glucose. Running in two compartments is wrong — the cycle is confined to the matrix. Inhibition by ATP and activation by ADP is ordinary allosteric control, not what the word means. And it cannot turn anaerobically: once NADH cannot be reoxidised the cycle stops.

title_zh: 循环一圈后「原样再生」的分子；TCA 收尾并转入氧化磷酸化
title_en: The molecule regenerated unchanged each turn; wrapping up the cycle and entering oxidative phosphorylation

points.zh: 他在图上追踪基团：彩色标出的那个羧基是乙酰CoA 带进来的，一圈之后位置变了，但分子的形式没变化。
points.en: He traces groups on the figure: the coloured carboxyl came in with acetyl-CoA, and after one turn its position has shifted but the molecule's form has not.

points.zh: 他的结论是：整个反应前后这个分子没有任何变化，最后还是回到原来的样子。
points.en: His conclusion: across the whole reaction the molecule is unchanged and comes back to exactly what it was.

points.zh: 由此他说乙酰CoA 在机体内比较稳定、含量不会有太大变化，「有点像个催化剂一样」。
points.en: From this he says acetyl-CoA is fairly stable in the body, its level not varying much, and that it is "rather like a catalyst".

points.zh: 他接着说：只有在机体很缺能量、乙酰CoA 被别的需能反应借走的时候，才会有填补反应。
points.en: He continues: only when the body is short of energy and acetyl-CoA is borrowed away by other energy-requiring reactions does the topping-up reaction occur.

points.zh: 他强调一般情况下这都不会发生。
points.en: He stresses that ordinarily this does not happen.

points.zh: 后面 PPT 上关于丙酮酸脱氢酶的几页他说是当年抄 PPT 抄下来的，不是考点，直接跳过。
points.en: The following slides on pyruvate dehydrogenase he says were copied from the original PPT when he studied, are not examinable, and are skipped.

points.zh: 他顺带复述：丙酮酸脱氢酶就是开始生成乙酰CoA 的那一步，也就是循环的入口。
points.en: He restates in passing that pyruvate dehydrogenase is the step that generates acetyl-CoA — the entry into the cycle.

points.zh: TCA 循环到此讲完：要记的点不多，主要是循环怎么转、每一步的酶叫什么，反应本身不难只是琐碎。
points.en: That closes the TCA cycle: not many points to hold, mainly how the cycle turns and what each enzyme is called — tedious rather than difficult.

points.zh: 接下来直接讲氧化磷酸化，也就是电子传递链，因为它与 TCA 循环和 EMP 途径紧密相连，连着讲印象更深。
points.en: He then moves straight into oxidative phosphorylation, the electron transport chain, because it is tightly linked to the TCA cycle and glycolysis and sticks better taught continuously.

extra.zh: 在循环里「前后不变、像催化剂」的是草酰乙酸，不是乙酰CoA。草酰乙酸与乙酰基缩合成柠檬酸，绕一圈后被净再生出来，胞内浓度极低（微摩尔级）却相对恒定，所以它才起催化剂式的作用。乙酰CoA 恰恰相反：它每一圈都被消耗，两个碳最终以 2 分子 CO2 离开，浓度随进食、饥饿、脂肪酸氧化大幅波动。同样，回补反应被触发的条件是草酰乙酸被抽走（糖异生、天冬氨酸合成），不是乙酰CoA 被借走。他在这两句里都说成了乙酰CoA，而且全程没有自我更正。
extra.en: The molecule that returns unchanged and acts like a catalyst is oxaloacetate, not acetyl-CoA. Oxaloacetate condenses with the acetyl group to make citrate and is regenerated net after one turn; its concentration is tiny (micromolar) but relatively constant, which is exactly why it behaves catalytically. Acetyl-CoA is the opposite: it is consumed every turn, its two carbons leaving as 2 CO2, and its level swings widely with feeding, fasting and fatty acid oxidation. Likewise, anaplerosis is triggered when oxaloacetate is withdrawn (gluconeogenesis, aspartate synthesis), not when acetyl-CoA is borrowed. He says acetyl-CoA in both sentences and never corrects himself.

extra.zh: 「净计量上被再生」不等于「分子没有变化」。同位素标记的经典结论是：第一圈放出的两个 CO2 全部来自草酰乙酸原有的碳，新进来的乙酰基那两个碳这一圈并不离开，要到后面几圈才被放出。草酰乙酸的羰基碳正是被乙酰基甲基进攻的位点，随后经历脱羧和氧化。所以说它「化学上没变化」是错的，只能说它在化学计量上被再生。
extra.en: "Regenerated net" is not "the molecule did not change". The classic isotope-labelling result is that both CO2 released in the first turn come from carbons that were in oxaloacetate; the two carbons of the incoming acetyl group do not leave in that turn and only come off in later turns. The carbonyl carbon of oxaloacetate is precisely the site attacked by the acetyl methyl group and then goes through decarboxylation and oxidation. Saying it is chemically unchanged is wrong; only the stoichiometric regeneration is true.

extra.zh: 乙酰CoA 是代谢的十字路口而非稳态池：来路有糖酵解经 PDH、脂肪酸 β 氧化、生酮氨基酸和乙醇；去路有 TCA 循环、酮体、脂肪酸和胆固醇合成、乙酰化修饰。也正因为进入循环的两个碳被两个 CO2 抵消，哺乳动物无法把乙酰CoA 净转化成葡萄糖——这是「脂肪不能变糖」的化学根据。
extra.en: Acetyl-CoA is a crossroads, not a buffered pool: it arrives from glycolysis via PDH, from fatty acid β-oxidation, from ketogenic amino acids and from ethanol, and departs into the TCA cycle, ketone bodies, fatty acid and cholesterol synthesis, and protein acetylation. And because the two carbons entering the cycle are matched by two CO2 leaving, mammals cannot make glucose from acetyl-CoA net — the chemical basis of "fat cannot be turned into sugar".

extra.zh: 一圈的收支表：乙酰CoA（2 个碳）进入，2 分子 CO2 离开，产 3 NADH、1 FADH2、1 GTP，草酰乙酸复原。总反应 乙酰CoA + 3 NAD+ + FAD + GDP + Pi + 2 H2O → 2 CO2 + 3 NADH + FADH2 + GTP + CoA + 3 H+，注意等式两边都没有草酰乙酸——这才是「催化剂」的严格含义。
extra.en: The balance sheet for one turn: acetyl-CoA (2 carbons) in, 2 CO2 out, 3 NADH, 1 FADH2 and 1 GTP produced, oxaloacetate restored. The overall equation acetyl-CoA + 3 NAD+ + FAD + GDP + Pi + 2 H2O → 2 CO2 + 3 NADH + FADH2 + GTP + CoA + 3 H+ contains no oxaloacetate on either side — that is the strict sense in which it is catalytic.

quiz.q_zh: 在柠檬酸循环里「转一圈后被原样再生、起催化剂作用」的分子是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which molecule is regenerated each turn of the citric acid cycle and thus acts catalytically?

options.zh: 草酰乙酸，它与乙酰基缩合后再生
options.en: Oxaloacetate, regenerated after condensing with acetyl

options.zh: 辅酶A，它在循环里被反复磷酸化
options.en: Coenzyme A, repeatedly phosphorylated in the cycle

options.zh: 柠檬酸，它在循环末尾重新出现
options.en: Citrate, which reappears at the end of the cycle

options.zh: 乙酰CoA，它每一圈都被完整保留
options.en: Acetyl-CoA, which survives each turn intact

quiz.explain_zh: 草酰乙酸在总反应式两边都不出现，是循环真正的催化性组分。乙酰CoA 每圈被消耗，两个碳最终变成 CO2，浓度波动很大；辅酶A 在第一步就以自由 CoA-SH 的形式离开，循环里并不被磷酸化；柠檬酸是循环内的中间物，末尾出现的是草酰乙酸。
quiz.explain_en: Oxaloacetate appears on neither side of the overall equation and is the genuinely catalytic component. Acetyl-CoA is consumed every turn, its carbons leaving as CO2, and its level fluctuates widely. Coenzyme A is released as free CoA-SH at the first step and is never phosphorylated in the cycle. Citrate is an intermediate; what reappears at the end is oxaloacetate.

quiz.q_zh: 同位素标记实验说明，TCA 循环第一圈放出的两个 CO2 的碳来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: Isotope labelling shows that the carbons of the two CO2 released in the first turn come from where?

options.zh: 全部来自草酰乙酸原有的那些碳
options.en: Both from carbons that were already in oxaloacetate

options.zh: 全部来自新进来的乙酰基两个碳
options.en: Both from the two carbons of the incoming acetyl group

options.zh: 一个来自乙酰基，一个来自草酰乙酸
options.en: One from the acetyl group and one from oxaloacetate

options.zh: 来自辅酶A 被降解后释放的碳
options.en: From carbons released by the breakdown of coenzyme A

quiz.explain_zh: 标记实验的经典结论是第一圈脱下的两个 CO2 全部出自草酰乙酸部分的碳，乙酰基那两个碳留在分子里，要到后面几圈才被放出。说两个碳都来自乙酰基、或一个来自乙酰基，都与标记结果不符；辅酶A 在缩合后立即以 CoA-SH 离开，根本不被降解。
quiz.explain_en: The classic labelling result is that both CO2 lost in the first turn derive from the oxaloacetate portion; the two acetyl carbons stay in the molecule and only leave in later turns. Attributing both, or one, of them to the acetyl group contradicts the labelling data. Coenzyme A leaves as CoA-SH immediately after the condensation and is not degraded at all.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么不能说乙酰CoA 的浓度「基本恒定、像催化剂」？
quiz.q_en: Why can acetyl-CoA not be described as constant in level, like a catalyst?

options.zh: 它是循环里唯一被磷酸化的产物
options.en: It is the only product phosphorylated in the cycle

options.zh: 它在胞质与基质之间自由穿梭
options.en: It shuttles freely between cytosol and matrix

options.zh: 它每圈都被消耗，随进食与饥饿波动
options.en: It is consumed each turn and swings with feeding state

options.zh: 它被内膜锚定，无法离开呼吸链
options.en: It is anchored in the inner membrane by the chain

quiz.explain_zh: 乙酰CoA 每一圈都被烧掉，同时又由糖酵解、β 氧化、生酮氨基酸不断补充，浓度随营养状态大幅变化。说它被内膜锚定不对，它是基质里的可溶代谢物；说它被磷酸化不对，循环里被磷酸化的是 GDP；说它自由穿梭不对，内膜对乙酰CoA 不通透，乙酰单位要靠柠檬酸穿梭才能出基质。
quiz.explain_en: Acetyl-CoA is burned every turn while being resupplied from glycolysis, β-oxidation and ketogenic amino acids, so its level tracks nutritional state closely. It is not anchored in the membrane — it is a soluble matrix metabolite. It is not phosphorylated; GDP is the phosphate acceptor in the cycle. And it does not shuttle freely: the inner membrane is impermeable to it, so acetyl units must leave as citrate.

title_zh: 生物氧化的概念、能量去向与氧化磷酸化的定义
title_en: Biological oxidation, where the energy goes, and the definition of oxidative phosphorylation

points.zh: 生物体内的「氧化」一般指某些有机大分子最终生成水和二氧化碳的过程。
points.en: In biology, oxidation generally means the process by which large organic molecules end up as water and carbon dioxide.

points.zh: 这一过程的特点之一是在体温条件下进行，他说这点不用多讲。
points.en: One feature is that it proceeds at body temperature — a point he says needs no elaboration.

points.zh: 葡萄糖、脂肪酸这类有机物在体内的氧化是分步进行的，每一步都逐渐地释放能量。
points.en: Substrates such as glucose and fatty acids are oxidised stepwise, each step releasing energy gradually.

points.zh: 他说释放的能量有 95% 都用来维持体温、使体温升高，只有 5% 真正被 ATP、GTP 或 NADH 捕获。
points.en: He says 95% of the released energy goes to maintaining and raising body temperature, and only 5% is genuinely captured by ATP, GTP or NADH.

points.zh: 氧化磷酸化的定义：NADH 和 FADH2 上氢原子的电子被传递给氧气。
points.en: Oxidative phosphorylation is defined as the transfer, to oxygen, of the electrons carried on the hydrogens of NADH and FADH2.

points.zh: 他当场纠正自己的措辞：不是质子，是氢原子上的电子——氢原子就是一个质子加一个电子。
points.en: He corrects his own wording on the spot: not the proton, the electron of the hydrogen atom — a hydrogen atom being one proton plus one electron.

points.zh: 电子交给氧气后生成水；剩下的氢离子则通过 ATP 合成酶产生 ATP。
points.en: Once the electrons reach oxygen, water is formed; the protons left behind go through ATP synthase to make ATP.

points.zh: 电子在传递过程中相当于释放了能量，这个能量最终用来生成 ATP，整个过程就叫氧化磷酸化。
points.en: The electron transfer amounts to a release of energy, and that energy ends up making ATP — the whole process being oxidative phosphorylation.

points.zh: 关于电势和不同氧化反应比较的那一小段他明确跳过，只讨论电子传递链里电子从哪里流向哪里。
points.en: He explicitly skips the block on potentials and comparisons of different oxidations, keeping only the question of where electrons flow from and to in the chain.

extra.zh: 「95% 变体温、只有 5% 被捕获」这个比例偏离太大。葡萄糖完全氧化 ΔG°′ ≈ −2870 kJ/mol，生成约 30–32 个 ATP，按 ATP 水解 ΔG°′ ≈ −30.5 kJ/mol 计，捕获效率约 30%–40%；若按细胞内实际浓度下的 ΔG（ATP 水解可达 −50 kJ/mol 以上）计算，还要更高。剩下的确实以热散失，但不是 95%。他没有自我更正。
extra.en: "95% into body heat, only 5% captured" is far off. Complete oxidation of glucose has ΔG°′ ≈ −2870 kJ/mol and yields about 30–32 ATP; at ΔG°′ ≈ −30.5 kJ/mol per ATP that is roughly 30–40% capture, and higher still if computed with intracellular ΔG values (ATP hydrolysis can exceed −50 kJ/mol in the cell). The remainder is indeed lost as heat, but it is not 95%. He never corrects this.

extra.zh: 为什么必须分步：一次性把 2870 kJ/mol 释放出来，绝大部分只能变成热，无法与 ATP 合成（约 +30.5 kJ/mol）耦联。把它拆成十几个小台阶，每一步的 ΔG 都与一个可耦联的化学步骤相当，能量才能被逐份存进 NADH、FADH2 和质子梯度。这正是生物氧化与体外燃烧在能量学上的根本区别，而不只是「温度低」。
extra.en: Why stepwise matters: releasing 2870 kJ/mol at once would leave almost all of it as heat, since nothing can couple to a drop that large. Split into a dozen small steps, each ΔG is comparable to a single couplable chemical event (ATP synthesis needs about +30.5 kJ/mol), so the energy can be banked in instalments as NADH, FADH2 and the proton gradient. That, not merely the low temperature, is the energetic difference between biological oxidation and combustion.

extra.zh: 呼吸链两端的电位差决定了可用能量：NAD+/NADH 的 E°′ = −0.32 V，1/2 O2/H2O 的 E°′ = +0.82 V，ΔE°′ ≈ 1.14 V。按 ΔG°′ = −nFΔE°′、n = 2、F = 96.5 kJ·V⁻¹·mol⁻¹，每对电子约放出 −220 kJ/mol，足以支撑泵出约 10 个质子并最终生成约 2.5 个 ATP。
extra.en: The potential span sets the available energy: NAD+/NADH has E°′ = −0.32 V, ½O2/H2O +0.82 V, so ΔE°′ ≈ 1.14 V. With ΔG°′ = −nFΔE°′, n = 2 and F = 96.5 kJ·V⁻¹·mol⁻¹, each electron pair releases about −220 kJ/mol — enough to pump some 10 protons and end up as roughly 2.5 ATP.

extra.zh: 生化里的「氧化」是失去电子，不必有氧参与：脱氢就是氧化，NAD+ 和 FAD 是接电子的中间载体，氧只是整条链最末端的电子受体。所以厌氧菌用硝酸盐、硫酸盐做末端受体时，同样在做「氧化」。老师把生物氧化直接定义成「变成水和二氧化碳」，是就人体有氧代谢而言的简写。
extra.en: In biochemistry oxidation means loss of electrons and does not require oxygen: dehydrogenation is oxidation, NAD+ and FAD are intermediate carriers, and O2 is merely the terminal acceptor of the chain. Anaerobes using nitrate or sulfate as terminal acceptors are oxidising substrates just the same. Defining biological oxidation as "ending up as CO2 and water" is shorthand for aerobic human metabolism.

quiz.q_zh: 老师说体内氧化释放的能量 95% 变成体温、只有 5% 被捕获。真实的能量捕获效率大致是多少？
quiz.q_en: He says 95% of the energy becomes body heat and only 5% is captured. What is the real capture efficiency?

options.zh: 约 90%，几乎不产生多余的热量
options.en: About 90%, with almost no surplus heat produced

options.zh: 约 5%，与内燃机的效率大致相当
options.en: About 5%, comparable to an internal combustion engine

options.zh: 约 15%，其余全部以热的形式散失
options.en: About 15%, with everything else dissipated as heat

options.zh: 约 30%–40%，其余以热的形式散失
options.en: About 30–40%, with the remainder dissipated as heat

quiz.explain_zh: 按 ΔG°′ ≈ −2870 kJ/mol、30–32 个 ATP、每个 ATP 约 30.5 kJ/mol 计，捕获率约 30%–40%，用细胞内实际 ΔG 算还更高。5% 这个数字更像内燃机或把净可用功与总能量混淆的结果；15% 同样低估；90% 则违反热力学上必然的耗散。
quiz.explain_en: With ΔG°′ ≈ −2870 kJ/mol, 30–32 ATP and about 30.5 kJ/mol each, capture is roughly 30–40%, and higher using intracellular ΔG. The 5% figure belongs to a heat engine, or confuses net useful work with total energy; 15% still understates it; 90% would violate the dissipation thermodynamics requires.

quiz.q_zh: 在氧化磷酸化中，NADH 携带的「氢」被拆开后，质子和电子各自的去向是什么？
quiz.q_en: In oxidative phosphorylation, where do the proton and the electron of NADH's hydrogen each go?

options.zh: 质子经复合体传给氧，电子留在基质
options.en: The proton passes to oxygen, the electron stays in the matrix

options.zh: 电子沿呼吸链传给氧，质子被泵出
options.en: The electron travels the chain to oxygen, the proton is pumped out

options.zh: 质子与电子一起被泵进膜间隙中
options.en: Proton and electron are pumped into the intermembrane space together

options.zh: 电子交给 FMN，质子直接结合生成水
options.en: The electron goes to FMN and the proton directly forms water

quiz.explain_zh: 电子沿一系列载体下坡传到氧，质子被复合体泵到膜间隙形成梯度，最后经 ATP 合酶回流并与氧、电子一起成水。说质子传给氧、电子留在基质把两者的角色对调了；说两者一起被泵出不对，被泵的只有质子；说质子直接生成水不对，成水必须等电子到达 Complex IV 的双核中心。
quiz.explain_en: The electron runs downhill through the carriers to oxygen while the proton is pumped into the intermembrane space to build the gradient, returning through ATP synthase and ending up in water. Sending the proton to oxygen and keeping the electron in the matrix swaps the two roles. Pumping both is wrong — only protons are pumped. And water cannot form until the electrons reach the binuclear centre of Complex IV.

quiz.q_zh: 体内氧化被拆成十几个小步骤，其能量学意义是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the energetic point of splitting biological oxidation into a dozen small steps?

options.zh: 让 O2 能够在多个位点同时被消耗掉
options.en: It lets O2 be consumed at several sites at once

options.zh: 每步 ΔG 都小到能与 ATP 合成耦联
options.en: It keeps each ΔG small enough to couple to ATP synthesis

options.zh: 让底物可以在更低的温度下直接被点燃
options.en: It lets the substrate ignite at a lower temperature

options.zh: 使整个反应的 ΔG°′ 变得更负一些
options.en: It makes the overall ΔG°′ of the reaction more negative

quiz.explain_zh: 分步的意义是把 2870 kJ/mol 拆成一系列能被化学耦联的小落差，每一步都能把能量存进还原当量或质子梯度。总自由能变化只取决于始末状态，不会因为分步而改变；「更低温度点燃」是活化能问题，靠的是酶而不是分步；氧只在 Complex IV 一处被消耗。
quiz.explain_en: Splitting the drop turns 2870 kJ/mol into a series of small, couplable steps, each able to bank energy in a reducing equivalent or in the gradient. The overall free energy change depends only on initial and final states and is unaffected by the number of steps. Lowering the ignition temperature is an activation-energy matter handled by enzymes, and oxygen is consumed at only one site, Complex IV.

title_zh: 呼吸链的定义、氧化磷酸化与底物水平磷酸化的对照、辅酶Q
title_en: Defining the respiratory chain, oxidative vs substrate-level phosphorylation, and coenzyme Q

points.zh: 呼吸链的定义：电子从 NADH、FADH2 出发，经过一系列按电子亲和力（也就是电势高低）排列的载体依次传递，形成的这条链就是呼吸链。
points.en: The respiratory chain is defined as the chain formed when electrons from NADH and FADH2 pass through a series of carriers arranged by electron affinity, that is, by redox potential.

points.zh: 他把这一点说成是本章比较重点的内容：电势的高低决定电子往哪里流。
points.en: He flags this as one of the more important items in the chapter: the potentials decide which way the electrons flow.

points.zh: 氧化磷酸化的严格说法：电子沿电子传递链释放自由能，并将 ADP 磷酸化形成 ATP 的过程。
points.en: The strict statement of oxidative phosphorylation: electrons release free energy along the chain, and ADP is phosphorylated to ATP.

points.zh: 他说这里是个「文字游戏」，因为它是相对于另一种磷酸化方式来定义的。
points.en: He calls this a matter of wording, since the term is defined by contrast with another kind of phosphorylation.

points.zh: 另一种叫水平磷酸化（底物水平磷酸化）：某些带磷酸的物质或一些激酶，不通过电子传递链，直接把一个磷酸基团转过去。
points.en: The other is substrate-level phosphorylation: certain phosphate-bearing compounds or kinases transfer a phosphoryl group directly, without the electron transport chain.

points.zh: 他把这一对定义定位成小概念、不是非常重要，随后开始逐个拆解电子传递链。
points.en: He treats the pair of definitions as a minor point and then starts taking the chain apart piece by piece.

points.zh: 他截了自己贴在笔记本上的那张图，说明图下方有一部分内容被贴住了、被挡住了。
points.en: He screenshots the figure he had pasted into his own notebook, noting that part of the lower content is covered up by the pasting.

points.zh: 链上先讲的是辅酶Q（UQ），中文名泛醌；他说凡是名字里带「泛」的东西（泛醌、泛素）都表示在基本上所有生物体内都存在。
points.en: The first carrier discussed is coenzyme Q (UQ), ubiquinone; he notes that the "ubi-" names (ubiquinone, ubiquitin) mark things present in essentially all organisms.

points.zh: 辅酶Q 的主要作用就是把电子从 NADH-Q 还原酶（Complex I）或者从 Complex II 转移到 Complex III，除此之外没有太多别的作用。
points.en: Coenzyme Q's job is to move electrons from NADH-Q reductase (Complex I) or from Complex II to Complex III, and it does little else.

extra.zh: 他说底物水平磷酸化是「不通过电子传递链将 ADP 氧化成 ATP，把一个磷酸基团直接加到了 ATP 上边」。两处要改：ADP → ATP 是磷酸化，不是氧化，ADP 本身并没有失去电子；磷酸基团是从高能化合物（1,3-二磷酸甘油酸、磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸、磷酸肌酸、琥珀酰CoA）转移到 ADP 上生成 ATP，不是「加到 ATP 上」。按上下文他显然想说 ADP，属口误，但他没有自我更正。
extra.en: He describes substrate-level phosphorylation as "oxidising ADP into ATP without the chain, adding a phosphate group onto ATP". Two corrections: ADP → ATP is phosphorylation, not oxidation — ADP loses no electrons; and the phosphoryl group is transferred from a high-energy compound (1,3-bisphosphoglycerate, PEP, creatine phosphate, succinyl-CoA) onto ADP to form ATP, not onto ATP. Context makes clear he means ADP, but he never says so.

extra.zh: 泛醌之所以不可替代，在于它是链上唯一的小分子脂溶性载体：苯醌环负责氧化还原，长的异戊二烯尾（人是 CoQ10，10 个单位）让它溶在内膜脂双层里自由扩散，把彼此不接触的复合体连起来。更关键的是它可以一次只接一个电子，经半醌自由基（Q ⇌ QH· ⇌ QH2）过渡——正是这一点使 Complex III 的 Q 循环能把双电子流拆成单电子流交给细胞色素 c。
extra.en: Ubiquinone is irreplaceable because it is the chain's only small lipid-soluble carrier: the benzoquinone ring does the redox chemistry while the long isoprenoid tail (CoQ10 in humans, ten units) keeps it dissolved in the bilayer, free to diffuse and connect complexes that never touch. More importantly it can take electrons one at a time through the semiquinone radical (Q ⇌ QH· ⇌ QH2) — which is exactly what allows the Q cycle in Complex III to split a two-electron flow into the one-electron flow cytochrome c requires.

extra.zh: 载体按 E°′ 排队，落差最大的三处正好是三个质子泵：NAD+/NADH −0.32 V → FMN 与 Fe-S 簇 −0.3 ~ −0.05 V →（此处落差约 0.36 V，Complex I）Q/QH2 +0.045 V → cyt b → cyt c1 +0.22 V →（Complex III）cyt c +0.25 V → cyt a/a3 +0.29 V →（Complex IV，落差约 0.53 V）O2 +0.82 V。琥珀酸/延胡索酸的 +0.03 V 挤在 Q 之前，落差太小，这正是 Complex II 不泵质子的原因。
extra.en: Carriers queue by E°′, and the three biggest drops are exactly the three pumps: NAD+/NADH −0.32 V → FMN and Fe-S clusters −0.3 to −0.05 V → (a drop of about 0.36 V, Complex I) Q/QH2 +0.045 V → cyt b → cyt c1 +0.22 V → (Complex III) cyt c +0.25 V → cyt a/a3 +0.29 V → (Complex IV, about 0.53 V) O2 +0.82 V. Succinate/fumarate sits at +0.03 V just below Q — a drop far too small to pump, which is why Complex II does not.

extra.zh: 底物水平磷酸化在整个糖代谢里只有三处：糖酵解的磷酸甘油酸激酶和丙酮酸激酶，TCA 循环的琥珀酰CoA 合成酶。它不需要氧、不需要完整的膜，所以在缺氧或用解偶联剂（2,4-二硝基苯酚）把质子梯度打掉之后，它仍然能产 ATP——这正是剧烈运动缺氧时肌肉唯一的 ATP 来源。
extra.en: Substrate-level phosphorylation occurs at just three places in carbohydrate metabolism: phosphoglycerate kinase and pyruvate kinase in glycolysis, succinyl-CoA synthetase in the TCA cycle. It needs neither oxygen nor an intact membrane, so it still makes ATP when the tissue is hypoxic or when an uncoupler such as 2,4-dinitrophenol collapses the gradient — which is why it is the muscle's only ATP source in anaerobic exercise.

quiz.q_zh: 呼吸链上各个电子载体的排列顺序由什么决定？
quiz.q_en: What determines the order in which the electron carriers of the respiratory chain are arranged?

options.zh: 各载体结合质子的能力强弱
options.en: Their proton-binding capacity, strong to weak

options.zh: 标准还原电位 E°′ 由低到高
options.en: Standard reduction potential E°′, low to high

options.zh: 各载体蛋白的分子量由小到大
options.en: Molecular mass of the carriers, small to large

options.zh: 各载体在内膜中的扩散速度
options.en: Their diffusion speed within the inner membrane

quiz.explain_zh: 电子自发地从电位低（给电子倾向强）的载体流向电位高的载体，整条链就是按 E°′ 从 −0.32 V 排到 +0.82 V。分子量与电子流向无关，Complex I 最大却排在最前只是巧合；扩散速度决定的是传递快慢，不是方向；结合质子的能力是泵的性质，不是排序依据。
quiz.explain_en: Electrons flow spontaneously from carriers of low potential (strong electron donors) to those of high potential, so the chain runs from −0.32 V to +0.82 V by E°′. Molecular mass is irrelevant to direction — Complex I being both the largest and the first is coincidence. Diffusion speed sets the rate, not the direction, and proton-binding capacity is a property of the pumps, not the ordering rule.

quiz.q_zh: 关于底物水平磷酸化与氧化磷酸化的区别，下列说法正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Which statement correctly distinguishes substrate-level from oxidative phosphorylation?

options.zh: 底物水平磷酸化必须有氧气直接参与
options.en: Substrate-level phosphorylation requires oxygen to take part

options.zh: 底物水平磷酸化只发生在线粒体基质
options.en: Substrate-level phosphorylation occurs only in the matrix

options.zh: 底物水平磷酸化把磷酸基团加到 ATP 上
options.en: Substrate-level phosphorylation adds a phosphoryl group to ATP

options.zh: 底物水平磷酸化不依赖跨膜质子梯度
options.en: Substrate-level phosphorylation needs no transmembrane gradient

quiz.explain_zh: 底物水平磷酸化靠高能中间物直接把磷酸转给 ADP，与膜和质子梯度无关，缺氧或解偶联时照样进行。说磷酸加到 ATP 上是把受体写错了，受体是 ADP；说必须有氧不对，无氧糖酵解正是靠它产 ATP；说只在基质里发生不对，糖酵解的两处都在细胞质。
quiz.explain_en: Substrate-level phosphorylation transfers phosphate from a high-energy intermediate straight to ADP, independent of any membrane or gradient, and continues under hypoxia or uncoupling. Adding phosphate to ATP names the wrong acceptor — it is ADP. Requiring oxygen is wrong: anaerobic glycolysis depends on exactly this route. And confining it to the matrix ignores the two glycolytic steps in the cytosol.

quiz.q_zh: 泛醌（辅酶Q）在呼吸链中不可替代的性质是什么？
quiz.q_en: What property makes ubiquinone irreplaceable in the respiratory chain?

options.zh: 它共价锚定在复合体 III 上面
options.en: It is covalently anchored onto Complex III

options.zh: 它每一次都只能整对传递电子
options.en: It can only pass electrons in strict pairs

options.zh: 它脂溶，能在内膜中自由扩散
options.en: It is lipid-soluble and diffuses in the membrane

options.zh: 它只接受复合体 I 传来的电子
options.en: It only accepts electrons from Complex I

quiz.explain_zh: 泛醌是链上唯一的小分子脂溶性载体，靠在脂双层里自由扩散把互不接触的复合体连起来。说它共价锚定在复合体 III 上不对，共价结合的是复合体 II 的 FAD；说它只能整对传递电子正好说反了，它能经半醌一次传一个电子，Q 循环正依赖这一点；说它只收复合体 I 的电子不对，复合体 II 和电子转移黄素蛋白也都把电子交给 Q 池。
quiz.explain_en: Ubiquinone is the chain's only small lipid-soluble carrier, linking complexes that never touch by diffusing through the bilayer. Covalent anchoring to Complex III is wrong — the covalently bound cofactor is the FAD of Complex II. Passing electrons strictly in pairs is the reverse of the truth: it can pass them singly via the semiquinone, which the Q cycle depends on. And it takes electrons from Complex II and electron-transferring flavoprotein as well as Complex I.

title_zh: Complex I 的身份、质子泵名单与质子的去向
title_en: Complex I, which complexes pump, and where the protons go

points.zh: Complex I 的名字叫 NADH-Q 还原酶，其中的 Q 指的就是辅酶Q，因为这个酶需要辅酶Q 的帮助。
points.en: Complex I is called NADH-Q reductase, the Q referring to coenzyme Q, on whose help the enzyme depends.

points.zh: 他建议：中文名比较复杂，跟教授交流时直接说 complex 1，这是比较公认的名字。
points.en: His advice: the Chinese name is cumbersome, so just say complex 1 with a professor — it is the widely accepted name.

points.zh: 他认为 complex 1、2、3 这个编号还挺有逻辑，大致对应电子传递的方向和先后。
points.en: He finds the numbering of complexes 1, 2, 3 fairly logical, roughly following the direction and order of electron transfer.

points.zh: Complex I 是电子传递链上最先遇到的质子泵。
points.en: Complex I is the earliest proton pump encountered along the chain.

points.zh: 他给出的名单是：所有这些电子传递链的蛋白都可以泵质子，除了 complex 4，complex 1、2、3 都起质子泵的作用。
points.en: The list he gives: all these chain proteins pump, except complex 4 — complexes 1, 2 and 3 all act as proton pumps.

points.zh: 质子泵的含义：把氢离子从 matrix（线粒体基质）泵出到膜间隙。
points.en: What a proton pump means: it drives protons out of the matrix into the intermembrane space.

points.zh: 他指出图上画的这层膜是内膜，外面还有一层外膜；随后又把去向说成「从内膜泵出到外膜」。
points.en: He points out that the membrane drawn is the inner membrane with an outer membrane beyond it, then describes the destination as "pumped from the inner membrane out to the outer membrane".

points.zh: 他给出的理由：TCA 循环每一步产生的 NADH、FADH2 都发生在线粒体基质里，所以这些氢离子必须通过不同的复合体泵到膜的间隙中。
points.en: His reasoning: since every NADH and FADH2 of the TCA cycle is made in the matrix, those protons must be pumped through the various complexes into the intermembrane space.

extra.zh: 这段最重要的一处：泵质子的名单说反了。泵质子的是 Complex I、III、IV（每 2 个电子分别约 4、4、2 个 H+），不泵的是 Complex II。原因是琥珀酸/延胡索酸（+0.03 V）与 Q（+0.045 V）之间几乎没有电位落差，不足以支撑跨膜转运。他在 01:34:53–01:35:25 明确改口说 complex 2 不泵氢离子，这一半以后面为准；但 complex 4 那一半他始终没有更正——细胞色素c 氧化酶既泵 2 个 H+，还额外消耗 4 个基质侧质子把 O2 变成 2 H2O，对质子梯度的贡献是双份的。
extra.en: The key error of this stretch: the list of pumps is exactly inverted. The pumps are Complexes I, III and IV (about 4, 4 and 2 H+ per 2 electrons); Complex II does not pump. The reason is that succinate/fumarate (+0.03 V) and Q (+0.045 V) are nearly isopotential, far too small a drop to drive transport. At 01:34:53–01:35:25 he explicitly corrects the Complex II half, saying it does not pump — follow that later statement. The Complex IV half he never corrects: cytochrome c oxidase both pumps 2 H+ and consumes 4 more matrix protons in making 2 H2O from O2, so it contributes to the gradient twice over.

extra.zh: 质子的去向是：从线粒体基质出发，跨过内膜，到达膜间隙（内膜与外膜之间的空间）。外膜上布满 porin，对小分子和离子几乎自由通透，所以电化学梯度只能建立在内膜两侧，不存在「泵到外膜」这回事；也与细胞膜无关——只有细菌才在质膜上做这件事。他在同一段里另有三次说的是「泵到膜间隙」，笔记以那三次为准。
extra.en: The destination is: out of the mitochondrial matrix, across the inner membrane, into the intermembrane space between inner and outer membranes. The outer membrane is studded with porins and is nearly freely permeable to small ions, so the electrochemical gradient can only exist across the inner membrane — there is no "pumping onto the outer membrane", and nothing here involves the plasma membrane (only bacteria do this at the plasma membrane). He says "into the intermembrane space" correctly three other times in this same passage; take those as the record.

extra.zh: Complex I 是呼吸链最大的酶（人 45 个亚基，约 1 MDa），呈 L 形：伸进基质的亲水臂含 FMN 和 8 个 Fe-S 簇，串成一条约 90 Å 长的电子导线；埋在膜里的臂含三个与 Na+/H+ 反向转运体同源的亚基。电子路径与质子通道在空间上是分开的，靠一条贯穿膜臂的中央亲水轴以构象波（「活塞」机制）远程驱动泵质子——这是「电子在这里、质子在那里」却能耦联的经典例子。
extra.en: Complex I is the chain's largest enzyme (45 subunits, about 1 MDa in humans) and L-shaped: the hydrophilic arm reaching into the matrix holds FMN and eight Fe-S clusters strung into a roughly 90 Å electron wire, while the membrane arm holds three subunits homologous to Na+/H+ antiporters. The electron path and the proton channels are physically separate, coupled at a distance by a conformational wave along a central hydrophilic axis — the textbook case of electrons here driving protons there.

extra.zh: NADH 折算 2.5 个 ATP、FADH2 折算 1.5 个，差别完全出自这份名单。FADH2 的电子从 Complex II 进入 Q 池，跳过了 Complex I 这一泵，每 2 电子少泵 4 个 H+：10 H+ 对 6 H+，按约 4 H+ 合成 1 个 ATP 折算，正好是 2.5 对 1.5。所以把名单记反，等于把整个 P/O 比的解释也记反了。
extra.en: The 2.5 versus 1.5 ATP for NADH and FADH2 comes entirely from this list. FADH2's electrons enter the Q pool at Complex II, skipping the Complex I pump and losing 4 H+ per 2 electrons: 10 H+ against 6 H+, which at about 4 H+ per ATP gives exactly 2.5 against 1.5. Getting the list backwards therefore inverts the whole explanation of the P/O ratio.

quiz.q_zh: 电子传递链上，哪些复合体起质子泵的作用？
quiz.q_en: Which of the complexes in the electron transport chain pump protons?

options.zh: Complex I、II、III、IV 四个全都泵质子
options.en: All four complexes pump, differing only in amount

options.zh: Complex I、II、III 泵，Complex IV 不泵
options.en: Complexes I, II and III pump; Complex IV does not

options.zh: 只有 Complex I 和 Complex IV 泵出质子
options.en: Only Complex I and Complex IV pump protons at all

options.zh: Complex I、III、IV 泵，Complex II 不泵
options.en: Complexes I, III and IV pump; Complex II does not

quiz.explain_zh: Complex I、III、IV 每 2 个电子分别泵出约 4、4、2 个 H+；Complex II 因为琥珀酸到泛醌的电位落差只有约 0.03 V，没有能量泵质子。说 I、II、III 泵而 IV 不泵，正是老师口误的那份名单，细胞色素c 氧化酶恰恰是泵；说只有 I 和 IV 泵漏掉了 Complex III 的 Q 循环；说四个都泵则抹掉了 NADH 与 FADH2 产能差别的唯一来源。
quiz.explain_en: Complexes I, III and IV pump about 4, 4 and 2 H+ per 2 electrons; Complex II cannot, because succinate to ubiquinone is a drop of only about 0.03 V. The list with I, II and III pumping and IV not is the inverted one — cytochrome c oxidase is very much a pump. Naming only I and IV drops the Q cycle of Complex III, and having all four pump erases the sole reason NADH and FADH2 differ in yield.

quiz.q_zh: Complex I 泵出的质子最终到达哪里？
quiz.q_en: Where do the protons pumped by Complex I end up?

options.zh: 内膜与基质之间的夹层
options.en: A layer between inner membrane and matrix

options.zh: 内膜与外膜之间的膜间隙
options.en: The intermembrane space between both membranes

options.zh: 线粒体外膜的外表面上
options.en: On the outer surface of the outer membrane

options.zh: 细胞质基质，经由外膜孔道
options.en: The cytosol, by way of outer-membrane porins

quiz.explain_zh: 质子被泵过内膜进入膜间隙，梯度就建立在内膜两侧。外膜有 porin 几乎自由通透，所以质子不会「停在外膜表面」，也不会因为泄漏到细胞质而形成有用的梯度；「内膜与基质之间的夹层」在解剖上不存在，内膜直接界定基质。
quiz.explain_en: Protons are driven across the inner membrane into the intermembrane space, and the gradient exists across the inner membrane. The outer membrane is porin-riddled and nearly freely permeable, so protons neither sit on its surface nor form a useful gradient by leaking to the cytosol. A layer between inner membrane and matrix does not exist anatomically — the inner membrane bounds the matrix directly.

quiz.q_zh: NADH 与 FADH2 的 ATP 当量差别（约 2.5 对 1.5）根本上来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: Where does the difference in ATP yield between NADH and FADH2 (about 2.5 vs 1.5) come from?

options.zh: FADH2 在线粒体基质中被直接水解
options.en: FADH2 is hydrolysed directly within the matrix

options.zh: FADH2 的电子最终并不与氧气结合成水
options.en: The electrons from FADH2 never reach oxygen

options.zh: FADH2 从复合体 II 进入，少一处泵
options.en: FADH2 enters at Complex II and skips one pump

options.zh: FADH2 根本无法把电子交给泛醌池
options.en: FADH2 cannot hand its electrons to the Q pool

quiz.explain_zh: FADH2 的电子在 Complex II 进入 Q 池，绕过了 Complex I，每 2 电子少泵 4 个质子，10 H+ 变成 6 H+，折算下来就是 1.5 而不是 2.5。说电子不交给氧不对，它们照样经 III、IV 到氧；说不能交给泛醌池正好说反了，Q 池就是它的入口；说被水解掉没有这种反应。
quiz.explain_en: FADH2's electrons enter the Q pool at Complex II, bypassing Complex I and losing 4 H+ per 2 electrons — 10 H+ becomes 6 H+, which converts to 1.5 rather than 2.5. Their never reaching oxygen is wrong: they still pass through III and IV to O2. Being unable to reach the Q pool is the reverse of the truth, since the Q pool is the entry point. And there is no hydrolysis of FADH2 in the matrix.

title_zh: Complex I 内部的电子路径与 Complex II（琥珀酸脱氢酶）
title_en: The electron path inside Complex I, and Complex II (succinate dehydrogenase)

points.zh: 在 Complex I（NADH-Q 还原酶）这一步，被接受的氢离子是由 NADH 提供的。
points.en: At Complex I, NADH-Q reductase, the hydrogens taken up are the ones supplied by NADH.

points.zh: 氢进入这个复合体后先遇到 FMN；他问 FMN 是哪个维生素来的，先说成维生素 K，随即自纠为维生素 B2。
points.en: Inside the complex the hydrogen first meets FMN; asked which vitamin it comes from he first says vitamin K and immediately corrects himself to vitamin B2.

points.zh: 他指出 FMN 与 FAD 长得很相近，两者都担任运送氢/电子的角色，FMN 在 complex 1 里就是干这个的。
points.en: He notes FMN and FAD look very much alike and both serve to carry hydrogens or electrons, FMN doing exactly that inside complex 1.

points.zh: 图上看起来像是「电子过来了、氢离子上去了」两件事，他强调实际上是同步发生的，电子传递与质子转运是同一个过程。
points.en: The figure makes it look like two events — electrons coming in, protons going up — but he stresses they happen simultaneously: electron transfer and proton translocation are one process.

points.zh: 路径是：NADH 交出氢，电子给到 FMN，FMN 经过铁硫簇，最终传递到辅酶Q。
points.en: The route: NADH gives up its hydrogen, the electrons go to FMN, from FMN through the Fe-S clusters, and finally to coenzyme Q.

points.zh: 在这个过程中它的氢离子也被泵出去（他这里的措辞是「泵出到了细胞膜外」）。
points.en: In the same process the protons are pumped out — his wording here is "pumped outside the cell membrane".

points.zh: 他要求记一个数字：Complex I 在一次反应过程中可以泵出 4 个氢离子。
points.en: One number he asks you to remember: Complex I pumps out 4 protons per reaction cycle.

points.zh: Complex II 就是琥珀酸脱氢酶，是 TCA 循环里反应位点在线粒体内膜上的那个蛋白；他先说「唯一的」，随即改口成「唯二的」。
points.en: Complex II is succinate dehydrogenase, the TCA enzyme whose reaction site sits on the inner membrane; he first says "the only one" and then changes it to "one of two".

points.zh: 机制是：琥珀酸脱去的两个氢原子直接交给 complex 2 内部的 FAD（他称之为辅酶），FAD 接受两个电子形成 FADH2，再经铁硫簇（Fe-S，铁和硫组成的传递电子的小元件）把电子交给泛醌；他明确说这一步不泵出氢原子，只传电子。
points.en: The mechanism: the two hydrogens removed from succinate go straight onto the FAD inside complex 2 (which he calls a coenzyme), the FAD takes two electrons to become FADH2, and the electrons then pass through the Fe-S cluster — iron and sulfur forming a small electron-relay component — to ubiquinone; he states explicitly that this step pumps no protons and only transfers electrons.

extra.zh: 「唯一」改成「唯二」是改错了方向。琥珀酸脱氢酶（= Complex II）是 TCA 循环八个酶中唯一嵌在线粒体内膜上的整合膜蛋白，其余七个都是可溶的基质酶。它同时属于 TCA 循环和呼吸链，这正是它特殊的原因，也是把两条通路缝在一起的那一针。
extra.en: Changing "the only one" to "one of two" corrects in the wrong direction. Succinate dehydrogenase (Complex II) is the only one of the cycle's eight enzymes integral to the inner membrane; the other seven are soluble matrix enzymes. It belongs to both the TCA cycle and the respiratory chain, which is precisely what makes it special and what stitches the two pathways together.

extra.zh: Complex II 里的 FAD 是辅基（prosthetic group），不是辅酶。它通过组氨酸残基共价结合在黄素蛋白亚基 SDHA 上，全程不离开酶，所以这里根本没有游离的 FADH2 分子跑出来——这也是为什么「FADH2 进入呼吸链」在图上永远画成 Complex II 本身。能自由解离、在酶与酶之间穿梭的 NAD+/NADH 才叫辅酶。另外他说「FAD 接受两分子电子」，应为两个电子（2 e⁻），电子不论「分子」。机制他讲对了，只是名称不严谨。
extra.en: The FAD in Complex II is a prosthetic group, not a coenzyme: it is covalently attached through a histidine to the flavoprotein subunit SDHA and never leaves the enzyme, so no free FADH2 molecule is released here — which is why "FADH2 entering the chain" is always drawn as Complex II itself. A coenzyme is something like NAD+/NADH that dissociates and shuttles between enzymes. He also says FAD accepts "two molecules of electrons", which should simply be two electrons. The mechanism he describes is right; only the terminology is loose.

extra.zh: 「泵出到细胞膜外」应为泵到线粒体膜间隙——这是线粒体内膜，不是细胞膜（质膜）。他在 01:31:43 和 01:32:14 说的「泵到膜间隙」才是准确说法。值得注意的是，他在 01:34:53–01:35:25 讲 complex 2 时明确说「他不会泵出氢原子，只是把电子传递给了铁硫簇」，这一句正好修正了 01:31:12 那份「除了 complex4，1/2/3 都泵」的名单——但 complex 4 是泵这一半，他到此仍未更正。
extra.en: "Pumped outside the cell membrane" should be into the mitochondrial intermembrane space — this is the inner mitochondrial membrane, not the plasma membrane. His phrasing at 01:31:43 and 01:32:14, "pumped into the intermembrane space", is the accurate one. Note also that at 01:34:53–01:35:25, discussing complex 2, he says plainly that it pumps no protons and only passes electrons to the Fe-S cluster — which corrects the list given at 01:31:12 ("all but complex 4 pump"). The other half of that list, that Complex IV does pump, he still has not corrected.

extra.zh: Complex II 由四个亚基组成，正好构成一条完整的电子通路：SDHA 带共价 FAD，是琥珀酸的氧化位点；SDHB 串着 2Fe-2S、4Fe-4S、3Fe-4S 三个簇，把电子接力约 40 Å；SDHC 与 SDHD 是膜锚，含一个血红素 b 和泛醌结合位点。它也是丙二酸（malonate）竞争性抑制的经典对象——这正是当年推断循环存在的实验工具；SDHB/C/D 的胚系突变会导致副神经节瘤和嗜铬细胞瘤，是 TCA 酶充当抑癌基因的经典例子。
extra.en: Complex II has four subunits that together form one continuous electron path: SDHA carries the covalent FAD and is the succinate oxidation site; SDHB strings 2Fe-2S, 4Fe-4S and 3Fe-4S clusters to relay electrons about 40 Å; SDHC and SDHD are the membrane anchors, holding a haem b and the ubiquinone site. It is also the classic target of competitive inhibition by malonate — the very tool used to infer the cycle's existence — and germline mutations in SDHB/C/D cause paraganglioma and phaeochromocytoma, the textbook case of a TCA enzyme acting as a tumour suppressor.

quiz.q_zh: Complex I 内部电子的传递路线是下列哪一条？
quiz.q_en: Which route do electrons take inside Complex I?

options.zh: NADH → 铁硫簇 → FAD → 细胞色素c
options.en: NADH → Fe-S clusters → FAD → cytochrome c

options.zh: NADH → 泛醌 → FMN → 铁硫簇
options.en: NADH → ubiquinone → FMN → Fe-S clusters

options.zh: NADH → 血红素 a → 铁硫簇 → 泛醌
options.en: NADH → haem a → Fe-S clusters → ubiquinone

options.zh: NADH → FMN → 铁硫簇 → 泛醌
options.en: NADH → FMN → Fe-S clusters → ubiquinone

quiz.explain_zh: NADH 把氢负离子交给 FMN，电子再沿一串 Fe-S 簇接力，最后交给膜内的泛醌。把 FAD 和细胞色素c 放进 Complex I 不对，前者是 Complex II 的辅基、后者在膜间隙侧连接 III 与 IV；把泛醌放在最前面不对，它是这一段的终点而不是起点；血红素 a 属于 Complex IV，Complex I 里没有血红素。
quiz.explain_en: NADH delivers a hydride to FMN, the electrons then relay along a string of Fe-S clusters and are finally handed to ubiquinone in the membrane. Putting FAD and cytochrome c inside Complex I is wrong: the former is the prosthetic group of Complex II, the latter works on the intermembrane face between III and IV. Placing ubiquinone first is wrong — it is the exit, not the entry. Haem a belongs to Complex IV; Complex I contains no haem.

quiz.q_zh: Complex II 里的 FAD 应该称作什么？为什么？
quiz.q_en: What should the FAD of Complex II be called, and why?

options.zh: 辅基，因为它共价结合在酶上
options.en: A prosthetic group, since it is covalently bound

options.zh: 辅酶，因为它可以在酶之间穿梭
options.en: A coenzyme, since it shuttles between enzymes

options.zh: 辅底物，因为它按化学计量消耗
options.en: A cosubstrate, since it is consumed stoichiometrically

options.zh: 辅酶，因为它离开酶去还原泛醌
options.en: A coenzyme, since it leaves to reduce ubiquinone

quiz.explain_zh: Complex II 的 FAD 通过组氨酸残基共价结合在 SDHA 上，全程不离开酶，符合辅基的定义。称它为可以在酶之间穿梭的辅酶不对，那是 NAD+/NADH 的行为；称它为按化学计量消耗的辅底物不对，它每轮都被重新氧化、并不净消耗；说它离开酶去还原泛醌也不对，电子是经 SDHB 的铁硫簇送到膜侧的 Q 位点的。
quiz.explain_en: The FAD of Complex II is covalently attached to SDHA through a histidine and never leaves the enzyme, which is the definition of a prosthetic group. Calling it a coenzyme that shuttles between enzymes describes NAD+/NADH instead. Calling it a cosubstrate consumed stoichiometrically is wrong — it is reoxidised every cycle and not consumed net. And it does not leave to reduce ubiquinone: the electrons travel through the SDHB Fe-S clusters to the Q site in the membrane.

quiz.q_zh: 关于琥珀酸脱氢酶（Complex II），下列说法正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about succinate dehydrogenase (Complex II) is correct?

options.zh: 它是唯一能泵出质子的 TCA 循环酶
options.en: It is the only TCA cycle enzyme that pumps protons

options.zh: 它把电子经细胞色素 c 交给氧气
options.en: It passes electrons via cytochrome c to oxygen

options.zh: 它是唯一嵌在线粒体内膜上的 TCA 酶
options.en: It is the only TCA enzyme embedded in the membrane

options.zh: 它产生游离 FADH2 再交给复合体 I
options.en: It releases free FADH2 for delivery to Complex I

quiz.explain_zh: 循环的八个酶里只有琥珀酸脱氢酶是内膜整合蛋白，其余都在基质中可溶，它同时是呼吸链的 Complex II。说它能泵质子不对，琥珀酸到泛醌的落差太小；说它经细胞色素c 交给氧不对，它只把电子交到泛醌池；说它产生游离 FADH2 再交给复合体 I 不对，FAD 共价结合在酶上，电子的去向是泛醌而不是倒回复合体 I。
quiz.explain_en: Of the cycle's eight enzymes only succinate dehydrogenase is integral to the inner membrane, the rest being soluble matrix enzymes, and it doubles as Complex II of the chain. It does not pump: the succinate-to-ubiquinone drop is too small. It does not reach oxygen via cytochrome c — it delivers only as far as the Q pool. And it releases no free FADH2 for Complex I: the FAD is covalently bound and the electrons go forward to ubiquinone.

title_zh: 复合体 II 不泵质子，复合体 III 作为电子中转站
title_en: Complex II pumps no protons; Complex III as the electron relay hub

points.zh: 复合体 II 这一步唯一需要记住的是：它不直接把氢离子泵到膜间隙里去。
points.en: The one thing to remember about Complex II is that it does not pump protons into the intermembrane space.

points.zh: 接下来讲的是复合体 III，他给的中文名是「细胞色素还原酶」。
points.en: Next comes Complex III, which he names in Chinese as 细胞色素还原酶 (cytochrome reductase).

points.zh: 复合体 III 实际上是复合体 I 和复合体 II 的一个中转站，两条来路的电子都汇到它这里。
points.en: Complex III is really the relay station for Complexes I and II — electrons from both routes converge on it.

points.zh: 复合体 I 和复合体 II 各自拿到的电子，都是通过辅酶 Q（泛醌）交给复合体 III 的。
points.en: Both Complex I and Complex II hand their electrons to Complex III via coenzyme Q (ubiquinone).

points.zh: 复合体 III 只负责一件事：接受电子之后把电子整合起来传给细胞色素 c。
points.en: Complex III does exactly one job: collect the incoming electrons and pass them to cytochrome c.

points.zh: 细胞色素 c 再进一步把电子传递给复合体 IV。
points.en: Cytochrome c then carries the electrons onward to Complex IV.

points.zh: 复合体 I、II、III 里边都含有铁硫簇（Fe-S），作为电子传递的内部中转。
points.en: Complexes I, II and III all contain iron-sulfur (Fe-S) clusters serving as internal electron relays.

points.zh: 他说复合体 III 内部电子具体怎么走不必记，重要的是细胞色素 c 和复合体 IV 的功能。
points.en: He says the detailed internal electron route inside Complex III need not be memorised; what matters is cytochrome c and Complex IV.

extra.zh: 他把复合体 III 叫「细胞色素还原酶」，规范名是细胞色素 c 还原酶（cytochrome c reductase，又称细胞色素 bc1 复合体）。少掉的那个 c 恰恰指明它还原的对象是谁——同理复合体 IV 的规范名是细胞色素 c 氧化酶。省一个 c 属简称，但考试写全名更安全。
extra.en: He calls Complex III 细胞色素还原酶. The proper name is cytochrome c reductase (the cytochrome bc1 complex); the dropped 'c' is precisely what names its substrate, exactly as Complex IV is cytochrome c oxidase. The short form is common speech, but write the full name in an exam.

extra.zh: 复合体 III 内部走的是 Q 循环（Q cycle）：泛醇在 Qo 位点把两个电子分叉，一个走 Rieske 铁硫蛋白 → 细胞色素 c1 → 细胞色素 c，另一个走细胞色素 bL/bH 回到 Qi 位点把另一分子泛醌半还原。要跑两轮才净氧化掉一个 QH2，正是这个分叉使每 2 个电子能泵出 4 个质子。
extra.en: Inside Complex III runs the Q cycle: ubiquinol is oxidised at the Qo site and its two electrons bifurcate — one via the Rieske Fe-S protein to cytochrome c1 and on to cytochrome c, the other via cytochromes bL/bH back to the Qi site to half-reduce a second ubiquinone. Two turns are needed to net-oxidise one QH2, and that bifurcation is what lets 4 protons be translocated per 2 electrons.

extra.zh: 复合体 II 不泵质子的根本原因是电位落差不够：琥珀酸/延胡索酸对约 +0.03 V，泛醌/泛醇约 +0.045 V，几乎没有落差；而复合体 I 的 NADH（−0.32 V）→ 泛醌落差约 0.36 V，足以驱动 4 个质子跨膜。这就是 FADH2 只值约 1.5 个 ATP 而 NADH 值约 2.5 个的根源。
extra.en: Complex II pumps nothing because the redox drop is too small: the succinate/fumarate couple sits near +0.03 V and ubiquinone/ubiquinol near +0.045 V, essentially no span, whereas Complex I spans NADH (−0.32 V) to ubiquinone, about 0.36 V, enough to drive 4 protons across. This is the origin of the ~1.5 ATP per FADH2 versus ~2.5 per NADH.

extra.zh: 铁硫簇存在于复合体 I、II、III，复合体 IV 里没有铁硫簇——它用的是血红素 a、a3 和两个铜中心 CuA/CuB。所以「所有复合体都有 Fe-S」是错的。
extra.en: Fe-S clusters are found in Complexes I, II and III. Complex IV has none — it uses hemes a and a3 plus the copper centres CuA and CuB. So 'every complex has Fe-S' is false.

quiz.q_zh: 复合体 II 不向膜间隙泵质子，最根本的原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the fundamental reason Complex II pumps no protons into the intermembrane space?

options.zh: 它的 FAD 辅基把两个氢原子全锁在酶内，没有可泵的游离质子
options.en: Its FAD prosthetic group locks both hydrogens inside the enzyme, leaving no free protons

options.zh: 它整合在线粒体外膜上，而外膜两侧根本无法建立质子梯度
options.en: It is embedded in the outer membrane, across which no proton gradient can be built

options.zh: 琥珀酸到泛醌这一段氧化还原电位落差太小，不足以驱动跨膜转运
options.en: The succinate-to-ubiquinone redox span is far too small to drive proton translocation

options.zh: 它把电子直接交给细胞色素 c，跳过了泛醌池和后面的复合体 III
options.en: It gives electrons straight to cytochrome c, bypassing the Q pool and Complex III

quiz.explain_zh: 泵质子要靠氧化还原自由能。琥珀酸/延胡索酸约 +0.03 V、泛醌/泛醇约 +0.045 V，落差几乎为零，不足以做跨膜功。说它在外膜上是错的，复合体 II 是内膜蛋白，而且外膜有 porin、本来就不隔离质子；说它绕过泛醌交给细胞色素 c 也是错的，它的产物正是泛醇；FAD 确实是酶内辅基、FADH2 不游离，但这解释的是「氢不外流」，不是「不泵质子」——复合体 I 的 FMN 同样不游离却照泵不误。
quiz.explain_en: Pumping needs redox free energy. The succinate/fumarate couple (~+0.03 V) and ubiquinone/ubiquinol (~+0.045 V) are almost isopotential, so there is no energy to do transmembrane work. Placing it in the outer membrane is wrong — Complex II is an inner-membrane protein, and the porin-riddled outer membrane cannot hold a gradient anyway. Handing electrons to cytochrome c is wrong: its product is ubiquinol. The FAD is indeed enzyme-bound and FADH2 never dissociates, but that explains why no hydrogen leaves, not why nothing is pumped — Complex I's FMN is equally bound and pumps fine.

quiz.q_zh: 复合体 I 与复合体 II 得到的电子，是如何汇合并继续往下传的？
quiz.q_en: How do the electrons acquired by Complexes I and II converge and travel onward?

options.zh: 都由细胞色素 c 送到复合体 III，再经泛醌交给复合体 IV
options.en: Both go via cytochrome c to Complex III, then via ubiquinone to Complex IV

options.zh: 复合体 I 经泛醌、复合体 II 经细胞色素 c 分别到复合体 IV
options.en: Complex I goes via ubiquinone and Complex II via cytochrome c to Complex IV

options.zh: 都先交给复合体 IV，由它氧化后再把电子返还复合体 III
options.en: Both go first to Complex IV, which oxidises them and returns them to Complex III

options.zh: 都由泛醌送到复合体 III，再经细胞色素 c 交给复合体 IV
options.en: Both go via ubiquinone to Complex III, then via cytochrome c to Complex IV

quiz.explain_zh: 泛醌是内膜脂相里的移动载体，收集复合体 I、II（以及脂肪酸氧化的 ETF-QO、甘油-3-磷酸脱氢酶）的电子送进复合体 III；细胞色素 c 是膜间隙侧的水溶性载体，把电子从复合体 III 送到复合体 IV。把两个载体对调是最常见的错记；让复合体 II 直接接细胞色素 c 就跳过了唯一泵质子的中段；电子在链上只能从低电位流向高电位，复合体 IV 电位最高，不可能把电子退还给复合体 III。
quiz.explain_en: Ubiquinone is the lipid-phase mobile carrier that collects electrons from Complexes I and II (and from ETF-QO and glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase) and delivers them to Complex III; cytochrome c is the water-soluble carrier on the intermembrane-space face that runs from Complex III to Complex IV. Swapping the two carriers is the classic mis-memorisation. Routing Complex II straight to cytochrome c would skip the proton-pumping middle segment. And electrons only flow towards higher potential, so Complex IV, the highest, cannot hand them back to Complex III.

title_zh: 细胞色素 c 的穿梭，与 FMN／FAD 两个电子入口
title_en: The cytochrome c shuttle, and FMN versus FAD as the two entry points

points.zh: 细胞色素 c 是一种水溶性的细胞色素，他称之为唯一可以水溶的细胞色素。
points.en: Cytochrome c is water-soluble; he calls it the only water-soluble cytochrome.

points.zh: 它可以在线粒体的内膜和外膜之间随意转运、来回跑动。
points.en: It moves freely back and forth in the space between the inner and outer mitochondrial membranes.

points.zh: 他说它接受复合体 III 的电子以后就带上电荷，于是被固定在内外膜之间的这个区域。
points.en: He says that once it takes electrons from Complex III it becomes charged and is thereby fixed in that region.

points.zh: 因此细胞色素 c 起到把电子从复合体 III 运到复合体 IV 的中间体作用。
points.en: Cytochrome c therefore acts as the intermediate that carries electrons from Complex III to Complex IV.

points.zh: 他说这幅图里名字很多，但真正要记的只有 FMN 和 FAD 两个。
points.en: He says the figure has many names on it, but only FMN and FAD really need to be remembered.

points.zh: FMN 和 FAD 是「两兄弟」，长得很像、只有很微小的区别，在电子传递链里都负责接受电子。
points.en: FMN and FAD are near-twins with only a small structural difference, and both serve to accept electrons in the chain.

points.zh: 区别在入口：FMN 接受 NADH 上的电子，FAD 则通过琥珀酸脱氢酶这一步直接接受电子。
points.en: The difference is the entry point: FMN takes electrons from NADH, FAD takes them directly at the succinate dehydrogenase step.

points.zh: 两者拿到电子后都交给铁硫簇 Fe-S，铁硫簇再交给泛醌，泛醌再送到复合体 III 里的铁硫簇。
points.en: Both then pass the electrons to Fe-S clusters, which pass them to ubiquinone, which delivers them to the Fe-S clusters inside Complex III.

extra.zh: 他说细胞色素 c「被固定在细胞质的内膜和外膜之间」——应是线粒体膜间隙，他上一句说的「线粒体的内膜和外膜之间」才是对的。这不只是措辞：细胞色素 c 一旦真的漏进细胞质，就会与 Apaf-1 组装成凋亡体激活 caspase-9，是线粒体凋亡通路的起点。
extra.en: He says cytochrome c is held 'between the inner and outer membranes of the cytoplasm'; the correct compartment is the mitochondrial intermembrane space, as in his own preceding sentence. This is not just wording: cytochrome c that genuinely reaches the cytosol assembles with Apaf-1 into the apoptosome and activates caspase-9 — the trigger of the intrinsic apoptotic pathway.

extra.zh: 「带上电荷后就被固定住」不准确。细胞色素 c 在氧化态（血红素 Fe³⁺）和还原态（Fe²⁺）下都带净正电荷，始终靠静电吸附在内膜的膜间隙侧；氧化还原状态改变的是它对复合体 III 与复合体 IV 的相对亲和力，从而实现「取货—卸货」的往返，而不是从自由扩散切换成被锁死。
extra.en: 'It gets charged and is then fixed' is not accurate. Cytochrome c carries a net positive charge in both the oxidised (heme Fe3+) and reduced (Fe2+) states and is electrostatically bound to the intermembrane-space face of the inner membrane throughout. What the redox state changes is its relative affinity for Complex III versus Complex IV, which is what makes it load and unload — not a switch from free diffusion to being locked in place.

extra.zh: FMN 与 FAD 的结构差别就是一个 AMP：核黄素（维生素 B2）磷酸化得到 FMN，FMN 再与 ATP 缩合接上 AMP 得到 FAD。二者的氧化还原电位并非固定，主要由所结合的蛋白环境决定，同一个黄素在不同酶里电位可以相差几百毫伏——这正是复合体 I 的 FMN 能接 NADH、而复合体 II 的 FAD 只能接琥珀酸的原因。
extra.en: FMN and FAD differ by one AMP: riboflavin (vitamin B2) is phosphorylated to FMN, and FMN is adenylylated with ATP to give FAD. Their redox potentials are not fixed properties but are set by the protein environment, and the same flavin can differ by hundreds of millivolts between enzymes — which is exactly why the FMN of Complex I can take electrons from NADH while the FAD of Complex II can only take them from succinate.

extra.zh: 复合体 II 里的 FAD 通过组氨酸残基共价结合在黄素蛋白亚基上，是辅基（prosthetic group），全程不离开酶；能在酶之间自由扩散、可解离的 NAD⁺/NADH 才叫辅酶（coenzyme）。老师上一段把它称作「辅酶」，讲的机制（氢直接交给酶内 FAD，FADH2 不游离）是对的，只是名称不严谨。
extra.en: The FAD of Complex II is covalently attached to the flavoprotein subunit through a histidine residue: it is a prosthetic group and never leaves the enzyme. A coenzyme proper is a dissociable carrier that diffuses between enzymes, such as NAD+/NADH. He called it a 辅酶 (coenzyme) in the previous stretch; his mechanism (hydrogens go straight onto the enzyme-bound FAD, FADH2 never floats free) was right, only the term was loose.

quiz.q_zh: 关于细胞色素 c 的定位与移动，下列哪一条是正确的？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the location and movement of cytochrome c is correct?

options.zh: 它是内膜的整合膜蛋白，横跨内膜把电子递到基质一侧去
options.en: It is an integral inner-membrane protein passing electrons across to the matrix

options.zh: 它嵌在外膜的 porin 通道旁边，负责把电子交给复合体 I 使用
options.en: It sits beside the outer-membrane porins and delivers electrons into Complex I

options.zh: 它溶解在细胞质里，靠自由扩散把电子送回到线粒体内膜上
options.en: It dissolves in the cytosol and diffuses back to the inner membrane with electrons

options.zh: 它是膜间隙侧的外周膜蛋白，在复合体 III 与复合体 IV 间往返
options.en: It is a peripheral protein of the intermembrane face, shuttling between III and IV

quiz.explain_zh: 细胞色素 c 是水溶性的外周膜蛋白，靠静电吸附在内膜的膜间隙侧，在复合体 III 与复合体 IV 之间摆渡电子。说它溶在细胞质里是老师这句口误的说法，细胞质里出现细胞色素 c 意味着凋亡；说它横跨内膜把电子送进基质是错的，电子不进基质，只有复合体 IV 上的氧还原发生在基质侧；外膜的 porin 与呼吸链无关，复合体 I 的电子来自基质里的 NADH，不来自细胞色素 c。
quiz.explain_en: Cytochrome c is a water-soluble peripheral protein held electrostatically on the intermembrane-space face of the inner membrane, ferrying electrons between Complexes III and IV. Placing it in the cytosol repeats the teacher's slip — cytosolic cytochrome c signals apoptosis. It does not span the inner membrane to deliver electrons to the matrix; no electrons enter the matrix, and only the oxygen chemistry at Complex IV faces that side. Outer-membrane porins have nothing to do with the chain, and Complex I takes its electrons from matrix NADH, not from cytochrome c.

quiz.q_zh: FMN 与 FAD 在电子传递链中分别在哪里接受电子？
quiz.q_en: Where do FMN and FAD each accept their electrons in the respiratory chain?

options.zh: FMN 在复合体 I 接 NADH，FAD 在复合体 II 接琥珀酸
options.en: FMN takes NADH in Complex I, FAD takes succinate in Complex II

options.zh: FMN 在复合体 II 接受电子，FAD 在复合体 I 上接受电子
options.en: FMN accepts electrons in Complex II, and FAD accepts them in Complex I

options.zh: 两者都在复合体 I 上，分别接受 NADH 与琥珀酸的电子
options.en: Both sit in Complex I, taking electrons from NADH and from succinate

options.zh: FMN 接受泛醇送来的电子，FAD 接受细胞色素 c 的电子
options.en: FMN takes electrons from ubiquinol, and FAD takes them from cytochrome c

quiz.explain_zh: 复合体 I 的 FMN 从 NADH 接受一个氢负离子（2 电子），复合体 II 的 FAD 从琥珀酸接受两个氢原子。把两者对调是最常见的错；说两者都在复合体 I 上则抹掉了琥珀酸脱氢酶同时属于 TCA 循环和电子传递链这一关键身份；泛醇和细胞色素 c 都在黄素之后、位于电子流的下游，它们不可能反过来给黄素供电子。
quiz.explain_en: The FMN of Complex I takes a hydride (two electrons) from NADH; the FAD of Complex II takes two hydrogens from succinate. Swapping them is the commonest error. Putting both in Complex I erases the key fact that succinate dehydrogenase belongs to both the TCA cycle and the respiratory chain. Ubiquinol and cytochrome c both lie downstream of the flavins in the electron flow and cannot feed electrons back to them.

title_zh: 铁硫簇的功能，与复合体 IV 的登场
title_en: What iron-sulfur clusters do, and Complex IV enters

points.zh: 铁硫簇就是铁原子和硫原子在酶里形成的一个专门传电子的小「元件」。
points.en: An Fe-S cluster is a small electron-transfer 'component' built from iron and sulfur atoms inside an enzyme.

points.zh: 他在黑板上边画边说是「这五个铁原子」，再配上几个硫原子。
points.en: Drawing on the board he says it is 'these five iron atoms' plus a few sulfur atoms.

points.zh: 铁硫簇的作用是把电子 trap 住，一站一站往下传递。
points.en: The cluster's job is to trap the electron and pass it on, one station at a time.

points.zh: 他强调各处的铁硫簇长得都一样，是同一类结构。
points.en: He stresses that Fe-S clusters all look alike — they are the same kind of structure everywhere.

points.zh: 最终这些电子都在复合体 III 这个中转站里全部交给细胞色素 c。
points.en: In the end all these electrons are handed over to cytochrome c at the Complex III relay station.

points.zh: 细胞色素 c 带着电子最终交给复合体 IV，这条主线记住就够了。
points.en: Cytochrome c then delivers them to Complex IV, and holding on to that main line is enough.

points.zh: 细胞色素 a、细胞色素 b 这些小分支不用记，比较重要的只有细胞色素 c。
points.en: Cytochromes a and b need not be memorised; only cytochrome c matters much.

points.zh: 复合体 IV 的中文名叫细胞色素氧化酶，但他建议还是叫 complex IV 更简单。
points.en: Complex IV's Chinese name is 细胞色素氧化酶, though he suggests simply calling it Complex IV.

points.zh: 复合体 IV 从细胞色素 c 上接受电子，再经它体内一套很复杂的电子传递位点往下传。
points.en: Complex IV receives electrons from cytochrome c and moves them onward through its own complicated internal set of redox sites.

extra.zh: 黑板上那个「五个铁原子」的铁硫簇并不存在。生物体内的 Fe-S cluster 只有 2Fe-2S、4Fe-4S 两种基本形式（外加少见的 3Fe-4S），铁由半胱氨酸的硫醇盐硫配位固定在蛋白骨架上，簇内还有无机硫（酸不稳定硫）。他当时是随手画的，但数字抄进笔记就是错的。
extra.en: The five-iron cluster on the board does not exist. Biological Fe-S clusters come in two basic forms, 2Fe-2S and 4Fe-4S, plus the less common 3Fe-4S; the irons are anchored to the protein by cysteine thiolate sulfurs, with inorganic (acid-labile) sulfide inside the cluster. He was sketching freehand, but the number is wrong if it goes into your notes.

extra.zh: 铁硫簇每次只能收发 1 个电子（Fe³⁺⇌Fe²⁺），而 NADH、FADH2、泛醌都是 2 电子载体。电子传递链的一个核心设计就是在复合体 I 和 III 里把 2 电子化学拆成 1 电子接力，Q 循环与半醌中间体正是为此存在。代价是半醌容易把电子漏给 O2 生成超氧阴离子——复合体 I 和 III 是线粒体活性氧的两个主要产生位点。
extra.en: An Fe-S cluster handles only one electron at a time (Fe3+/Fe2+), while NADH, FADH2 and ubiquinone are two-electron carriers. A core design feature of the chain is that Complexes I and III convert two-electron chemistry into a one-electron relay, which is what the Q cycle and its semiquinone intermediate are for. The price is that semiquinone leaks electrons to O2 to form superoxide — Complexes I and III are the two main mitochondrial ROS sites.

extra.zh: 复合体 IV 的规范中文名是细胞色素 c 氧化酶（cytochrome c oxidase），它就是终端酶本身；而细胞色素 c 是把电子送给它的可溶性载体。两个名字只差一个 c，紧接着的一段（约 01:42:55）老师就把这两者说反了。
extra.en: The proper Chinese name of Complex IV is 细胞色素 c 氧化酶, cytochrome c oxidase — the terminal enzyme itself — whereas cytochrome c is the soluble carrier that feeds it. The names differ by a single 'c', and in the very next stretch (around 01:42:55) he swaps the two.

extra.zh: 电子在链上严格由低电位流向高电位：NADH −0.32 V → FMN/Fe-S → 泛醌 +0.045 V → 细胞色素 b、c1、c 约 +0.22～+0.25 V → 细胞色素 a/a3 → O2/H2O +0.82 V。总落差约 1.14 V，按 ΔG°′ = −nFΔE°′ 计，每 2 个电子释放约 −220 kJ/mol，足够支撑约 10 个质子的跨膜转运。
extra.en: Electrons run strictly downhill in potential: NADH at −0.32 V, then FMN and the Fe-S chain, ubiquinone at +0.045 V, cytochromes b, c1 and c at roughly +0.22 to +0.25 V, cytochromes a/a3, and finally O2/H2O at +0.82 V. The total span of about 1.14 V gives ΔG°′ = −nFΔE°′ ≈ −220 kJ per mole of 2 electrons — enough to translocate about 10 protons.

quiz.q_zh: 生物体内铁硫簇的真实构成形式是什么？
quiz.q_en: What form do biological iron-sulfur clusters actually take?

options.zh: 血红素中的铁与卟啉环螯合，硫由外围的二硫键把它固定住
options.en: Iron chelated by a porphyrin ring as in heme, held in place by outer disulfides

options.zh: 2Fe-2S 与 4Fe-4S（少数 3Fe-4S），由半胱氨酸硫醇盐固定在蛋白上
options.en: 2Fe-2S and 4Fe-4S (rarely 3Fe-4S), anchored to the protein by cysteine thiolates

options.zh: 5Fe-5S 的对称簇，铁与硫交替排布成一个稳定的五元环结构
options.en: A symmetric 5Fe-5S cluster in which iron and sulfur alternate around a five-ring

options.zh: 单个铁原子由四个组氨酸配位，硫原子来自甲硫氨酸的侧链提供
options.en: A single iron coordinated by four histidines, with sulfur supplied by methionine

quiz.explain_zh: 标准形式是 2Fe-2S 和 4Fe-4S（少数 3Fe-4S），铁由半胱氨酸的硫醇盐配位、簇内含无机硫。五个铁的对称簇不存在，那是老师黑板上随手画多的；四个组氨酸配位的单铁中心是另一类非血红素铁蛋白的模式，不含酸不稳定硫；铁卟啉是血红素，属于细胞色素而不是铁硫簇——复合体 IV 用的就是血红素而非 Fe-S。
quiz.explain_en: The standard forms are 2Fe-2S and 4Fe-4S (with rare 3Fe-4S), the irons ligated by cysteine thiolates and the cluster containing inorganic sulfide. A symmetric five-iron cluster does not exist; that was an extra atom on the board. A single iron held by four histidines describes a different class of non-heme iron site with no acid-labile sulfur. Iron in a porphyrin is heme, which defines cytochromes rather than Fe-S clusters — and heme is exactly what Complex IV uses instead.

quiz.q_zh: 呼吸链的四个复合体中，哪一个不含铁硫簇？
quiz.q_en: Which of the four respiratory complexes contains no iron-sulfur cluster?

options.zh: 复合体 III，它的电子只经细胞色素 b 与 c1 的血红素传递
options.en: Complex III, whose electrons pass only through the hemes of cytochromes b and c1

options.zh: 复合体 I，它全靠一串黄素单核苷酸逐级完成电子的接力
options.en: Complex I, which relays electrons through a chain of flavin mononucleotides

options.zh: 复合体 II，它只用共价结合的 FAD 把电子直接交给泛醌
options.en: Complex II, which uses only its covalently bound FAD to reduce ubiquinone

options.zh: 复合体 IV，它用的是血红素 a、a3 和 CuA、CuB 两个铜中心
options.en: Complex IV, which uses hemes a and a3 plus the CuA and CuB copper centres

quiz.explain_zh: 复合体 IV 靠血红素 a、a3 和 CuA、CuB 铜中心工作，没有铁硫簇。复合体 I 含 8 个铁硫簇，黄素只有一个 FMN，不是一串；复合体 II 除共价 FAD 外还有 2Fe-2S、4Fe-4S、3Fe-4S 三个簇串到泛醌位点；复合体 III 除细胞色素 b、c1 外还有关键的 Rieske 2Fe-2S 蛋白，正是它启动 Q 循环的电子分叉。
quiz.explain_en: Complex IV works with hemes a and a3 and the CuA/CuB copper centres and has no Fe-S cluster. Complex I contains eight Fe-S clusters and only a single FMN, not a chain of flavins. Complex II, besides its covalent FAD, carries 2Fe-2S, 4Fe-4S and 3Fe-4S clusters leading to the quinone site. Complex III has, in addition to cytochromes b and c1, the crucial Rieske 2Fe-2S protein that initiates the Q-cycle bifurcation.

title_zh: 复合体 IV 生成水，以及三个质子泵的账
title_en: Water made at Complex IV, and the proton-pumping tally

points.zh: 复合体 IV 发挥的功能，是把电子送到氧气和氢离子上面，最终生成水。
points.en: Complex IV's function is to deliver electrons onto oxygen and protons, ultimately producing water.

points.zh: 整条链忙这么大劲，第一件事是在接受电子的同时接受氢离子。
points.en: For all the trouble the chain goes to, the first thing it does is take up protons along with electrons.

points.zh: 复合体 I 一次可以泵出 4 个氢离子。
points.en: Complex I pumps out 4 protons per turn.

points.zh: 他补充说自己刚刚忘了讲：复合体 III 也起质子泵的作用，同样泵出 4 个氢离子。
points.en: He adds what he had forgotten: Complex III is also a proton pump, likewise moving 4 protons.

points.zh: 他描述电子路线时说「3 通过细胞色素氧化酶把电子给 4」。
points.en: Describing the route he says 'III gives the electrons to IV through cytochrome oxidase'.

points.zh: 复合体 IV 在这个过程中也能泵出 2 分子氢离子。
points.en: Complex IV, in the same process, also pumps out 2 protons.

points.zh: 复合体 IV 最终负责把氧气、氢离子和电子结合到一起生成水。
points.en: Complex IV is finally responsible for combining oxygen, protons and electrons into water.

points.zh: 讲到这里他指出：电子的去向讲完了，但氢离子的去向还没讲——氢离子最终在 ATP 合酶那里发挥作用。
points.en: At this point he notes that the fate of the electrons has been covered but not that of the protons, which finally act at ATP synthase.

points.zh: 所有电子传递链产生的氢离子都是从 matrix（基质）被泵出，蹦到线粒体内膜与外膜之间的间隙里。
points.en: All the protons generated by the chain are pumped out of the matrix into the gap between the inner and outer mitochondrial membranes.

extra.zh: 「3 通过细胞色素氧化酶把电子给 4」——在复合体 III 与 IV 之间传电子的是细胞色素 c，而细胞色素 c 氧化酶就是复合体 IV 本身，不是中间体。他在约 01:41:49 刚刚正确说过复合体 IV 的中文名，这里把载体与终端酶换了位置，属口误，但这句话照抄进笔记会把整条链的顺序记反。
extra.en: 'III gives the electrons to IV through cytochrome oxidase' — the carrier between Complexes III and IV is cytochrome c, while cytochrome c oxidase *is* Complex IV, not an intermediate. He had given Complex IV's Chinese name correctly around 01:41:49; here the carrier and the terminal enzyme have swapped places. Copied into notes as spoken, this sentence inverts the order of the whole chain.

extra.zh: 每传递 2 个电子的泵出数：复合体 I 约 4 H⁺、复合体 II 0 个、复合体 III 约 4 H⁺、复合体 IV 约 2 H⁺。所以 NADH 走完全程约 10 H⁺，FADH2 从复合体 II 进入只有 6 H⁺，10:6 正对应 2.5:1.5 个 ATP。这也说明「FADH2 少一个 ATP」不是因为它少了什么氢，而是因为它跳过了复合体 I 这个泵。
extra.en: Protons pumped per 2 electrons: about 4 at Complex I, 0 at Complex II, about 4 at Complex III, about 2 at Complex IV. NADH therefore drives about 10 H+ over the full route while FADH2, entering at Complex II, drives only 6 — and 10:6 is exactly the 2.5:1.5 ATP ratio. This also shows that FADH2 yields less not because it carries less hydrogen but because it bypasses the Complex I pump.

extra.zh: 复合体 IV 的完整反应是 4 cyt c(Fe²⁺) + O₂ + 8 H⁺(基质) → 4 cyt c(Fe³⁺) + 2 H₂O + 4 H⁺(膜间隙)。8 个基质质子里，4 个被消耗掉变成水（「化学质子」），另外 4 个被真正泵过膜（「泵质子」）。两者都在降低基质侧的质子浓度，所以生成水这一步本身也对质子动力势有贡献——课上按每 2 电子记成 2 个泵质子，是同一个化学计量的一半。
extra.en: The full Complex IV reaction is 4 cyt c(Fe2+) + O2 + 8 H+(matrix) → 4 cyt c(Fe3+) + 2 H2O + 4 H+(intermembrane space). Of the eight matrix protons, four are consumed into water ('chemical protons') and four are genuinely pumped across ('pumped protons'). Both lower the matrix proton concentration, so making water itself contributes to the proton-motive force. The lecture's figure of 2 pumped per 2 electrons is simply half of this stoichiometry.

extra.zh: 氧气在这里是终端电子受体，它的作用不是「提供能量」，而是把还原型载体重新氧化、让整条链能继续周转。这也是缺氧时链会「堵住」的原因：所有载体停在还原态，NADH 无处可去，TCA 循环随之停摆。氰化物、CO、叠氮和硫化氢正是通过卡住复合体 IV 的双核 a3–CuB 中心致命的。
extra.en: Oxygen here is the terminal electron acceptor; its role is not to supply energy but to re-oxidise the reduced carriers so the chain can keep turning. That is why hypoxia jams the chain: every carrier sits reduced, NADH has nowhere to go, and the TCA cycle stalls behind it. Cyanide, carbon monoxide, azide and hydrogen sulfide kill precisely by blocking the binuclear a3–CuB centre of Complex IV.

quiz.q_zh: 电子从复合体 III 传到复合体 IV，靠的是哪一个载体？
quiz.q_en: Which carrier moves electrons from Complex III to Complex IV?

options.zh: 泛醌，它在内膜的脂相里把电子横向送到复合体 IV
options.en: Ubiquinone, carrying electrons laterally in the inner-membrane lipid

options.zh: Rieske 铁硫蛋白，它摆动头部把电子直接交给复合体 IV
options.en: The Rieske Fe-S protein, whose head swings electrons over to Complex IV

options.zh: 细胞色素 c，一个附着在内膜膜间隙侧的可溶性载体
options.en: Cytochrome c, a soluble carrier bound to the intermembrane-space face

options.zh: 细胞色素 c 氧化酶，它在膜间隙侧来回摆渡这些电子
options.en: Cytochrome c oxidase, ferrying electrons on the intermembrane face

quiz.explain_zh: 载体是细胞色素 c；细胞色素 c 氧化酶就是复合体 IV 本身，把它说成中间体就是老师这里的口误。泛醌只在复合体 I／II 与复合体 III 之间工作，它是脂溶性的，无法接近膜间隙侧的复合体 IV 结合面；Rieske 铁硫蛋白的头部确实会摆动，但摆动范围只在复合体 III 内部，从 Qo 位点摆到细胞色素 c1，不出复合体。
quiz.explain_en: The carrier is cytochrome c; cytochrome c oxidase is Complex IV itself, and calling it an intermediate is exactly the slip made here. Ubiquinone operates only between Complexes I/II and Complex III and, being lipid-soluble, cannot reach the Complex IV docking face on the intermembrane side. The Rieske protein's head really does swing, but only within Complex III, from the Qo site to cytochrome c1, never leaving the complex.

quiz.q_zh: 每传递 2 个电子，四个复合体泵出的质子数依次约为多少？
quiz.q_en: Per 2 electrons transferred, roughly how many protons does each complex pump?

options.zh: 复合体 I 泵 4 个、II 泵 0 个、III 泵 4 个、IV 泵 2 个
options.en: Complex I pumps 4, II pumps none, III pumps 4, and IV pumps 2

options.zh: 复合体 I 泵 2 个、II 泵 0 个、III 泵 2 个、IV 泵 4 个
options.en: Complex I pumps 2, II pumps none, III pumps 2, and IV pumps 4

options.zh: 复合体 I 泵 4 个、II 泵 4 个、III 泵 2 个、IV 泵 0 个
options.en: Complex I pumps 4, II pumps 4, III pumps 2, and IV pumps none

options.zh: 复合体 I 泵 4 个、II 泵 2 个、III 泵 4 个、IV 泵 0 个
options.en: Complex I pumps 4, II pumps 2, III pumps 4, and IV pumps none

quiz.explain_zh: 标准计量是 4、0、4、2。凡是给复合体 II 分配质子的都错——它的电位落差近于零，做不了跨膜功，这也正是老师这一段唯一强调要记住的点。把复合体 IV 记成 0 是他上一大段留下的错误（他在这里已经自己补正为 2）。把 I、III 记成 2 个则算不出 NADH 的 10 H⁺，也就得不到 2.5 个 ATP 这个数。
quiz.explain_en: The standard stoichiometry is 4, 0, 4, 2. Any allocation that gives Complex II protons is wrong — its redox span is near zero and cannot do transmembrane work, which is the single point he insisted on remembering in this stretch. Giving Complex IV zero repeats his earlier error, which he corrects to 2 right here. Reducing Complexes I and III to 2 each fails to add up to the 10 H+ behind NADH and so cannot give the figure of 2.5 ATP.

quiz.q_zh: 复合体 IV 的总反应里，取自基质的 8 个质子的去向是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the overall Complex IV reaction, what becomes of the 8 protons taken from the matrix?

options.zh: 2 个生成 1 分子水，其余 6 个用来稳定膜电位不外流
options.en: 2 make one water and the other 6 stay to stabilise the membrane potential

options.zh: 8 个全部被泵到膜间隙，水由膜间隙侧的质子来生成
options.en: All 8 are pumped out, and water is made from intermembrane protons

options.zh: 4 个被泵出，另外 4 个随电子一起回到细胞色素 c 上
options.en: 4 are pumped out and 4 return to cytochrome c along with electrons

options.zh: 4 个与 O₂ 及 4 个电子生成 2 分子水，另外 4 个被泵出
options.en: 4 combine with O2 and 4 electrons to give 2 water, and 4 are pumped

quiz.explain_zh: 反应是 4 cyt c(Fe²⁺) + O₂ + 8 H⁺(基质) → 4 cyt c(Fe³⁺) + 2 H₂O + 4 H⁺(膜间隙)：4 个化学质子成水，4 个泵质子过膜。水必须由基质侧的质子生成，因为氧还原化学发生在基质侧的双核中心，说水由膜间隙质子生成方向就反了；细胞色素 c 只传电子、不带质子回去；把 6 个质子留在基质「稳定膜电位」也说不通——膜电位正是靠质子离开基质建立的。
quiz.explain_en: The reaction is 4 cyt c(Fe2+) + O2 + 8 H+(matrix) → 4 cyt c(Fe3+) + 2 H2O + 4 H+(intermembrane space): four chemical protons become water and four are pumped. The water must come from matrix protons because the oxygen chemistry happens at the matrix-facing binuclear centre, so sourcing it from the intermembrane side reverses the geometry. Cytochrome c carries electrons only and takes no protons back. And keeping six protons in the matrix to 'stabilise the membrane potential' is backwards — the potential arises precisely because protons leave the matrix.

title_zh: 质子电化学梯度与 ATP 合酶的质子通道
title_en: The proton electrochemical gradient and the channel through ATP synthase

points.zh: 图上写的是 electrochemical gradient（电化学梯度）：膜间隙里氢离子多，膜内侧氢离子少。
points.en: The figure is labelled 'electrochemical gradient': many protons in the intermembrane space, few on the inside.

points.zh: 外边多、里边少，这些氢离子天然就有一种往里冲的冲动。
points.en: More outside than inside, so the protons naturally have an urge to rush back in.

points.zh: ATP 合酶提供的正是这样一个渠道：它中间有一个质子通道。
points.en: ATP synthase supplies exactly that route: it has a proton channel running through its middle.

points.zh: 质子通过这个通道，从膜间隙重新回到膜的内侧。
points.en: Protons pass through this channel from the intermembrane space back inside.

points.zh: 在质子回流的这个过程中，酶利用运输过程产生的能量来合成 ATP。
points.en: During that return flow, the enzyme uses the energy released by the transport to synthesise ATP.

points.zh: 学生问：是不是无限地往外泵、又随 ATP 合酶回来、再往外泵？他回答「其实也不全是」。
points.en: A student asks whether protons are endlessly pumped out and brought back; he answers that it is not quite like that.

points.zh: 回流之后的质子已经失去了它原来带有的电势能／化学势能。
points.en: Once returned, a proton has lost the electrical and chemical potential energy it carried.

points.zh: 在膜外时它受到大量同类质子的排挤，有天然向内的倾向；进到里面以后就没有再往外走的倾向了。
points.en: Outside it is crowded by other protons and has an inward tendency; once inside it has no tendency to leave again.

points.zh: 图上可以看到两个氢离子与氧气生成一分子水，同时另外两个氢离子被泵出去。
points.en: In the figure two protons combine with oxygen into one water while two more are pumped out.

extra.zh: 他全程把线粒体内膜说成「细胞膜」「细胞内膜」，把膜间隙说成「细胞膜间隙」。质子梯度只能建立在线粒体内膜两侧：外膜上密布 porin，对小分子和离子几乎自由通透，外膜两侧根本没有梯度。这与质膜（细胞膜）无关——只有细菌才把这一整套装在质膜上。
extra.en: Throughout he says 'cell membrane' or 'inner cell membrane' for the inner mitochondrial membrane, and 'cell-membrane space' for the intermembrane space. The proton gradient can only exist across the inner mitochondrial membrane: the outer membrane is studded with porins and is essentially freely permeable to ions and small molecules, so no gradient forms across it. None of this involves the plasma membrane — only bacteria run the whole apparatus there.

extra.zh: 质子动力势 Δp 有两个分量：膜电位 Δψ 和跨膜 pH 差，Δp = Δψ − (2.3RT/F)·ΔpH。在活跃呼吸的哺乳动物线粒体里 Δψ 约 150–180 mV，是主要贡献；ΔpH 通常只有约 0.5–1 个 pH 单位（约 30–60 mV）。膜电位占优是因为泵出的是带电粒子而基质侧有大量缓冲。
extra.en: The proton-motive force has two components, membrane potential and transmembrane pH difference: Δp = Δψ − (2.3RT/F)·ΔpH. In actively respiring mammalian mitochondria Δψ is about 150–180 mV and dominates, while ΔpH is usually only about 0.5–1 pH unit (roughly 30–60 mV). The potential dominates because what is pumped is a charged particle and the matrix side is heavily buffered.

extra.zh: 「失去势能」更准确的说法是：质子回流的自由能被转换成了 ATP 合酶转子的机械功，再变成 ATP 的磷酸酐键。这就是化学渗透假说（Mitchell, 1961）的核心——氧化与磷酸化之间的偶联介质不是某个高能共价中间体，而是跨膜电化学梯度本身。这个假说提出时争议极大，Mitchell 于 1978 年获诺贝尔化学奖。
extra.en: A sharper way to say 'loses its potential energy': the free energy of the returning proton is converted into mechanical work on the rotor of ATP synthase and then into the phosphoanhydride bond of ATP. That is the core of the chemiosmotic hypothesis (Mitchell, 1961) — the coupling intermediate between oxidation and phosphorylation is not some high-energy covalent compound but the transmembrane electrochemical gradient itself. It was fiercely disputed when proposed; Mitchell received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1978.

extra.zh: 内膜对质子几乎完全不通透，这是梯度能维持的前提；ATP 合酶的 FO 是唯一受控的回流口。解偶联剂 DNP 是脂溶性弱酸，能带着质子直接穿过内膜绕开 ATP 合酶，梯度被耗散，呼吸拼命加快却不产 ATP，能量全变成热——1930 年代曾作减肥药，因致死性高热被禁。棕色脂肪的 UCP1 是生理性的同一原理。
extra.en: The inner membrane is essentially impermeable to protons, which is what lets the gradient persist, and the FO of ATP synthase is the only controlled return route. The uncoupler DNP is a lipid-soluble weak acid that ferries protons straight across the membrane, bypassing ATP synthase; the gradient collapses, respiration races, no ATP is made and the energy all appears as heat — it was sold as a diet drug in the 1930s and banned after fatal hyperthermia. UCP1 in brown fat is the same principle used physiologically.

quiz.q_zh: 线粒体的质子动力势由哪两部分组成，其中哪一部分贡献更大？
quiz.q_en: Which two components make up the mitochondrial proton-motive force, and which dominates?

options.zh: 跨膜 pH 差与渗透压差，其中 pH 差的贡献要大得多
options.en: Transmembrane pH difference and osmotic pressure, with pH far dominant

options.zh: 膜电位与外膜两侧的离子强度差，后者的贡献占多数
options.en: Membrane potential and outer-membrane ionic strength, the latter dominant

options.zh: 基质温度差与膜电位，二者在静息线粒体中各占一半
options.en: Matrix temperature gradient and potential, each half in resting organelles

options.zh: 膜电位与跨膜 pH 差，哺乳动物线粒体中膜电位贡献更大
options.en: Membrane potential and transmembrane pH difference, with potential dominant

quiz.explain_zh: Δp = Δψ − (2.3RT/F)·ΔpH，两个分量是膜电位和 pH 差；哺乳动物线粒体里 Δψ 约 150–180 mV，远大于 ΔpH 折算的约 30–60 mV。渗透压差和温度差都不是电化学梯度的分量，线粒体基质与胞质渗透压基本平衡；外膜因为有 porin 而无法维持任何离子梯度，谈它两侧的离子强度差没有意义。
quiz.explain_en: Δp = Δψ − (2.3RT/F)·ΔpH, so the components are membrane potential and pH difference; in mammalian mitochondria Δψ of 150–180 mV far exceeds the 30–60 mV equivalent of ΔpH. Osmotic and temperature gradients are not components of an electrochemical gradient, and matrix and cytosol are essentially iso-osmotic. The porin-permeable outer membrane sustains no ion gradient at all, so its ionic strength difference is meaningless.

quiz.q_zh: 解偶联剂 DNP 让线粒体耗氧升高却几乎不产 ATP，机制是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why does the uncoupler DNP raise mitochondrial oxygen consumption while making almost no ATP?

options.zh: 它带着质子穿过内膜回流，绕过 ATP 合酶把梯度耗散掉
options.en: It carries protons across the membrane, dissipating the gradient past F1FO

options.zh: 它直接抑制复合体 IV，使电子传递停滞在细胞色素 c 上
options.en: It inhibits Complex IV directly, stalling electron flow at cytochrome c

options.zh: 它堵住 FO 的质子通道，让质子无法回流到线粒体基质
options.en: It plugs the FO proton channel so protons cannot return to the matrix

options.zh: 它把 ATP 合酶的 γ 亚基锁死，使三个 β 亚基无法再变构
options.en: It locks the gamma subunit so the three beta subunits cannot change shape

quiz.explain_zh: DNP 是脂溶性弱酸，在膜间隙侧结合质子、以中性分子形式穿过内膜、在基质侧释放质子，等于给内膜开了一个旁路，梯度被耗散、呼吸链失去反压所以拼命加速耗氧，能量全成热。抑制复合体 IV（氰化物那类）会让耗氧下降而不是升高；堵住 FO（寡霉素）或锁死 γ 会让梯度堆高、呼吸变慢，这叫抑制而不是解偶联。
quiz.explain_en: DNP is a lipid-soluble weak acid: it picks up a proton on the intermembrane side, crosses the membrane as the neutral form and releases it in the matrix, opening a bypass that dissipates the gradient. With the back-pressure gone the chain races and oxygen consumption rises, with all the energy appearing as heat. Inhibiting Complex IV, as cyanide does, lowers oxygen consumption rather than raising it. Plugging FO (oligomycin) or locking the gamma shaft builds the gradient up and slows respiration — that is inhibition, not uncoupling.

title_zh: 水的去向说法，与 F1／FO 的命名和取向
title_en: The claimed fate of the water, and the naming and orientation of F1/FO

points.zh: 他说回流后的质子已经没有化学电势能了，对细胞来说就已经失去了功能。
points.en: He says a returned proton no longer has electrochemical potential energy and has thus lost its use to the cell.

points.zh: 所以细胞会把这些氢离子和氧气结合到一起，让它生成水分子。
points.en: So, he says, the cell combines these protons with oxygen to make water.

points.zh: 他接着说这个水分子可以进一步参与到 TCA 循环里面去。
points.en: He then says this water can go on to take part in the TCA cycle.

points.zh: 他举的例子是「延胡索酸脱去两分子的水变成富马酸」。
points.en: His example is that 'fumaric acid loses two waters to become fumarate'.

points.zh: 然后说富马酸马上接受一分子水变成苹果酸，所以水最终回到这个位置发挥作用。
points.en: He then says fumarate immediately takes up one water to become malate, so the water finds its use there.

points.zh: 总结：ATP 合酶就是利用氢的化学电势能（electrochemical gradient）来产生 ATP 的。
points.en: His summary: ATP synthase makes ATP using the electrochemical gradient of hydrogen.

points.zh: 他放的是一个自己读书时就看过的、很经典的 ATP 合酶模拟动画。
points.en: He plays a classic ATP synthase animation he has watched since his own student days.

points.zh: 动画上方那一端朝向线粒体基质，下方那个「屁股」才是插在磷脂双分子层即线粒体内膜里的部分。
points.en: The top end in the animation faces the matrix; the bottom end is what sits in the lipid bilayer of the inner membrane.

points.zh: 他特别纠正：下面那个复合物叫 FO，是字母 O 不是数字 0；F1 是生成 ATP 的基团，FO 是质子通道，国内不少教材写成了 F0。
points.en: He specifically corrects the naming: the lower complex is FO with the letter O, not a zero; F1 is the ATP-forming part and FO the proton channel, while many domestic textbooks print F0.

extra.zh: 「延胡索酸脱去两分子的水变成富马酸」有两处错：延胡索酸就是富马酸（fumarate 的两个中文名），不可能由前者脱水生成后者；而且这一步的底物是琥珀酸，琥珀酸→富马酸是脱氢，由琥珀酸脱氢酶（复合体 II）把 2 个氢交给酶内 FAD 生成 FADH2，不是脱水。他紧接着说的「富马酸加一分子水变成苹果酸」（延胡索酸酶催化的水合）是对的。
extra.en: 'Fumaric acid loses two waters to become fumarate' contains two errors: 延胡索酸 and 富马酸 are two Chinese names for the same molecule, fumarate, so one cannot dehydrate into the other; and the substrate of that step is succinate, with succinate → fumarate being a dehydrogenation in which succinate dehydrogenase (Complex II) passes two hydrogens to its bound FAD to give FADH2 — not a dehydration. His next statement, that fumarate adds one water to become malate (the fumarase-catalysed hydration), is correct.

extra.zh: 复合体 IV 生成水的意义是为电子传递链提供终端电子受体，使各载体重新被氧化、让链能继续转，不是为了给 fumarase 供水。细胞里的水是一个巨大的公共池（几十摩尔浓度），不存在「这一分子水专门送去 TCA 循环」的通路；把它讲成目的论的物质循环会误导。同样，回到基质的质子也不是「失去功能被处理掉」，它们只是回到了公共质子池，随时可以再被泵出去。
extra.en: The point of making water at Complex IV is to give the chain a terminal electron acceptor so the carriers are re-oxidised and turnover can continue — not to supply fumarase with water. Cellular water is one enormous shared pool at tens of molar, and there is no pathway that routes this particular molecule to the TCA cycle; describing it as a teleological material cycle is misleading. Likewise, protons returning to the matrix are not 'spent and disposed of'; they simply rejoin the common proton pool and can be pumped out again.

extra.zh: FO 的 O 取自 oligomycin（寡霉素）——这一部分是寡霉素敏感的，寡霉素结合在 c 环与 a 亚基的界面上就能停掉全部氧化磷酸化，这也是临床上判断 ATP 合酶是否参与呼吸的经典药理工具。F1 的名字则来自它是最早从线粒体膜上洗脱下来的「Factor 1」，游离的 F1 在体外只表现 ATP 水解活性，因此曾被称为 F1-ATPase。
extra.en: The O in FO comes from oligomycin: this sector is oligomycin-sensitive, and oligomycin bound at the interface between the c-ring and subunit a shuts down oxidative phosphorylation entirely — still the classic pharmacological tool for testing whether respiration is coupled to ATP synthase. F1 was named as 'Factor 1', the first factor eluted from mitochondrial membranes; isolated F1 shows only ATP hydrolysis in vitro, which is why it was long called the F1-ATPase.

extra.zh: 取向要记牢：F1 头伸在基质里，因此 ATP 是在基质侧合成的；FO 嵌在内膜内，质子从膜间隙侧经 a 亚基的一条半通道进入、绕 c 环一圈后从另一条半通道出到基质。合成的 ATP 还要由腺苷酸转位酶 ANT 与胞质 ADP 交换出去，ATP⁴⁻ 换 ADP³⁻ 净带走一个负电荷，本身就要消耗膜电位；再加上磷酸转运体 PiC 以 H⁺ 同向共转运带入 Pi，这两步合计约再花掉 1 个质子。
extra.en: Fix the orientation: the F1 head projects into the matrix, so ATP is made on the matrix side; FO sits within the inner membrane, and protons enter from the intermembrane side through one half-channel in subunit a, ride the c-ring around, and exit through the other half-channel into the matrix. The ATP made must then be exported by the adenine nucleotide translocase in exchange for cytosolic ADP; swapping ATP4- for ADP3- moves one net negative charge outward and so consumes membrane potential, and the phosphate carrier brings Pi in by H+ symport — together these cost roughly one further proton.

quiz.q_zh: 琥珀酸转变为延胡索酸（富马酸）这一步的化学本质是什么？
quiz.q_en: What kind of reaction converts succinate into fumarate?

options.zh: 脱氢，由复合体 II 把两个氢交给酶内 FAD 生成 FADH2
options.en: Dehydrogenation, Complex II passing two hydrogens to its bound FAD

options.zh: 脱羧，放出一分子 CO₂ 并把电子交给 NAD⁺ 生成 NADH
options.en: Decarboxylation, releasing CO2 and giving electrons to NAD+ as NADH

options.zh: 加水，由琥珀酸脱氢酶催化并同时泵出 4 个质子到膜外
options.en: Hydration by succinate dehydrogenase, pumping 4 protons meanwhile

options.zh: 脱去两分子水，由延胡索酸酶催化，产物随后立即被氧化
options.en: Loss of two waters by fumarase, the product being oxidised right after

quiz.explain_zh: 琥珀酸→富马酸是脱氢反应，琥珀酸脱氢酶（就是复合体 II）把两个氢交给共价结合的 FAD 生成 FADH2，再经铁硫簇给泛醌。延胡索酸与富马酸是同一个分子的两个中文名，所以「延胡索酸脱水变富马酸」不成立；这一步不脱羧，TCA 循环的两次脱羧发生在异柠檬酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体；加水的是下一步（延胡索酸酶把富马酸水合成苹果酸），而且复合体 II 不泵质子。
quiz.explain_en: Succinate to fumarate is a dehydrogenation: succinate dehydrogenase, which is Complex II, hands two hydrogens to its covalently bound FAD to give FADH2, then relays the electrons through Fe-S clusters to ubiquinone. 延胡索酸 and 富马酸 are two Chinese names for the same molecule, so dehydrating one into the other is impossible.
