No decarboxylation occurs here — the cycle's two decarboxylations are at isocitrate dehydrogenase and the alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex. Hydration is the next step, fumarase making malate, and Complex II pumps no protons at all.

quiz.q_zh: 复合体 IV 生成水，在生理上的主要意义是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the main physiological point of making water at Complex IV?

options.zh: 提供终端电子受体，使各载体重新氧化让电子传递继续
options.en: To provide the terminal acceptor that re-oxidises every carrier

options.zh: 生成的水稀释基质内容物，维持线粒体的渗透压平衡
options.en: To dilute the matrix contents and keep the organelle iso-osmotic

options.zh: 为延胡索酸酶提供水，使富马酸得以水合生成苹果酸
options.en: To supply fumarase with water so that fumarate can be hydrated

options.zh: 把失去势能的质子清除掉，避免基质被多余质子酸化
options.en: To clear spent protons and keep the matrix from being acidified

quiz.explain_zh: 氧被还原成水的意义在于它是终端电子受体：没有它，所有载体停在还原态、链无法周转，NADH 堆积、TCA 循环随之停摆——缺氧致死的直接机制就是这个。给 fumarase 供水是老师这里的目的论说法，细胞水是几十摩尔的公共池，不需要专门供应；质子回到基质后并没有「变成废物」，它们回到质子池随时可被再泵出；每 2 电子只生成 1 分子水，这点体积对渗透压毫无意义。
quiz.explain_en: Reducing oxygen to water matters because oxygen is the terminal electron acceptor: without it every carrier stays reduced, turnover stops, NADH piles up and the TCA cycle stalls behind it — the direct mechanism by which anoxia kills. Supplying fumarase is the teleological account given here; cellular water is a shared pool at tens of molar and needs no dedicated source. Protons that return to the matrix do not become waste; they rejoin the pool and can be pumped again. And one water per two electrons is far too little volume to matter osmotically.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 F1 与 FO 的命名和取向，下列哪一条是正确的？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the naming and orientation of F1 and FO is correct?

options.zh: FO 的 O 取自寡霉素，嵌在内膜中；F1 头部伸向基质一侧
options.en: The O of FO is for oligomycin and sits in the membrane; F1 faces the matrix

options.zh: FO 的 O 是数字零，嵌在外膜中；F1 头部伸向膜间隙一侧
options.en: The O of FO is a zero and sits in the outer membrane; F1 faces the gap

options.zh: F1 是埋在膜内的质子通道；FO 在基质一侧负责催化合成 ATP
options.en: F1 is the buried proton channel; FO lies in the matrix and makes ATP

options.zh: 两者都位于内膜的膜间隙一侧，靠外周柄一起固定在膜表面
options.en: Both lie on the intermembrane face, held to the surface by the stalk

quiz.explain_zh: FO 的 O 是字母，取自 oligomycin（寡霉素敏感因子），它嵌在线粒体内膜里承担质子通道；F1 是可溶的头部，伸在基质里，ATP 在基质侧生成。写成数字 0 正是老师批评的国内教材通病；把 F1 说成质子通道、FO 说成合成部位是把两者完全对调；两者都在膜间隙侧则违背了整个取向——若如此，ATP 会生成在错误的一侧，ANT 也无从工作。
quiz.explain_en: The O of FO is a letter, from oligomycin (the oligomycin-sensitivity factor); FO is embedded in the inner membrane and forms the proton channel, while F1 is the soluble head projecting into the matrix where ATP is made. Writing it as a zero is exactly the textbook habit he criticises. Calling F1 the channel and FO the synthetic part swaps the two outright. Putting both on the intermembrane face contradicts the whole architecture — ATP would appear on the wrong side and the adenine nucleotide translocase would have nothing to do.

title_zh: F1 的三个催化位点与旋转催化（录音在此中断）
title_en: The three catalytic sites of F1 and rotary catalysis (the recording breaks off here)

points.zh: 动画里所有黄色小球都是氢离子（质子），它们从膜外经过黄色的 FO 部分进入 ATP 合酶。
points.en: All the yellow spheres in the animation are protons, entering the synthase from outside through the yellow FO sector.

points.zh: 他说质子由此进入到 ATP 合酶的 F1 复合物里边。
points.en: He says the protons thereby enter the F1 complex of the synthase.

points.zh: 他把 F1 描述成一个三聚体，有三个亚基。
points.en: He describes F1 as a trimer with three subunits.

points.zh: 三个亚基在同一时间点功能各不相同，分为 Open type、Tense type 和 Loose type。
points.en: At any instant the three subunits differ in function and are classed as open, tense and loose types.

points.zh: 他先说 O 型完全开放、可以去结合氢质子；T 型最紧张、紧密结合氢质子并且有活性；L 型是用来释放的。
points.en: He first says the open type binds protons, the tense type binds them tightly and is active, and the loose type is the releasing one.

points.zh: 回答学生提问时他明确：三种状态在每一个时刻都是同时存在的。
points.en: Answering a question, he confirms that all three states exist simultaneously at every moment.

points.zh: 他否定动画里底座在转的画面，说实际上是上面这个三聚体在发生旋转，每转一次 O 变 L、L 变 T、T 变 O，三个亚基同时变构。
points.en: He overrides the animation's rotating base and says the upper trimer is what turns, each turn taking O to L, L to T and T to O, all three changing conformation together.

points.zh: 约 01:50:52 他自己改口给出正确分工：O 态口袋开得最大、是 ATP 释放，T 态是 ATP 结合，L 态是 ADP 结合。
points.en: At about 01:50:52 he corrects himself and gives the right assignment: the open state has the widest pocket and releases ATP, the tense state holds ATP, and the loose state binds ADP.

points.zh: 他最后描述：ADP 结合到 L 位、磷酸上来，转过去就变成 ATP，原来 ATP 那个位置转到 O 位就释放出一分子 ATP，并说「每一次旋转都释放出一个 ATP」——话说到「会议时间好像要」时录音中断，他没有机会再补充或更正。
points.en: He ends by describing ADP binding at the loose site, phosphate coming on, and rotation turning it into ATP which is then released at the open site, adding that 'each rotation releases one ATP' — and the recording cuts off mid-sentence at '会议时间好像要', leaving him no chance to add or correct anything.

extra.zh: F1 上的三个催化位点结合的是 ADP + Pi 和 ATP，不是质子。质子根本不进 F1：它从膜间隙侧经 a 亚基的半通道进入，质子化 c 亚基上的一个保守天冬氨酸／谷氨酸，随 c 环转过一圈后从另一条半通道释放到基质。FO 与 F1 之间是机械偶联（转子的扭矩），不是化学偶联。他在约 01:50:52 已把 O／T／L 的分工改对，但「位点结合质子」这个说法前后出现两次，都需要纠正。
extra.en: The three catalytic sites of F1 bind ADP + Pi and ATP, not protons. Protons never enter F1: they come in from the intermembrane side through a half-channel in subunit a, protonate a conserved aspartate/glutamate on a c subunit, ride the ring around, and leave into the matrix through the second half-channel. FO and F1 are coupled mechanically, by torque on the rotor, not chemically. He fixes the O/T/L assignment himself at about 01:50:52, but the claim that the sites bind protons appears twice and needs correcting in both places.

extra.zh: 转的不是上面的头。α3β3 头部被外周柄 b2δ（stator，定子）拴住不动，转子是 c 环加 γ、ε 亚基；γ 的不对称长杆插在 α3β3 中央转动，依次把三个 β 推过 open→loose→tight 的构象循环。这正是 rotary catalysis 的核心：三个 β 化学序列完全相同，全靠 γ 杆的不对称接触把它们区分开。Boyer 与 Walker 因结合变化机制获 1997 年诺贝尔化学奖，Noji 等把荧光肌动蛋白丝接在 γ 上直接看到了它的转动。另外 F1 头是 α3β3 六聚体，催化位点在 3 个 β 上，不要记成「只有三个亚基」。
extra.en: It is not the head that rotates. The α3β3 head is held still by the peripheral b2δ stalk, the stator, while the rotor is the c-ring together with the gamma and epsilon subunits; the asymmetric gamma shaft turns inside the head and drives each of the three beta subunits through the open→loose→tight cycle in turn. That asymmetry is the heart of rotary catalysis: the three betas are chemically identical and are distinguished only by which face of the gamma shaft they contact. Boyer and Walker won the 1997 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for the binding change mechanism, and Noji and colleagues attached a fluorescent actin filament to gamma and watched it turn directly. Note also that the F1 head is an α3β3 hexamer with the catalytic sites on the three betas — not merely three subunits.

extra.zh: 他最后说「每一次旋转都释放出一个 ATP」，录音就此中断，没有更正。标准结论是 γ 亚基每转完整的 360° 产生 3 个 ATP——三个 β 各跑一遍 open→loose→tight，各放出 1 个；γ 每转 120° 才对应 1 个 ATP。如果「一次旋转」指的是 120° 的一步，那说法可以成立，但按字面听就会记成 1 转 1 ATP，直接把产率算成三分之一。
extra.en: His closing sentence, 'every rotation releases one ATP', is where the recording stops, so it is never corrected. The standard result is that a full 360° rotation of the gamma subunit yields three ATP — each of the three betas runs one open→loose→tight cycle and releases one — so one ATP corresponds to a 120° step. If 'one rotation' meant that 120° step the statement would stand, but taken literally it fixes the yield at one third of the true value.

extra.zh: 一圈要花多少质子由 c 环化学计量决定：c 环每转一整圈需要 n 个质子（n = c 亚基数，物种间 8–15，哺乳动物为 8，酵母 10，菠菜叶绿体 14），换来 3 个 ATP，即约 2.7 H⁺/ATP；不同物种落在约 2.7–3.3 H⁺/ATP 之间。再加上 ANT 与 Pi 转运耗掉的约 1 个质子，常用估计是 ~4 H⁺/ATP。正因为质子计量与 ATP 计量不成整数比，P/O 比才不是整数——NADH 约 10 H⁺ ÷ 4 ≈ 2.5，FADH2 约 6 H⁺ ÷ 4 ≈ 1.5。
extra.en: How many protons a full turn costs is set by the c-ring stoichiometry: one complete revolution requires n protons, where n is the number of c subunits (8–15 across species: 8 in mammals, 10 in yeast, 14 in spinach chloroplasts), and buys 3 ATP — about 2.7 H+ per ATP in mammals, with species falling in the 2.7–3.3 range. Adding the roughly one further proton spent on the adenine nucleotide translocase and phosphate carrier gives the commonly used figure of about 4 H+ per ATP. Because the proton and ATP stoichiometries are not in integer ratio, P/O ratios are not integers either: NADH gives about 10 H+ ÷ 4 ≈ 2.5 and FADH2 about 6 H+ ÷ 4 ≈ 1.5.

quiz.q_zh: ATP 合酶工作时，真正发生旋转的是哪一部分？
quiz.q_en: When ATP synthase works, which part actually rotates?

options.zh: c 环连同 γ、ε 亚基旋转，α3β3 被 b2δ 外周柄拴住不动
options.en: The c-ring with gamma and epsilon turns; b2δ holds α3β3 in place

options.zh: α3β3 头部整体旋转，而 c 环被外周柄拴住保持不动
options.en: The whole α3β3 head turns while the stalk holds the c-ring still

options.zh: 只有 γ 亚基旋转，c 环则随质子流上下往复地移动
options.en: Only gamma turns, while the c-ring slides up and down with flow

options.zh: b2δ 外周柄绕轴旋转，带动三个 β 亚基依次发生变构
options.en: The b2δ stalk spins on its axis and drives the three betas in turn

quiz.explain_zh: 转子是 c 环 + γ + ε，定子是 α3β3 加 b2δ 外周柄：质子流推动 c 环，γ 杆随之在静止的头部内部转动，把三个 β 依次推过三种构象。老师在课上否定了动画、改说上面的头在转，正好说反了。γ 单独转而 c 环上下往复没有任何结构依据，质子推动的是 c 环的旋转；外周柄的功能恰恰是不转——它必须抗住扭矩，头部才不会跟着一起空转。
quiz.explain_en: The rotor is the c-ring plus gamma and epsilon; the stator is α3β3 with the b2δ peripheral stalk. Proton flow turns the c-ring, the gamma shaft turns with it inside the stationary head, and the three betas are pushed through their three conformations in turn. Overriding the animation to say the head turns inverts this. Gamma turning while the c-ring slides back and forth has no structural basis — proton flow drives ring rotation. And the peripheral stalk's whole job is not to turn: it must resist the torque, or the head would simply spin along and no catalysis would occur.

quiz.q_zh: F1 上那三个催化位点结合的底物究竟是什么？
quiz.q_en: What do the three catalytic sites on F1 actually bind?

options.zh: 质子，质子先进入 F1，再在位点上与 ADP 结合成 ATP
options.en: Protons, which enter F1 and there combine with ADP into ATP

options.zh: ADP + Pi 与 ATP，质子只走 FO 通道、不进入 F1 头部
options.en: ADP + Pi and ATP; protons pass through FO and never enter F1

options.zh: 泛醌与泛醇，靠这一对的氧化还原驱动头部的构象变化
options.en: Ubiquinone and ubiquinol, whose redox drives the conformations

options.zh: 细胞色素 c 与氧气，二者在紧密结合的 T 位点上完成偶联
options.en: Cytochrome c and oxygen, coupled together at the tight site

quiz.explain_zh: 三个位点结合的是底物 ADP + Pi 和产物 ATP；质子完全不进 F1，它在 FO 里质子化 c 亚基的保守羧基、随 c 环转一圈后进入基质，能量以扭矩的形式传给 γ。老师前面两次说位点「结合氢质子」正是这里要纠正的（他在约 01:50:52 把 O／T／L 的分工改对了，但没有改这一点）。泛醌和细胞色素 c 都是电子传递链的载体，与 ATP 合酶没有任何直接接触，氧还原只发生在复合体 IV。
quiz.explain_en: The three sites bind the substrates ADP and Pi and the product ATP. Protons never enter F1; within FO they protonate a conserved carboxylate on a c subunit, ride the ring around into the matrix, and their energy reaches gamma as torque. His two statements that the sites bind protons are exactly what needs correcting here — at about 01:50:52 he fixes the O/T/L assignment but not this. Ubiquinone and cytochrome c are respiratory-chain carriers that never touch ATP synthase, and oxygen reduction happens only at Complex IV.

quiz.q_zh: γ 亚基每转完整的 360°，F1 一共产生几个 ATP？
quiz.q_en: How many ATP does F1 produce per full 360° rotation of gamma?

options.zh: 2 个，其中一个 β 亚基在这一圈里始终保持开放态
options.en: Two, since one beta subunit stays open throughout the turn

options.zh: 3 个，三个 β 各走一遍 open→loose→tight 各放出 1 个
options.en: Three, each beta running open→loose→tight and releasing one

options.zh: 6 个，α 与 β 亚基上的六个位点在一圈里同时放出 ATP
options.en: Six, all six sites on the alpha and beta subunits firing at once

options.zh: 1 个，三个 β 亚基协同完成同一次完整的催化循环
options.en: One, the three betas cooperating in a single catalytic cycle

quiz.explain_zh: γ 转 120° 推动一个 β 走完一步构象变化，转满 360° 三个 β 各完成一遍 open→loose→tight，共放出 3 个 ATP。记成 1 个正是老师最后那句「每一次旋转释放一个 ATP」的字面理解，会把产率算成三分之一；说有一个 β 全程保持开放则违背了三个位点严格轮转、始终三态并存的机制；F1 虽有 6 个核苷酸位点，但 α 上的 3 个是非催化位点，只起调节作用，不生成 ATP。
quiz.explain_en: A 120° step of gamma advances one beta through one conformational change, so a full 360° puts all three betas once through open→loose→tight and releases three ATP. Answering one is the literal reading of his closing 'one ATP per rotation' and understates the yield threefold. Saying one beta stays open throughout contradicts the strict rotation of states, which keeps all three occupied at every instant. And although F1 has six nucleotide sites, the three on the alpha subunits are non-catalytic and merely regulatory.
